    • How long does it take to get a trade license in Ajman?
    • Is Ajman trade license valid across the UAE?

Ajman is one of the dynamically growing economic and business centers in the United Arab Emirates and businesses that are emerging here now and then must acquire Ajman Trade License to kick start their journey. 

As Ajman is near to Dubai and Abu Dhabi, it offers various opportunities and benefits for businesses like low corporate tax rate, Ajman free zone for freelancers and convenience in company formation in mainland.

If you want to apply for a business license in Ajman, you will require following certain steps outlined by the local authorities and you must know Ajman trade license cost before applying for it.

Here is everything you need to know about its fee and other relevant information:

The Advantages of Obtaining a Trade License in Ajman

Setting up a business in Ajman is relatively less costly as compared to Dubai and Abu Dhabi and that is why it is ideal for businesses to visit Ajman for once to explore the investment opportunities. Also, getting an Ajman trade licenses is necessary for every business to start their venture. It comes with the following advantages:

  • Ajman has its own Free Zone and it is regulated by Ajman Free Zone Authority. It lets businesses and proprietors to operate freely in various industries and manufacturing services through Ajman trade license.
  • Due to nearness to Dubai and Abu Dhabi, Ajman has become a prime location for entrepreneurs, investors, and businessmen who are interested in the real estate sector.
  • The government of Ajman facilitates investors and funding seekers with easier loan processes and grants them to acquire property.
  • Through various business-friendly initiatives the Ajman Government aims to reduce the cost of business related to commercial or property.

Understanding the Different Types of Ajman Trade Licenses

There is variety of Ajman trade licenses that one must acquire to accommodate diverse activities of business and commercial nature. Let’s go through some of the business licenses in Ajman:

Commercial or Trading License

This is the fundamental Commercial license for businesses that is necessary for all businesses providing any sort of services or products to the consumers. Through this license on can carry out commercial activities related to common use commodities and products within the UAE like:

  • Import
  • Export
  • Distribution
  • Re-exportation
  • Recycling
  • Retail

Industrial or Manufacturing License

Through Industrial license, the businesses can carry out activities like manufacturing of goods, industrial processing of raw materials, and even assemble heavy duty items. Businesses in Ajman are able to do the following operation through industrial trade license:  

  • The import of raw materials
  • The production of eligible products or commodities
  • The export of products or commodities
  • The assembly of machinery or any other heavy duty items

Freelance License

The Ajman government encourages freelancers and that is why there is a growing number of freelancer licenses issuance for supporting freelance businesses, and services in the UAE.

E-commerce License

Ecommerce is expanding all over the world and UAE does not lack behind when it comes to Ecommerce expansion. That is why Ajman Government issues Ecommerce licenses to businesses to operate online and entrepreneurs are benefitted to it immensely. Through this license, online businesses can perfrom following activities:

  • Online retail and fashion trading
  • Provide online services related to media and entertainment
  • Sell industrial electronic equipment
  • Ecommerce related to automotive and auto spare parts
  • Online shopping facility for personal, home, or office use items and utilities

Step-by-Step Guide to Obtaining a Trade License in Ajman

There is a certain process that you must follow for obtaining your trade license in Ajman. Here is the step-by-step process for obtaining your Ajman business license:

Market Research:

An extensive market research is important to evaluate the business environment in Ajman, your target audience, your competitors, and industry trends.

Business Activity and Legal Structure:

Determine what will be the business activities of your organization and legal structure to choose the appropriate business license.

Company Name Reservation:

Select a unique and memorable company name and reserve it with the Department of Economic Development in Ajman.

Document Preparation:

You will need to prepare the documents necessary to kick start the process and these includes:

  • Passport copies
  • Proof of business address
  • A detailed business plan
  • Application form of license
  • Free payment receipts

Application Submission:

You can submit your trade license application through online portal or you can submit it in person to the Ajman Department of Economic Development.

Review and Approval Process:

The application undergoes a review process by the authorities, including document authentication, background checks, and compliance evaluation.

Business License Acquisition:

Upon approval, obtain the business license specifying permitted activities, validity duration, and any additional conditions.

Renewal and Compliance:

Renew the license annually and ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and laws of Ajman.

Ajman Free Zone vs. Mainland: Choosing the Right License for Your Business

Setting up a business in Ajman demands you to learn the difference between the Free Zone and Mainland so that you can apply for the Trade License accordingly.

There are various reasons to understand Free Zone or Mainland:

  • Help in selecting the right business entity type
  • Help in aligning your business requirements with these zones
  • Help in evaluating your intended business ownership structure

Free Zone and Mainland both have their own limitations as well as advantages that businesses have to respect. Let’s get the overview of them:

Free zone in Ajman refer to the area of economic activities that can be used for trading goods and services by investors and receive with special tax benefits and customs rates.  An Ajman company in Mainland needs to be registered for a business license from the Ajman DED (Department of Economic Development) 
By investing in Free Zone and getting the Free Zone trade license in Ajman, you can enjoy the following benefits:
 

  • 100% foreign business ownership
  •  0% rate for corporate and VAT
  • 100% ROI for profits and capital funds
  • Fast processing of trade license
 Companies and businesses in Mainland Ajman are also called onshore companies and they can: 

  • Easily access to local markets
  • Get reach to international markets like markets in GCC region and Middle East
  • RHQ setup in Ajman business district
  • Tax emptions 

Costs and Fees Associated with Ajman Trade Licenses

In this section, we will discuss the it’s fees for companies operating in Ajman Free Zone, Mainland, or working as a LLC company in Ajman. Go through the following information to know what will be the license cost.

Cost of Ajman Trade License For Free Zone Company:

  • The cost of license for Ajman Media Free Zone is approximately AED 25,000.
  • Ajman free zone trade license cost is also around AED 25,000.
  • Ultimate cost may vary based on factors like visas, rental space, and business type.
  • Both free zones offer benefits like 100% ownership, tax exemptions, and strategic location near airports and seaports.

 Cost of Ajman General Trading License:

  • Ajman business license cost is AED 35,150 for general trading.
  • Includes initial approval, trade name, and license issuance fees.
  • Relatively less expensive than in other Emirates.
  • Procedure for obtaining the license is simplified.
  • Allows companies to conduct business within the emirate and import/export products.

Ajman LLC License Cost:

  • Cost varies based on business scale, shareholders, and activity.
  • Average cost for an LLC license in Ajman for the first year is around AED 14,000.
  • Includes DED license fees, UAE service agent, consultant, documentation, and ongoing support.
  • Ajman LLC costs are generally lower than other Emirates.
  • Ajman offers advantages that reduce the overall cost of establishing a business.

Renewing Your Ajman Trade License: Key Considerations and Timelines

Renewing your Ajman trade license is necessary when it comes to make your business operations seamless and smooth. Here are some key considerations you have to account when it comes to renewing your Ajman trade license: 

Prepare all the required document

 Before renewing the Ajman trade license, you must gather the necessary documents like:

  • Proof of business insurance
  • A detailed financial bank statement
  • Copy of passport and business expired business license along with residency permit
  • Other relevant documents

Submission of renewal application

You have to submit the license renewal application to the AFZA Ajman Free Zone Authority

Ajman trade license renewal fees

it’s renewal fees is AED 5,000 to AED 20,000, depending on the business type, license type you are applying to and the scale of business operations.

The license renewal timeline

On an average, the process for renewal of business license in Ajman may take a week or several depending on the following circumstances:

  • Type of business in Ajman
  • Company’s legal structure
  • The complete documentation
  • Accuracy of the information in application
  • History of law compliance, taxation, and participation in economic activities

Compliance and Regulations: Ensuring Legal Compliance with Your Ajman Trade License

All businesses must comply with all the legal regulations in Ajman Mainland and Free Zone, i.e., AFZA to operate smoothly and seamlessly in Ajman UAE. It will help them in bypassing financial penalties, and also they can maintain their business’s good reputation. Here are some points to keep in mind:

  • Registration of your business
  • Acquiring trade license in Ajman
  • Learn the Ajman’s employment laws
  • Learn about the intellectual property rights
  • Stay compliant to the taxes
  • Maintain business record-keeping and ensure accounting and auditing
  • International law compliance
  • Legal consultation and professional business support

Ajman Trade License Inquiry: Get Answers to Your Licensing Questions

You can go the official online portal of Ajman DED to get the answers to all your queries related to license, cost, legalities involve in it, and other aspects. 

Ajman Trade License Fine Check: Avoid Penalties with Quick Verification

As an emerging business in Ajman, you have to conduct trade license fine check to ensure your financial planning and avoid delays in renewals. Economic Development Authority in Ajman implements hi-tech solutions like online and SMS renewal systems for trade licenses. Also keep in mind that you have to pay fines as per the Ajman’s Economic Development (DED) website. Here are the penalties for Non-Renewal of Ajman trade license:

  • Operating a business without a license incurs a penalty of AED 5000.
  • Failure to renew a license within the specified time results in a fine of AED 250.
  • Adding an additional office without permission leads to a fine of AED 2000

Activities List: Explore Permitted Business Ventures

Ajman is offering a lot of opportunities for business to perform a set of activities and the permitted Ajman trade license activities list is as follow:

  • Trading 
  • Industrial manufacturing
  • Business and legal consultancy services
  • Ecommerce
  • Food processing and packaging
  • Logistic services
  • IT and software services
  • Media, marketing and advertising

Ajman Trade License Verification: Ensure Legitimacy with Hassle-Free Checks

Yu have to use Department of Economic Development’s E-services for conveniently and efficiently checking of your trade license and verify it. The portal can be accessed through the website of DED for Ajman trade license verification and obtain all the details relevant to it.

How Connect Zone can help you get Ajman Trade License?

Connect Zone is the business consultancy firm in the UAE helping a lot of clients with their trade license in Ajman. Whether you want to know the Ajman trade license cost or you want to renew it, we are here for all the hassles so that you can focus on your business core activities.

FAQs

What is an Ajman trade license?

An Ajman trade license is an official permit issued by the Ajman Department of Economic Development that allows you to legally conduct business in Ajman.

How much does an Ajman trade license cost?

In 2025, costs typically start from around AED 10,000 to AED 20,000 depending on the business activity, office space, and required approvals.

What types of trade licenses are available in Ajman?

Common types are commercial license (for trading), professional license (for services), and industrial license (for manufacturing).

Can foreigners get a trade license in Ajman?

Yes. Foreigners can get a trade license in Ajman, including 100% ownership in many free zones and certain mainland options with current UAE ownership rules.

How long does it take to get a trade license in Ajman?

It usually takes about 5–10 working days once all documents are submitted and requirements are met.

Is Ajman trade license valid across the UAE?

Yes, an Ajman trade license is valid to operate legally in Ajman, and you can trade across the UAE, but for selling directly in other emirates, you may need additional approvals or local agent arrangement,s depending on your activity.

ABusinesses need to be profitable in order to be successful. Interested in setting up shop in Abu Dhabi and witnessing success by earning great profits? Well, you have come to just the right place. Connect Zone brings you these lucrative Abu Dhabi business ideas. From starting your real estate agency to running your very own food truck, we have a list of top 10 profitable business ideas in Abu Dhabi. So keep reading to find out the currently popular market trends and useful business ideas.

Business Idea #1 Real Estate Development

Real estate development is one of the top trending business ideas in Abu Dhabi. The real estate sector in the city of Abu Dhabi has seen a considerable amount of growth in recent times.

Those who are already in the real estate business offer a variety of services. A Real estate business includes different fields of related services, such as:

  • Real estate consulting
  • Property rental
  • Property management services

This field is not for just anyone. You need to be an expert to establish yourself as the go-to person for it. 

Business Idea #2 Tourism and Hospitality Services

When it comes to tourist attractions, Abu Dhabi has a lot to offer. This makes Abu Dhabi an ideal place for businesses catering to tourists from all around the world.

Setting up your business in the city of Abu Dhabi to offer tourism and hospitality services is a sure way to succeed. You can offer these services in a variety of ways. From running hotels to managing luxury resorts, it is a largely profitable business. Another example of these services are specialized tour operators, travel agencies, and even inns.

Whichever service you choose to offer in the hospitality industry, it remains one of the greatest profitable Abu Dhabi business ideas.

Business Idea #3 Tech Startups

Tech startups are great as part of business ideas in Abu Dhabi. Offering IT services — as the present day world continues its course towards technological advancements — is genius.

Tech startups offer different services. Here are some of of them to give you more business ideas in Abu Dhabi:

  • Software development
  • App development
  • Cyber security solutions
  • Information technology services

Business Idea #4 Healthcare Services

Healthcare services have many opportunities if that is your field. You need to gain the relevant approvals and licenses from government authorities to start offering your healthcare services.

Some of the healthcare services are:

  • Health clinics
  • Wellness retreats
  • Fitness programs

Business Idea #5 Renewable Energy Solutions

Some suggest renewable energy solutions as profitable business ideas in Abu Dhabi. However, not everyone can offer these. Only experts will be able to run this business setup in Abu Dhabi. If you are thinking of using this from Abu Dhabi business ideas, you may need relevant licenses for it. 

Business Idea #6 Education and Training

As for business ideas in Abu Dhabi, there is always room for education and training programs. With the right tools, you can get started right away if you want to start this business. People running their business in this category do so in these domains:

  • Language schools
  • Vocational centers
  • Online learning
  • Tutoring services

Business Idea #7 Food and Beverage

Win hearts, loyal customers and profits with a food and beverage business. Stepping your foot in the food industry is actually quite easy given you follow all the health and safety standards.

You can run your business in different forms selling food and beverages. You may sell your cultural cuisine or street food with a food truck. lso open up specialized cafes with your secret generational recipe.

Food delivery services are some of the great business ideas in Abu Dhabi too.

Business Idea #8 Consulting and Professional Services

With some experience, your best choice among business ideas in Abu Dhabi are consulting and professional services. Offer consulting services and your valuable advice in departments of your expertise. For example, if you are well-versed in marketing, you may offer services in that department. Tech experts and finance experts will have success in their fields.

Business Idea #9 Retail

In the list of remarkable business ideas in Abu Dhabi, retail is one of the leading ones. Retail businesses are an everyday need. They have a regular demand. With some market knowledge, expertise and strategies, profits are sure to follow.

Business Idea #10 Event Management and Entertainment

Event management and entertainment are also great business ideas in Abu Dhabi. Reaching out to someone specializing in event management is a need of today’s fast paced world.

With this business, you can manage events of different kinds for a variety of clients. You may offer your services to manage some of these events:

  • Business conferences
  • Annual seminars
  • Annual dinners
  • Weddings

FAQs for Profitable Business Ideas in Abu Dhabi

Is Abu Dhabi a suitable location for tech startups?

Abu Dhabi is one of the most suitable locations for tech startups around the world. Being the hub of business and technology advancements, tech startups get access to a lot of clients and can offer a variety of their tech related services.

What opportunities exist for entrepreneurs in Abu Dhabi’s tourism sector?

Entrepreneurs will find ample opportunities in Abu Dhabi’s tourism sector. From being able to run hotels to offering services as a travel agency, there is a lot to avail in the business sector of tourism. 

Are there any government incentives or support programs for new businesses in Abu Dhabi?

This is the list of some of the support programs and government incentives for new businesses in Abu Dhabi:

  1. Hub71
  2. Khalifa Fund for Enterprise Development (KFED)
  3. Mohammed Bin Rashid Innovation Fund (MBRIF)
  4. Emirates Development Bank (EDB)
  5. Market Expansion to Abu Dhabi
  6. Khalifa Industrial Zone (KIZAD)
  7. ADIO Innovation Programme
  8. Industrial Development Bureau (IDB) incentives
    • The Energy Tariff Incentive Programme (ETIP)
    • The Land Rebate Incentive Programme
    • The Smart Manufacturing Programme
    • The Financial Ecosystem Programme

How can I navigate the process of starting a business in Abu Dhabi as a foreign entrepreneur?

Foreign entrepreneurs can follow this simple process to start a business in Abu Dhabi:

  1. Identify the nature of your business activity
  2. Determine the legal structure of your company
  3. Register your trade name
  4. Obtain initial approval
  5. Get an MOA
  6. Choose the location of your business
  7. Obtain additional government approvals
  8. Submit the required documents
  9. Pay fees
  10. Collect license
  11. Register your company with the Chamber of commerce and industry

What are the key factors to consider when choosing a business location in Abu Dhabi?

There are some of the factors to consider when choosing a business location in Abu Dhabi:

  • Legal status
  • Size
  • Budget
  • Visibility
  • Accessibility
  • Transport
  • facilities

Are there specific regulations or permits required for certain types of businesses in Abu Dhabi?

Specific permits and licenses are required for these certain types of businesses in Abu Dhabi.

  • Healthcare: Approval from the Department of Health Abu Dhabi (DOH).
  • Education: Permits from the Abu Dhabi Department of Education and Knowledge (ADEK).
  • Tourism and Hospitality: Permits from the Department of Culture and Tourism (DCT) Abu Dhabi.
  • Financial Services: Licensed by the Central Bank of the UAE or Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM).
  • Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi (EAD): Required for businesses impacting the environment.
  • Abu Dhabi Municipality: Building permits and approvals
  • Department of Municipal Affairs: Compliance for real estate businesses

What are the best business ideas in Abu Dhabi?

Best ideas include tech services, health and fitness, e-commerce, tourism services, real estate support, logistics, consulting, and renewable energy solutions.

Low-cost options are online stores, digital marketing, tutoring, consulting, content creation, delivery services, and freelancing.

Is Abu Dhabi good for new startups?

Yes. Abu Dhabi has strong government support, funding programs, modern infrastructure, and a growing startup ecosystem.

What business licenses are required in Abu Dhabi?

You need a trade license from Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development that matches your activity, such as commercial, professional, industrial, or service license.

Can foreigners start a business in Abu Dhabi?

Yes. Foreigners can start and fully own businesses, especially in free zones and under updated mainland ownership laws.

Which sectors are growing fast in Abu Dhabi?

Fast growing sectors in 2025 include technology, renewable energy, healthcare, tourism, logistics, and specialised services.

Discover the Six Cheapest Free Zones in the United Arab Emirates

The United Arab States is the most ideal place in the world to start and grow your business due to its economic condition which is favorable for entrepreneurs.

Free zones are economic areas where companies can be opened at custom rates and with privileged taxes. Each free zone in the UAE, such as IFZA, Jafza, DMC, and others, has its own regulations and rules.

Free Zones attract a good number of local and foreign investors due to several reasons including 0% taxes and 100% foreign ownership. Free zones have gained popularity over the years with an increasing number of businesses.

The six popular free zones available in the UAE are:

  1. International Free Zone Authority (IFZA)
  2. Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO)
  3. Jebel Ali Free Zone (Jafza)
  4. Dubai Media City (DMC)
  5. Dubai Healthcare City (DHC)
  6. Sharjah Media City (Shams)

1. International Free Zone Authority (IFZA)

IFZA, as one of the most competitive free zones in the UAE, is located in the Silicon Oasis area in Dubai. IFZA provides business owners with multiple low-cost company setup packages. Packages are starting at AED 12,900 which make it the cheapest free zone in the United Arab Emirates to start a business.

Business owners need to take permission from the IFZA authority who decides the range of business activities. You can choose a maximum of 3 activities under one license. The type of license offered in the IFZA free zone are:

  • Professional
  • Commercial

2. Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO)

Dubai Silicon Oasis, commonly known as DSO. DSO is a fully government-owned free zone. It was established in the year 2005 by the Government of Dubai. Their mission is to facilitate and promote modern technology based industries. They also support the region’s demand for business expansion.

3. Jebel Ali Free Zone (Jafza)

The Jebel Ali Free Zone is a ecosystem and community where industries such as:

  • Logistics
  • E-commerce
  • Petrochemicals and 14 other industries thrive.

It helps in flourishing key business sectors with an annual trade of $104.2 billion per year.

4. Dubai Media City (DMC)

Dubai Media City (DMC) established in the year 2000. It has grown into a hub for media companies. DMC is a community for:

  • Freelancers
  • SMEs
  • Start-ups and
  • Large enterprises co-exist.

It has been one of the most fertile grounds for the development of media industries due to its integrated infrastructure.

5. Dubai Healthcare City (DHC)

The Dubai Healthcare city was established in the year 2002 to bring together core healthcare services. It attracts the best network of businesses from hospitality to retail outlets and consultancies. It is governed by Dubai Healthcare City Authority.

6. Sharjah Media City (Shams)

One of the fastest growing media free zones, SHAMS is on top of the UAE’s list. For new entrepreneurs, it fosters a vibrant and growing atmosphere. We can say that it’s the ideal free zone for established businesses as well as new investors.

Offering a vast list of business activities, you can easily get trade licenses starting from AED 5750. Different business activities have different license types. For those who want to establish a business without a physical presence, SHAMS is an ideal place. The type of business license offered in the Sharjah Media City are:

  • Trading
  • Service & Consultancy
  • Media
  • Holding and other types
  • Social media influencer

Most Affordable Free Zones in the UAE for Starting Your Business

The most affordable and cheapest free zone in UAE to start operating your business are:

  1. Sharjah Research Technology and Innovation Park (SRTIP)

SRTIP free zone is aligned with the UAE’s 10-year strategic plan. It promotes research in renewable energy,  environmental technology, water management, transport and others.

SRTIP free zone is a new player in the industry. It is offering trade licenses economically from AED 5500 for different business activities.

  1. Ajman Media City (AMC)

Ajman media city offers a quick and simple company formation process. It is a  new investment destination in the UAE. The AMC attracts businesses from all across the world. Their services are cheap, easy and cost-effective. It incorporates a wide variety of entertainment and media related activities. It offers a trade license starting from AED 8500

  1. Sharjah Media City (Shams)

SHAMS is one of the fastest growing free zones in the Sharjah, UAE. It facilitates a growing atmosphere for entrepreneurs. A best place for established businesses as well as new investors.

They offer a vast list of business activities. Trade licenses can be obtained starting from AED 5750.

  1. Ras Al Khaimah Free zone (RAKEZ)

Ras Al Khaimah Free zone is also one of the cheapest free zone license in uae. The RAKEZ is located close to the RAK seaport and airport. Due to its location it is a lucrative option for aspiring entrepreneurs.

RAKEZ offers SME packages starting from AED 5499. The RAKEZ is renowned for its customizable warehousing solutions. According to the business activities, you can choose low, medium and high sized warehouses.

  1. International Free Zone Authority (IFZA)

It is one of the most competitive free zones in the UAE. IFZA is located in the Silicon Oasis area in Dubai. International Free Zone Authority provides business owners with multiple low-cost company setup packages. Packages are starting at AED 12,900 which make it the cheapest free zone in the United Arab Emirates to start a business.

Comparative Analysis: Cost Breakdown of Operating in Different Free Zones in the UAE

Cheapest Free zone in Sharjah Sharjah Media City AED 9000 Creative Business Center

There are many cheap and economical free zones in Dubai but the Dubai International Financial Center DIFC deserve a separate mention

Navigating Legalities: Understanding the Regulations in the Cheapest Free Zones of the UAE

The Free zones companies are regulated by the local government in each respective Emirate, so each free zone has its own restrictions and procedures. Usually, if a company is registered under a respective free zone then it is not permitted for them to carry out business activities outside the free zone.

Factors to Consider When Choosing a Budget-Friendly Free Zone for Your Business in the UAE

  • Business activities
  • Facility types for business
  • Free zone location accessibility
  • Tax Incentives and Custom Benefits
  • Type of legal entity

Business activities:

This is the most important factor to choose a free zone for your business. Each free zone has different guidelines in the UAE depending on the business activities. The more business activities you carry out the more licenses you need under one company

Facility types for business:

Facilities are also among the top factors when selecting a free zone. A company registered in the free zone can only have the facility within the free zone where it is registered. The free zone offered a variety of services in their area to the businesses operating there. The facility you choose to set up your business in a free zone must be aligned with your needs and budget.

Free zone location accessibility:

Location is another criterion when opting for free zone location. The location must be reliable for your company. The free zone connectivity with roads, airports, seaports must be evaluated.

  • For import and export business set up, a popular sea-air hub like JAFZA would be best suitable for your business.

  • DAFZA might be the reliable option for proximity to airports

A tax environment which is favorable is the main attraction of the UAE free zone.

For an investment business, the selection of the best Dubai free zone can depend on various factors such as:

title: Types of Residence Visas in UAE: Which One is Right for You?
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle
  • Tourist Visa: Exploring Short-term Stay Options
  • Employment Visa: Navigating Work Opportunities in the UAE
  • Investor Visa: Investing in the Future of the UAE
  • Family Residence Visa: Bringing Your Loved Ones Closer
  • Student Visa: Pursuing Education in the UAE
  • Retirement Visa: Enjoying Your Golden Years in the UAE
  • Freelancer Visa: Embracing the Freedom of Freelancing in the UAE
  • Comparison of Visa Types: Finding the Right Fit for You
  • Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) For Types of residence visa in UAE
    • What is a residence visa, and why is it important in the UAE?
    • What are the eligibility criteria for obtaining a tourist visa in the UAE?
    • Can I work in the country with a tourist visa?
    • Is it possible to bring family members to the UAE on a family residence visa?
    • What are the benefits of an investor visa, and how can I qualify for one?
    • Can international students study in the UAE with a student visa?
    • What are the requirements for obtaining a retirement visa in the UAE?
    • How does the freelancer visa program work in the UAE, and who is eligible?

The types of residence visa in UAE allow foreigners to establish themselves in the country according to their particular conditions. In this case, there is a wide variety of visas ranging from work visas to retirement visas. Each of them has its particular requirements and conditions to be able to aspire to obtain one.

In this article, we will show you what the characteristics of each of the visas offered by local authorities are. Likewise, we will answer some of the most common questions to clear up your doubts in this regard.

Tourist Visa: Exploring Short-term Stay Options

Although it is not among the types of residence visa in UAE, it is possible to visit the country with a tourist visa. In this case, it is for those who are not eligible for a visa on arrival or visa-free entry into the country. Citizens of any country are eligible to obtain a tourist visa if they meet the other conditions.

For example, women under 18 years of age cannot apply for this type of visa, only if they are traveling with their parents. The UAE tourist visa, which is valid for 5 years, allows the holder to enter the country multiple times. Additionally, you will be able to stay in the country for 90 days, which you can renew for the same amount of time.

To apply for a tourist visa, people from any country must meet the following requirements:

  • A minimum balance of USD 4,000 (approximately AED 14,690) in the bank for the last 6 months.
  • Have valid medical insurance for the Emirates.
  • A plane ticket to the country and one out.
  • Proof of stay in the country, either in a private home or in a hotel.

Likewise, applicants must submit the documents that we will mention below:

  • Color photo
  • Passport copy
  • Valid health insurance
  • Proof of possessing the necessary financial qualification
  • Trip program
  • Journey continuation ticket

Employment Visa: Navigating Work Opportunities in the UAE

A residence visa in UAE that allows you to live and work in the country is a work visa. However, this visa requires that a company in the nation sponsors you offering you a signed contract. The company that must sponsor the applicant may be located on the mainland, in a free zone, or be government-owned.

The company is responsible for carrying out all the procedures and paying the fees for the work visa application. Below, you can see the documents that the company and the applicant must submit to the authorities:

  • Business license from the company that wants to hire the employee
  • Company Immigration Card
  • Business employment card
  • Employee passport
  • Color photo on a white background of the potential employee
  • Educational certificates
  • Previous residence visa if you have had one
  • Emirates ID if you had it
  • Valid health insurance

On the other hand, companies owned by the government or established in a Free Zone need the following additional documents:

  • Online application
  • Office lease agreement
  • Copy of the offer or appointment letter

This is one of the types of residence visa in UAE that has variable validity depending on the characteristics. The validity of the employment visa in a continental company is 2 years and in a free zone or government company it is 3 years. In both cases, the visa is renewable for the same period and the application must be made by the employer.

Investor Visa: Investing in the Future of the UAE

Another of the types of residence visa UAE is the one that can be obtained by those who wish to do business in the nation. In this case, the applicant must have a company in the UAE or own shares in a local business. Thus, the visa holder can live and work in the country legally for the duration of the visa.

The residence visa for investors, or investor visa, is valid for 3 years with the possibility of renewal. This visa requires the documentation that we will list below if the application is for a company on the continent:

  • Company Business License
  • Immigration Establishment Card
  • Memorandum of Association for Limited Liability Companies (LLC)
  • List of partners for an LLC
  • Local service agreements
  • Partnership contracts
  • Photo on a white background and passport of the investor
  • Bank statement
  • Residence visa and Emirates ID (in case of previous residence)

These requirements plus a certificate of incorporation are necessary for investments in Free Zones.

Family Residence Visa: Bringing Your Loved Ones Closer

This is one of the types of residence visa in UAE that an expatriate with a residence visa in the country can sponsor. However, this type of visa is only for immediate family members, which includes spouses, children, and parents. Additionally, applicants for this type of visa must meet the following requirements for sponsorship:

  • Investors must pay AED 3,000 for each family member they wish to sponsor.
  • Employees in the UAE must have a minimum salary of AED 4,000 or AED 300 plus monthly rent.
  • Parents must have a monthly income that should not be less than AED 20000. However, in case of the death of one of the parents, you must submit the death certificate.

Likewise, sponsors of the family visa must submit the following documents:

  • Copy of passport
  • Copy of residence visa
  • Original Emirates ID
  • Bank statement

On the other hand, dependents who aspire to obtain a family visa must submit the documents that we will mention below:

  • Passport with a minimum validity of 6 months
  • Photograph on a white background that must be the same size as the passport
  • Spouses must provide a marriage certificate
  • In the case of children, the sponsor must present the birth certificate

The validity of a family visa is commonly 2 years but can be for the same duration as the visa of the sponsor. Furthermore, among the types of visa in UAE, this depends on the visa of the sponsor. Therefore, if the sponsor cancels the visa; he/she must also cancel the family visa of his/her dependents.

Student Visa: Pursuing Education in the UAE

Foreign students may be granted a residence visa in UAE if they meet the requirements. In this way, they can enroll in one of the educational institutions in the country by legally residing. The documents include those common to the different types of visa, including the following:

  • Copy of passport with at least 6 months of validity
  • A photograph of the same size as the passport with a white background
  • Visa receipts
  • Tuition fees
  • Copy of admission letter from the relevant educational institution

Among the types of residence visa in UAE, this is one of the least valid, only 1 year. Nevertheless, students can request annual renewal for the duration of their studies. However, there are certain characteristics that a student can meet to receive a 5-year student visa, which are:

  • Have a grade of 95% if you are a high school student
  • Have a GPA (Grade Point Average ) of at least 3.75 for undergraduates

Retirement Visa: Enjoying Your Golden Years in the UAE

Another of the types of visa in UAE is the retirement visa for citizens who are over 55 years old. Conversely, you must meet one of the eligibility criteria to be able to request this document. The mandatory criteria that must be met to receive it are detailed below:

  • You must own a real estate investment in a property worth a minimum of AED 2 million.
  • Have at least AED 1 million on savings.
  • Have continuous income of a minimum value of AED 20000 per month.
  • Combine property ownership and savings worth at least AED 2 million.

On the other hand, as with other types of residence visa in UAE, applicants must submit the following documents:

  • Passport of the applicant
  • Marriage certificate for applicant couples
  • Current residence visa
  • Emirates ID

Likewise, it requires one of the following additional documents for particular cases:

  • Real estate investment
  • Copy of the property title
  • Proof of sufficient savings
  • Proof of retirement letter
  • Fixed income test
  • Proof of income letter
  • 6-month bank statement
  • Proof of savings letter

Of the types of residence visa UAE, this is one of the longest duration as it is valid for 5 years. Additionally, as with other visas, you can renew them for the same period as the original application.

Freelancer Visa: Embracing the Freedom of Freelancing in the UAE

Most free zones in the UAE offer freelance visas for citizens of various countries. Additionally, as with other types of UAE residency visa, you do not need a sponsor for one of these visas. Therefore, it allows you to live, including your family, and work in the country independently for between 1 and 5 years.

When applying for a self-employed visa in the UAE, you must submit the following documents:

  • Updated CV
  • Complete application form
  • Copy of the passport of the applicant
  • Photograph
  • Certified academic qualifications
  • 2 professional references with corresponding contact information
  • Those who have employment in the country must have a No Objection Certificate (NOC)

In addition to having these documents, applicants must meet the following eligibility criteria:

  • Obtain a freelance permit from the MOHRE.
  • Have a specialist diploma or a bachelor’s degree.
  • Prove that you have had a minimum income of AED 360000 during the 2 years before applying. However, you can show your financial ability to support yourself during your stay in the UAE.

Comparison of Visa Types: Finding the Right Fit for You

Each of the types of residence visa in UAE are specific for people who meet the established criteria. Choosing the right type of visa for you depends on your conditions and needs for your stay in the country. For example, you would need a student visa if you only want to study in the country, as you cannot work using this visa.

Nevertheless, there are differences between a work visa and a freelance visa, as you need a contract with a company for the former. Therefore, if you want to work in a company in the UAE, you must obtain a work visa. In contrast, with a freelance visa, you can do work for various companies and will not need a sponsor.

Hence, understanding each of the types of residence visa UAE will help you understand which one is ideal for you.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) For Types of residence visa in UAE

What is a residence visa, and why is it important in the UAE?

This is a document that allows expats to live in the United Arab Emirates legally. Residence visas can be valid for between 1 and 10 years depending on the type, which are renewable. In addition, residence visas in the country are important for the following reasons:

  • The country does not offer permanent residence, so you need a visa and renew it within the established period.
  • You can open a bank account
  • You can get a driver’s license
  • Have access to government health services
  • In some cases, you can work legally
  • Travel to certain countries without losing your residency

What are the eligibility criteria for obtaining a tourist visa in the UAE?

This is one of the types of visa in UAE for All nationalities for which you will need to comply with the following:

  • A bank balance of AED 14,690 (USD 4,000)
  • Have valid health insurance
  • UAE arrival and departure ticket
  • Proof of stay

Can I work in the country with a tourist visa?

The tourist visa does not allow holders to participate in activities outside of tourism, such as working in the country. People who work under a tourist visa will receive sanctions and legal responsibilities.

Is it possible to bring family members to the UAE on a family residence visa?

Foreigners with UAE residency visas can bring their family and spouse to the country on a family visa. However, applicants must meet a series of requirements imposed by the authorities regarding salary and accommodation. Likewise, people over 18 years of age who apply for a family visa must pass a medical examination consisting of several tests.

What are the benefits of an investor visa, and how can I qualify for one?

Just like the other types of residence visa in UAE, the investor visa gives the holder the following benefits:

  • It allows the holder to live in the country for three years.
  • Sponsor your close family members (spouse, children, and parents).
  • Facilities for traveling between GCC member countries.
  • You can live outside the UAE for 1 year without losing residency.
  • Eventually, you will be able to obtain a golden visa that allows you to reside for up to 10 renewable years.

One of the conditions to be able to obtain an investor visa is to be over 18 years of age. Though, you must establish a company in the country or you must prove that you have an investment in the country.

Can international students study in the UAE with a student visa?

The authorities allow international students to obtain a residence visa in UAE for this purpose. However, you must first be accepted into an educational institution to apply for a student visa. Additionally, you must meet specific qualification requirements for high school students and college students.

What are the requirements for obtaining a retirement visa in the UAE?

The first requirement to obtain a retirement visa in the UAE is to be over 55 years of age. Additionally, the applicant must have worked for at least 15 years in the country or outside of it. Likewise, you must meet certain financial conditions, such as savings, property, or continuous income.

How does the freelancer visa program work in the UAE, and who is eligible?

The authorities make it easier for independent workers to obtain a self-sponsored visa to work. However, they can only work in permitted activities, which include jobs in media, education, design, and more. As with the other types of residence visa in UAE, they must meet certain conditions which are:

  • They must a permit to work from the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratization (MOHRE)
  • Have a bachelor’s degree or specialization diploma
  • Have an annual income for the previous two years of AED 360,000 thanks to your work. You can also show financial solvency to support yourself throughout your stay in the UAE.

If you have any questions regarding visa types in the UAE or how to set up a company, please contact us.

title: Top 5 Benefits of the UAE Golden Visa Program – Unlocking Opportunity
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle

  • Financial Opportunities

  • Real Estate Investment
  • Here are some frequently asked questions (FAQs) about the UAE Golden Visa program

    • What is the salary for Golden Visa in UAE?

    • How long is the validity of the UAE Golden Visa?
    • Are there any financial requirements or investment thresholds for the UAE Golden Visa?
    • Are there any restrictions on Golden Visa holders regarding travel outside the UAE?
    • How can I apply for the UAE Golden Visa?
    • Can I apply for permanent residency or citizenship through the UAE Golden Visa program?
    • Are there any specific industries or sectors targeted by the UAE Golden Visa program?
    • Can Golden Visa holders sponsor their family members for residency in the UAE?
    • Can I convert an existing UAE visa to a Golden Visa?
    • Are there any age restrictions for applicants of the UAE Golden Visa?
    • How can I renew my UAE Golden Visa once it expires?
  • FAQs
    • What is the UAE Golden Visa program?
    • Who is eligible for the UAE Golden Visa?
    • How long is the UAE Golden Visa valid?
    • What are the benefits of the UAE Golden Visa?
    • Can family members be sponsored under the Golden Visa?

The UAE Golden Visa program is extremely interesting for any entrepreneur and investor from around the world. This initiative provides several UAE Golden Visa benefits for those who wish to settle or invest in the country. From the possibility of residing for up to 10 years in the country to the exemption from the need for a local sponsor. In other words, the purpose of the Golden Visa is to open doors and unlock opportunities for those who want to apply.

In this article, we will explore in detail the five key benefits of the Golden Visa in the UAE. From the freedom to work, live, and study in the country to maximum business ownership. In addition to being able to enjoy the ease of traveling with a multiple entry permit. In short, we will discover how this visa can transform the lives of investors and entrepreneurs. Keep reading to discover the UAE golden visa benefits.

Long-Term Residency

Among the UAE Golden visa benefits is that it offers up to 10 years of residence. In this way, it is a substantial upgrade from regular visas. Additionally, it provides a solid foundation for professional and personal development.

This extended period is advantageous for those who wish to deepen their roots in the UAE. Therefore, obtaining a Golden UAE visa allows you comprehensive professional development and great opportunities for business growth.

This long-term visa allows individuals and their families to integrate into the culture and community in the UAE. Furthermore, this fosters a greater sense of belonging and a better understanding of local traditions and customs.

Business Opportunities

Provides unparalleled access to employment and business opportunities. For this reason, among the advantages of Golden Visa UAE, this one stands out greatly. In addition, the UAE is recognized thanks to its high-level infrastructure and services.

It can also include a cutting-edge technological ecosystem, a modern transportation network, and state-of-the-art medical facilities. In this way, these characteristics collectively create a very favorable environment for professionals and companies to prosper.

Added to this is the ease of doing business, combined with a strategic location, making the UAE a magnet for foreign entrepreneurs and professionals.

Thanks to this access, the doors are now open to infinite possibilities for professional and business growth. Furthermore, all this is in an environment that is globally competitive and innovative, making this one of the great Golden Visa UAE benefits.

Access to Quality Education

Another of the benefits of Golden Visa UAE is access to quality education for families with children. Specifically, it includes a series of discounts on higher education. In this way, it makes it more financially viable for families to afford study opportunities at the highest level.

In this way, thanks to the Golden visa benefits, international universities can now establish their branches in the country. As a result, students can delve into various fields of study and obtain qualifications recognized around the world.

This educational incentive is a clear testament to the UAE’s commitment to fostering excellence. Additionally, it provides families with all the resources necessary for the academic success and growth of their children.

Healthcare Benefits

A UAE Golden visa provides families with access to an exceptional healthcare system. This aspect is fundamental to the country’s high quality of life.

Additionally, this access includes state-of-the-art healthcare facilities that are equipped with the latest technology. Also, they are cared for by world-class medical professionals.

The availability of this highly advanced medical care offers residents a wide range of treatment options. Additionally, a feeling of security and peace of mind regarding your well-being and health.

In this way, this medical care is not the only good thing since you can find other advantages of a UAE Golden visa. Among these are world-class leisure and entertainment options in a living environment that is completely safe.

Financial Opportunities

The Golden visa opens up a large number of investment opportunities. This is especially true for entrepreneurs seeking access to business-friendly policies, finance, banking, etc.

Additionally, investors in certain industries are granted full ownership of their companies through this visa program. In this way, it becomes a great offer for foreign investors.

As part of the Golden Visa UAE advantages, there are tax advantages. Therefore, new foreign companies that want to start business in the UAE will be able to enjoy these benefits.

Foreign entrepreneurs doing business in the UAE can enjoy reduced tax obligations, especially if they are operating in a free zone.

These free zones have special tax and customs regulations. In this way, foreign investors will face a lower tax burden.

Lifestyle and Culture

The UAE is home to a large number of foreign professionals and family members. Added to this, there are international educational institutions with exceptional education.

For this reason, a multicultural and inclusive learning environment is cultivated in the UAE. In this way, you will be able to learn about a large number of cultures apart from that of the UAE, greatly changing your lifestyle.

Real Estate Investment

One of the Golden visa benefits is the exclusive right to own UAE properties, a privilege that greatly distinguishes them in the real estate market.

Furthermore, this benefit will be reinforced by reduced fixed mortgage interest rates. Therefore, much more affordable financing options are generated and facilitate the expansion of property portfolios.

The UAE is known for its very dynamic business and tourism sectors worldwide. Additionally, they have a high-demand real estate market, making this a very attractive opportunity.

Here are some frequently asked questions (FAQs) about the UAE Golden Visa program

What is the UAE Golden Visa program?

A Golden visa is a long-term residence permit that offers benefits to foreign talents. In this way, they are allowed to live, work, or study in the UAE. Therefore, meeting the requirements to obtain a Golden visa is an important first step.

Eligible individuals include investors, scientists, entrepreneurs, humanitarian pioneers, outstanding students, and frontline heroes. In addition, among the types of UAE Golden visas are:

  • 5-year green residence visa: This is aimed at highly qualified professionals, investors, entrepreneurs, and the self-employed. Additionally, 3 executives and family can be added.
  • 10-year Golden visa: A family, domestic support staff, an advisor, a CEO, and executive partners contributing AED 2 million can be added to this visa.

What are the benefits of the UAE Golden Visa for investors and entrepreneurs?

The UAE Golden visa opens the door to a wide variety of investment opportunities, especially for all those entrepreneurs who want to take advantage of the favorable business policies of the UAE.

In certain industries, you may even have full ownership of your company. For this reason, it is one of the most attractive places for foreigners looking to invest.

What are the benefits of the UAE Golden Visa for skilled professionals and academics?

Among the benefits that you can enjoy if you are the holder of a Golden visa are:

  • Expanded residence rights.
  • Ability to sponsor your family members and unlimited household helpers.
  • Self-financed work or stay.
  • Extended time outside the UAE.
  • Exclusive healthcare packages.
  • Dubai Police Esaad Privilege Card.

How many countries can travel with UAE Golden Visa?

It is always important to know certain details about the Golden visa. Among these are the new visa rules or the countries you can travel to without needing a visa. Therefore, the countries you can travel to are:

Asia:

  • Maldives.
  • Armenia.
  • Kyrgyzstan.
  • Azerbaijan.
  • Nepal.
  • Sri Lanka.
  • Japan.
  • Singapore.
  • Thailand.
  • Malaysia.

Europe:

  • Georgia.
  • Montenegro.
  • Serbia.

Africa:

  • Seychelles.
  • Mauricio.

There are a total of 15 countries that you can travel to without a visa if you have a UAE Golden Visa. Additionally, this list is always subject to change according to each government’s policy.

Access to these countries must also be taken into account. Therefore, you should be aware of any changes if you want to travel to one of these countries or another outside the list.

What are the discounts for Golden Visa holders in UAE?

One of the UAE golden visa benefits is the Esaad Privilege Card, which is provided free of charge to some select categories of Golden Visa holders in Dubai.

Thanks to this exclusive card you will have access to various benefits and discounts. Specifically in automobiles, property, hospitality, healthcare, health insurance, and banking services. As a result, the UAE golden visa benefits are higher.

It can be said that the Esaad Privilege card improves the overall value of the Golden Visa in the UAE. Especially by adding a layer of financial and lifestyle advantages that are hard to overlook.

What is the salary for Golden Visa in UAE?

The first thing you need to know is that the Dubai Golden Visa aims to attract and retain exceptionally talented professionals, executives, and investors. Specifically, those who want to obtain a long-term residence in the UAE.

Any holder of this long-stay permit can enjoy the UAE golden visa benefits. That is, travel, study, work, and even sponsor family members without problems.

The Golden Visa system has further boosted the UAE’s position as one of the most advanced centers in the world. Specifically, for global businesses and lifestyles, attracting people from all over the world to the UAE.

A Golden Visa offers long-term residency for 10 years to people earning more than AED 30,000 per month. The other option is through AED 2 million or more. You can even own an off-plan property valued at AED 2 million or more.

Who is eligible to apply for the UAE Golden Visa?

  • Scientists and doctors: Require approval from the Ministry of Health and Prevention of the United Arab Emirates. In addition, a letter of recommendation from the relevant scientific councils is necessary.
  • Inventors: They need a letter of recommendation from the Ministry of Economy. Especially, the one that validates the patent and adds value to the economy of the UAE.
  • Creative people in arts and culture: Require a letter of approval from the Department of Arts and Culture of the UAE.
  • CEOs: Valid university degree and at least five years of experience in the same position and a minimum salary of AED 50,000.
  • Athletes: A recommendation from the General Sports Authority of the UAE or sports councils.
  • Science and engineering specialist: Relevant qualification and employment contract.
  • Outstanding Students: Those high school students with the best grades and college students. Also, having a high GPA from popular institutions.
  • Public investment investors: Deposit AED 2 million in an accredited investment fund in the UAE. Additionally, you can own a business with at least AED 2 million in capital or pay a minimum of AED 250,000 per year in taxes.
  • Real estate investors: They have to own property in the UAE worth at least AED 2 million or purchase property through a loan from local banks.
  • Entrepreneurs: Possess an innovative economic project worth at least AED 500,000. In addition, it has the support of an auditor from the UAE, the relevant authorities of the emirate, and a business incubator accredited in the country.

How long is the validity of the UAE Golden Visa?

Currently, thanks to the government of the UAE, the validity of all categories of the Golden Visa increases from 5 to 10 years. As a result, it is an even more attractive option for those who want to work and live in the UAE.

Additionally, Golden Visa holders can enjoy a multiple-entry visa for a period of 6 months. Thus, you can complete the Golden Visa procedures.

You are also allowed to stay outside the UAE for longer than 6 months. Therefore, foreigners have 6 months to modify their status and obtain another residence visa or leave the country.

The grace period after visa cancellation or expiration is longer than 30 days to 6 months for Golden visa holders and their family members. Therefore, foreigners now have a period of 6 months to modify their status and obtain another residence or leave the country, if necessary.

Finally, you have to know that fines do not apply during the grace period. However, if the Golden visa holder does not cancel or renew the visa of his or her dependents, the dependents may be required to pay an overstay fine.

Are there any financial requirements or investment thresholds for the UAE Golden Visa?

Yes, for investors who want the Golden Visa in the UAE, a financial threshold generally includes a minimum investment in real estate. This investment has to be valued at AED 2 million or its equivalent in other eligible investments.

Are there any restrictions on Golden Visa holders regarding travel outside the UAE?

Holders of a Golden Visa and some other categories can enjoy the privilege of staying outside the UAE. Specifically, for a period of more than six months without affecting your residence permit status.

How can I apply for the UAE Golden Visa?

Currently, there are two equally practical and good ways to apply for this long-stay permit and therefore, enjoy the UAE golden visa benefits, we describe them below.

Application through the ICA

If you want to apply for a Golden visa, you can do so through the ICP smart services online platform. The process is very simple, you just have to present the necessary documents and be willing to move to the United Arab Emirates.

Application through GDRFA

Eligible applicants can apply for the Golden Visa through the GDRFA website through the following steps:

  • Go to the GDRFA Dubai website.
  • Select the Golden Visa service you want and are eligible for.
  • Fill out the form to apply for the Golden visa in the UAE.
  • Attach the essential documents and pay the fees.
  • Submit the Golden Visa application in the country.

On the other hand, those eligible have to apply for the Golden Visa through the GDRFA Dubai Smart App, using the steps given below:

  • Download the GDRFA-Dubai app (Android, iOS).
  • If you want to make the request and do not have an account, you must register a new user account.
  • Subsequently, you have to select the service you want.
  • Attach the documents for the Golden Visa and pay the corresponding fees.
  • Finally, you have to submit the application for a Golden Visa.

It is important to know that eligible candidates can also apply for the Golden Visa in person through the AMER Center.

Can I apply for permanent residency or citizenship through the UAE Golden Visa program?

Initially, you have to know that a Golden Visa gives you automatic access with a residence permit. However, there is a longer path to obtaining a UAE passport. That is why the answer is yes, a Golden Visa can eventually lead to citizenship, but to do so you have to live in the country for a few years beforehand.

Are there any specific industries or sectors targeted by the UAE Golden Visa program?

Yes, the Golden Visa program is especially for the investment industry. The truth is that it is aimed at a wide range of investors segmented into four main categories:

  • Partner/Investor: Especially those with participation in companies in the UAE.
  • Deposit Investor: It is for people with significant bank deposits in the UAE.
  • Real Estate Investor: It is special for people who want to invest in the Dubai real estate market.
  • Tax Collection Investor: Aimed at people who want to make substantial tax contributions in the UAE.

Can Golden Visa holders sponsor their family members for residency in the UAE?

One of the best UAE golden visa benefits is the possibility that people can sponsor their family members, regardless of the age of the dependents. Children and spouses are eligible for sponsorship, so families can stay together.

Additionally, they have the option to enjoy the UAE golden visa benefits. Even, in the unfortunate event that the main visa holder dies, family members can remain in the UAE. All this under the Golden Visa with a limit until the natural conclusion of the visa term, providing a feeling of continuity and security.

Can I convert an existing UAE visa to a Golden Visa?

If you can, you have to submit the necessary documents correctly, after that you have to wait for approval. In this case, initial approval will take at least 48 hours.

It is important to note that you will have to cancel your current visa. In addition to performing a complete medical evaluation again. After completing these steps, you will have your new Golden visa within three to five business days. Thus, you can enjoy all the UAE golden visa benefits that you saw previously.

Are there any age restrictions for applicants of the UAE Golden Visa?

Currently, there is no age restriction to apply for a UAE Golden visa. That is, an applicant can apply for any category of the Golden Visa as long as they know and meet the necessary eligibility criteria.

How can I renew my UAE Golden Visa once it expires?

If you want to renew your Golden Visa in the UAE, initially, you have to submit a renewal application before the expiration date. That is, you will have to provide updated documents, such as copies of your visa and passport. Of all the documents, the most important is proof of continued eligibility for the Golden Visa category.

Finally, you have to keep in mind that renewal may also require an updated health insurance policy and a medical fitness test.

FAQs

What is the UAE Golden Visa program?

The Golden Visa is a long-term residency program. Designed for investors, professionals, and exceptional talents.

Who is eligible for the UAE Golden Visa?

The categories, such as investors, entrepreneurs, skilled professionals, scientists, and outstanding students, may qualify.

How long is the UAE Golden Visa valid?

Golden Visas are issued for five or ten years with renewal options.

What are the benefits of the UAE Golden Visa?

Several benefits you’ll get after obtaining a Golden Visa for the UAE. It may include long-term residency, family sponsorship, and freedom to work or invest.

Can family members be sponsored under the Golden Visa?

Absolutely!

Holders can sponsor spouses, children, and dependents.

title: Guide to Entry Permits in the UAE: Everything You Need to Know
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle

  • Tourist Entry Permits: How to Visit the UAE for Leisure or Business
  • Student Entry Permits: Navigating Education Opportunities in the UAE
  • Investor Entry Permits: Facilitating Business Ventures in the UAE
