  • Entry Permit Renewal in the UAE: What You Need to Know
  • Entry Permit Fees in the UAE: Understanding the Costs
  • Entry Permit Processing Time: How Long Does It Take?
  • Common Entry Permit Errors and Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
  • Entry Permits and Emiratization: Impact on Employment in the UAE
  • Entry Permit Updates and Changes: Staying Informed in the UAE
  • How to Check Entry Permit Status?
  • FAQs
    • What is an entry permit in the UAE?
    • How long is an entry permit valid?
    • Can I convert an entry permit into a residence visa?
    • Who issues entry permits in the UAE?
    • What happens if an entry permit expires?

An entry permit is an important document for foreigners who want to travel to the UAE, either for tourism, work, or residence matters. Therefore, it is important to understand how to apply for it depending on your particular case.

In this article, you are going to learn all the basics about applying for an entry permit for the UAE. Moreover, you will learn what is entry permit in uae and how to check it once you have applied.

Understanding Entry Permits: A Guide for Expatriates Moving to the UAE

Whether you are deciding to start a business in Dubai as a foreigner or you are looking for work in the UAE, the primary requirement for travelling to the Emirates is obtaining an entry permit.

If you are an expatriate looking to move to the UAE, You have to carry out the process for obtaining an entry permit.

Most commonly, it is issued to those individuals who want to apply for a residence visa. This is because with this document you are able to enter the UAE and stay for a specific period to finalize your procedures for the residency.

In other cases such as visiting for tourism, attending an event, or just passing by the UAE to travel to somewhere else you will have to get an entry permit too.

The following are the characteristics of this important document for foreigners:

  • It has a varied validity depending on the purpose of the entrance.
  • Some types of visas are also referred to as entry permits Since they grant permission to enter the Emirates for a short time.
  • If the person who wants to enter the UAE needs sponsorship, the sponsor will be in charge of handling all the transactions of the permit.

Types of Entry Permits in the UAE: Exploring the Options

One of the advantages of the UAE is that it offers several options for entry permits. So, depending if you are planning to start freelancing in Dubai or looking for a long-term residency, you have to know how to apply for an entry permit.

The following are the different types of permits for entrance in the UAE:

  • Permit for the issuance of a work visa.
  • Permits for medical treatments in the UAE.
  • Transit visas are also known as permits for entrance.
  • Tourist permits are issued for those who want to enter the UAE for tourism purposes and for that reason are known as entry permits too. Thus there are different types such as a multi-entry or a single-entry tourist visa.
  • Entry permits for visit visas: To explore job opportunities, to explore business opportunities, for visiting a relative, and for studying, training, or rehabilitation.
  • Entry permits for the issuance of a residence visa.

Step-by-Step Guide to Obtaining an Entry Permit for the UAE

The process for applying for this document in the UAE will vary depending on the type of permit you will need. Nonetheless, the UAE authorities have streamlined the process so individuals can carry out online.

Therefore you can obtain your permit by following the next steps:

  1. Visit the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP) official website.
  2. On the “Services” tab, find “Services for individuals” and click it.
  3. Scroll until you find the service for “Issuing entry permits” and click on “info”.
  4. Once you are taken to the next page you can click on start service to start your application.
  5. If you are already registered in the ICP platform you can access using your credentials or UAE pass. If this is your first time on the ICP platform, then you have to register.
  6. Fill in the application form providing valid and trustworthy details to ensure it gets approved.
  7. Pay the required fees and wait for approval.
  8. If your application gets approved you will receive notification of entry issuance.

Work Entry Permits in the UAE: Requirements and Application Process

Foreigners who have secured a job contract in the UAE need to obtain a work entry permit to continue with the hiring procedures. Thus, the employer should be in charge of applying for this document through the GDRFA or ICP website.

This document will be valid for 60 days from the date of entry and during this time, the employee has to finalize all the formalities to start the job.

The following are the requirements:

  • Passport with a validity of at least 6 months from the date of application.
  • Health insurance
  • Employment contract
  • Personal photo

In the case of a permit for work but for green residency, it is a self-sponsored document, and the individual has to submit additionally a MOHRE Certificate proving he or she is a skilled worker or self-employed.

The process to apply is the following:

  1. Enter the ICP website
  2. Look for “Services” on the menu and search for “Issuing entry permits”.
  3. Click on “Start Service” and access using your personal information.
  4. Fill in the required data by ensuring there are no errors.
  5. Pay the fees and wait the processing time, which could be no less than 48 hours.

Keep in mind you can check entry permit status once you have submitted your application.

Once you get your entry permit, you can travel to the UAE and continue with the formalities. For instance, you have to pass the medical test and obtain your Emirates ID.

Family Entry Permits: Bringing Loved Ones to the UAE

To obtain an entry permit for your relative to visit you in the UAE, you have to gather the following documentation:

  • Evidence of kinship
  • The reason behind the visit
  • Copy of residence permit
  • Passport copy
  • Health insurance
  • Flight ticket
  • Financial guarantee of 1000 AED for a single trip and AED 2000 for several trips.

Once your loved one enters the Emirates, you can continue with the procedure for applying for their residency if you would like. If your relative wants to come back to their country, then the permit may be valid for 30, 60 or 90 days.

Moreover, you can apply for this permit through the ICP, GDRFA or a Customer Happiness Center.

Tourist Entry Permits: How to Visit the UAE for Leisure or Business

In case you are planning to apply for a 5-year multiple-entry tourist visa or a short-term tourist visa, you must know if you need an entry permit first.

Some countries are exempted from obtaining a permit to enter the UAE and they can stay in the Emirates for a specific period. However, if you plan to stay longer, you may have to apply for a visa.

The good news is that in the UAE there are many types of tourist entry permits, so you can choose the one that suits your needs. Some of them are the following:

  • Single visit entry visa: the individual must have a sponsor or host and it is valid for 30 or 60 days.
  • Multi-entry tourist visa: the individual can enter the UAE multiple times and this permit is valid for 30 or 60 days.
  • Multi-entry tourist permit (long-term): this permit is valid for 5 years and the holder can enter the UAE multiple times during its validity.

Student Entry Permits: Navigating Education Opportunities in the UAE

If you are planning to study in the UAE, you have to apply for a permit first. Also known as a student visa, you can reside in the Emirates under the sponsorship of your parents or an accredited educational institution.

This document will be valid for a year, and you can renew it for the same period. The following are the key requirements:

  • Certificate issued by the educational institution specifying the duration of the study.
  • Colour photo (recent)
  • Passport copy complying with the minimum validity requirements
  • Medical fit certificate
  • Medical Insurance
  • Emirates ID application

Investor Entry Permits: Facilitating Business Ventures in the UAE

As an investor, you have many options for applying for an entry permit. You could apply for the following:

  • Visit visa to explore business opportunities that can be valid for 60, 90 or 120 days with a single entry option. This can be a great solution for testing the market and deciding if your business may thrive in the UAE.
  • Residence visa for investors: most commonly known as a Green Visa, you can obtain a long-term residency by providing proof of investment and start living in the UAE.

Golden Visa Entry Permits: A Pathway to Residency in the UAE

The UAE Golden Visa is a long-term residency to which a selected group of individuals may apply. It is a highly sought-after entry permit in uae as it grants many benefits to the holder.

With this permit, the holder can stay for 5 or 10 years in the UAE, and renew it as long as they continue complying with the requirements.

The UAE entry permit for this visa is valid for 6 months, and the person can enter multiple times to the UAE to continue with the procedures to obtain residency.

The following are the individuals who can apply for this permit:

  • Investors of investment funds
  • Real estate owners or investors
  • Entrepreneur with a technical project based on innovation
  • Outstanding talented individuals such as doctors, athletes, scientists, inventors, etc.
  • Outstanding students

It is worth noting that as a UAE Golden Visa holder you can apply for a Dubai driving license.

Entry Permit Renewal in the UAE: What You Need to Know

Renewing your permit is a pretty simple process. However, this is known as an extension, and if you plan to stay for a long term then it is better to apply for a residency visa while you are in the UAE.

The extension depends on the type of permit you have, as well as the number of times you can extend it. Therefore, you need to consider the following:

  • Permit for tourism: the extension period is 30 days and you can extend it only twice.
  • Permit for visit (regardless of the reason): you can apply for a 30-day extension twice.
  • Entry permit for treatment: it can be extended for 90 days.
  • Extension of entry permit for student: 90-day extension

Keep in mind that the ideal is to finalize your procedures for residency during the validity of the permit. This way you avoid having to renew it.

Entry Permit Fees in the UAE: Understanding the Costs

To apply for an entry permit for UAE residents, you have to take into consideration the costs. This is because this way you are able to plan the budget you will need for travelling to the UAE.

Although there are different types of entry permits the application fees are very similar for all of them.

Some of the expenses you will incur when carrying out your application are the following:

  • Application fee through the service channel or typing centre: 100 AED.
  • Issuance fee: 100 AED for a single trip per month and 200 AED for several trips per month. For the multi-entry long-term tourist visa, the issuance fee is AED 500.
  • Electronic services: If you carry your application online you will have to pay 150 AED.
  • In the case of a visit permit, you need 1000 AED for a financial guarantee if you are making one trip. If you are making several trips you will need 2000 AED.

It is worth noting that in the case of issuance of residency without work, the individual will only have to pay the application fee, insurance fees, and electronic service fee.

Entry Permit Processing Time: How Long Does It Take?

The processing time for an entry permit in the UAE is fast since the procedure is pretty straightforward. Typically it may take at least 48 hours.

So two days after you have submitted your application you can wait for the notification to obtain your permit.

However, in some cases, it may take longer. This is because sometimes there might be too many applications and you will have to wait. Nonetheless, it is very quick and you will likely have to wait less than seven days.

Common Entry Permit Errors and Mistakes and How to Avoid Them

If you want to enter the UAE you have to apply for an entry permit. Since it is a crucial document for you, it is essential to know how to apply to ensure it gets approved.

Therefore, make sure to follow the next recommendations:

  • Be very attentive to detail when filling out the application form. Many people get rejected due to an incorrect or incomplete application. Thus make sure to read all the questions. And provide valid answers that are truthful and accurate.
  • Gather the required documentation in advance to ensure there are no missing documents in your application.
  • Check carefully all the requirements for your specific situation.
  • Do not apply too late for the entry visa. If you need to travel, make sure to submit your application with enough time in advance. Otherwise, your application can result in rejection. And you may miss your trip.
  • Make sure your passport complies with the validity requirements. Otherwise, your application can be rejected.

Entry Permits and Emiratization: Impact on Employment in the UAE

The goal of the Emiratisation laws is to increase the contribution of UAE Nationals to the national economy by being part of the UAE workforce. However, this may impact the employment of foreign individuals.

As such, employers have to ensure they do the following:

  • Make sure you have a well-versed team in local policies to comply with the Emiratisation law.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest changes in Emiratisation for the private sector.
  • Encourage the hiring of a diverse workforce, including UAE Nationals.
  • In case you have to hire a foreign individual, make sure to follow all the requirements established by MOHRE.

Entry Permit Updates and Changes: Staying Informed in the UAE

Just as there are new visa rules in 2024 due to modifications in current regulations, there may also be changes when it comes to entry permits.

The following are some of the updates the UAE has made to these permits:

  • The UAE has announced the launch of 10 different entry pieces that do not require to have a host or sponsor. Therefore, they have flexible durations and applicants can choose between single or multiple entries. These are valid for 60 days and they can be renewed for the same period.
  • The UAE also announced an update on their policy for Visa-on-arrival. Currently, individuals from 87 countries can enter the UAE without having a pre-entry visa.
  • Individuals can now sponsor their male children up to the age of 25 For an entry family Visa.

How to Check Entry Permit Status?

Once you have applied for your entry permit, you have to wait for the processing time to obtain it. Although generally, it is very quick to get your document. In some cases, it may take longer.

For this reason, you may want to do the UAE entry permit status check.This way, you can see if your permit is still pending if it has been rejected, or if it is approved.

There are 2 different methods to check your permit. If you have applied through the GDRFA website, because you are planning to travel to Dubai, you can check it on that website. On the other hand, if you plan to travel to any of the other Emirates, you can check it through the ICP smart services.

How to check entry permit status through the GDRFA:

  1. Enter the GDRFA official site.
  2. Scroll down until you find an icon that says “Visa Status” and click on it.
  3. Provide the required information.

The following are the steps to check the permit through the ICP website:

  1. Visit the ICP Smart Service official website
  2. Scroll down until you find a tab called “E-channel services”.
  3. By clicking on it, it will redirect you to another page.
  4. Click on “Public Services”.
  5. Once on that page, you have to click on the “Application tracking” button located at the top right side of the screen.
  6. After that, you have to enter your Request Number and click on “Search”.

Knowing how to process all the documentation you need to start your business in the UAE may be challenging. For this reason, it is advisable to partner with a team of experts like Connect Zone who know how to guide you.

In addition, we have everything you need for your company formation to ensure a smooth incorporation. Contact us now to let us know your needs and help you establish a solid business in the UAE.

FAQs

What is an entry permit in the UAE?

UAE entry permit allows a foreign national to enter the country for residence visa processing or short-term purposes.

How long is an entry permit valid?

Most entry permits are valid for 60 days from the date of issue.

Can I convert an entry permit into a residence visa?

Conversion happens after medical tests, Emirates ID registration, and visa stamping.

Who issues entry permits in the UAE?

ICP or GDRFA mainly issues entry permits. It depends on the emirate.

What happens if an entry permit expires?

You must exit the UAE or reapply for your permit. So that you can avoid fines and immigration penalties.

title: Latest Amendments: New Labour Law for Limited Contracts in the UAE
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle

  • Rights and Protections for Employees: Analysis of Benefits and Entitlements

  • Legal Insights and Considerations: Understanding the Legal Framework
  • Challenges and Opportunities: Adapting to the Evolving Regulatory Landscape
  • FAQs related to the latest amendments to the labour law for limited contracts in the UAE
    • What is the new labour law for limited contracts in the UAE?
    • How long can a limited contract be valid?
    • What are the termination rules under the new law?
    • Are notice periods mandatory for limited contracts?
    • How does the new law impact employers and employees?
    • What penalties apply for non compliance?

Understanding the new labour law for limited contract in UAE is a must if you want to have a compliant business. Before hiring new employees, it is necessary to learn about the employment rules regarding contracts.

In this article, you are going to learn more about the new labour law for limited contract in UAE. Moreover, you will understand all the implications for employers and how you can navigate the impact of this new rule as a business.

Key Changes Explained: Understanding the New Amendments

Regardless if you plan to hire temporary workers or permanent workers, you must provide them with a valid contract. According to the previous UAE labour law, there were two types of contracts. Thus there were the limited term and unlimited term contracts.

However, with the new labour law issued in February 2022, there were new provisions regarding contracts. That led to the new labour law for limited contract in UAE.

The following are the key changes these new regulations include:

  • All the unlimited-term contracts have to be converted to limited-term contracts. The deadline for converting unlimited-term contracts to limited-term contracts was 31st December 2023.
  • Employers who want to issue a new contract for a new hire must offer limited-term contracts only.
  • The limited-term contracts may have a validity of two to three years.

Implications for Employers: Navigating the Impact of the New Labour Law

Starting a business in the UAE as a foreigner comes with a varied set of challenges. As an employer, you have to be aware of all the local employment regulations so you can stay in compliance.

Nonetheless, the UAE is popular for being a place that is constantly changing and updating its regulations to adapt to the evolving market. Therefore, you should have a team of experts in your HR department who can always check the new revisions and rules regarding employment.

Since limited or fixed-term contracts are now the rule it is important to understand what they are and how they can impact your business. So, what is limited contract in UAE? Also known as a fixed-term contract this written employment agreement terminates automatically or it can be renewed at the end date established.

The following are the implications of this new rule for employers:

  • The new labour law for limited contract in UAE is a key benefit for employers. This is because it offers potential security for the business. For instance, if you hire an employee who does not give his best performance under an unlimited term contract it will be harder to dismiss him. However, with a limited-term contract, the employee with poor performance will live once it expires.
  • A fixed-term contract can be a great tool for attracting new employees particularly those that come from abroad.
  • It offers an opportunity to hire employees at constant intervals and update contracts based on the role and developments.
  • It provides the opportunity to engage employees for a particular project or a task of a specific duration.

Employee Perspectives: Assessing the Effects on Limited Contract Workers

The new labour law for limited contract in UAE also affects employees. Given that the contract has a starting and ending date specified, the employee can know for how long they will be working for the company.

Since the contract is time-limited it is important to make the distinction between a fixed-term one and a temporary one. In a temporary contract, the goal of employment does not pretend to be permanent, but just for a short term. Whereas in a fixed-term contract, the employee can be rehired by the company and thus become a permanent employee.

Just like it happens with employers, this type of contract has its risks and rewards for employees too. The following are some of the effects it has on employees:

  • For some employees, this type of contract may offer more flexibility. This is because they have an end date and thus, they are able to have more control over their schedule. So, they can make the decisions that they will take regarding their careers with enough time.
  • In a limited-term contract, the employee has no long-term commitment. For instance, the employee may deliver their best performance during the work term and decide to try something new after the contract ends to explore different roles. Thus, it is a good type of work arrangement for those who want to look for a job that best suits their skills and interests.
  • One of the risks of this type of contract is that employees may decide to terminate the employment relationship but they may lose their end-of-service gratuity, or in some cases, may face penalties.

Keep in mind that if you do not comply with what the contract establishes, your employee may file a complaint regarding labour issues and your company could get affected.

Termination and Renewal Procedures: Guidelines Under the New Regulations

Deciphering written employment agreements like contracts can be complex. One of the most difficult aspects of contracts in the UAE is understanding the termination procedures.

Since the contract has an end date once said date is approaching, both parties have to determine what they will do. Thus, there are only two options: renew it or terminate it.

If both parties decide to renew the contract it is easier. This is because they just have to reach the agreement and sign the new contract. However, when it comes to termination, there are different rules to follow.

So, what is the benefits of limited contract in UAE? The main advantage is that there are several rules for termination that have the goal to protect both the employer and the employee.

The following are the cases in which limited-term contracts can be terminated:

  • Both parties submit a written agreement before its termination.
  • The employment contract can be terminated once the end date specified in the contract approaches and neither the employer nor the employee decides to renew it or extend it.
  • Either party may wish to terminate the employment contract as long as they follow the provisions in the law and comply with the notice period established in the contract.
  • Some other cases where the contract may be terminated are in the case of the employer’s death, the employee’s death, a final judgment, if the establishment closes permanently or if the employer goes bankrupt.

Rights and Protections for Employees: Analysis of Benefits and Entitlements

According to the UAE labour law employees have the following rights and protections regarding their contracts:

  • If the employer wants to terminate the employment contract they have to comply with the notice period established in the contract. Therefore the employee has to be notified at least 30 days in advance and no more than 90 days.
  • The employee has the right to receive their full wage during the notice period and until the expiration of such period.
  • If the employer does not comply with the notice period they should pay compensation to the employee. Thus this compensation is the notice period allowance.
  • Another great benefit employees have in the case of employment termination by the employer is that they have the right to be absent for one working day each week during the notice period. This is with the aim to start the search for another job. However, the employee has to notify the employer the date that they will not show up at work with at least three days in advance.
  • In some cases, the employee can resign without notice while retaining their rights. Some of these cases may be when there is a breach of the employer’s obligations towards the employee. Or when it was determined that the employer assaulted the employee, for instance.

Employer Compliance Requirements: Ensuring Adherence to the New Regulations

As an employer, you need to ensure you comply with the labour law for limited contract in UAE. Some of the key considerations you can take to ensure compliance are the following:

  • Ensure to have legal specialists in your HR team who know how to draft compliant employment contracts.
  • Make sure every detail about employment is included in the contract. Thus include the notice period and any other detail that is crucial for compliance.
  • Provide a safe workplace where the employees’ safety and health are not in danger. This is to minimize the risk of having employees resign without notice.

Legal Insights and Considerations: Understanding the Legal Framework

When it comes to the new labour law for limited contract in UAE, it is important to understand the legal framework that surrounds it.

As such keep in mind the following:

  • Resignation during probation period: Either party may terminate the employment relationship during the probation period. However it is necessary to comply with the 14-day notice period.
  • Resignation during the employment term: Either party can terminate the employment relationship at any moment. However, they should comply with the notice period established in the contract.
  • Gratuity pay: Employees may receive their end-of-service benefit as long as they have more than one year of service. Thus the amount paid will be based on the years the employee has worked for the company.
  • Resignation without notice: If any of the parties decide to terminate the contract without notice they should pay the notice period allowance to the other party.

It is worth noting that a valid employment contract is a requirement for obtaining a work permit and applying for a UAE residence visa for your employee.

Challenges and Opportunities: Adapting to the Evolving Regulatory Landscape

As with any other employment aspect in the UAE, it has its set of challenges and opportunities. It is important to comply with the evolving regulatory landscape to ensure ongoing operations.

Some of the challenges you may encounter are the following:

  • Not having a team that is well-versed in this type of contract: What is limited contract in UAE? What is the most suitable duration?
  • Depending on the industry where you work it might be harder to find people that want to work for a limited time.
  • In some cases, you may end up having to recruit more staff than you will need given the direction of the fixed-term contracts.

On the other hand, you may take advantage of the following opportunities:

  • Get total control on employment such as knowing how and when it will end.
  • It is a cost-effective option as you can hire employees for a determined term while having a limited budget.
  • You can test employees and decide if they are a good permanent fit for your company.

Whether you establish your company in Dubai Mainland or any other Emirate, you need to always keep up-to-date with the local regulatory landscape.

FAQs related to the latest amendments to the labour law for limited contracts in the UAE

What is the new labour law for limited contracts in the UAE?

It standardizes contract terms and employee rights.

How long can a limited contract be valid?

It is renewable for up to three years.

What are the termination rules under the new law?

Termination must follow notice and legal grounds.

Are notice periods mandatory for limited contracts?

Yes, notice periods are required.

How does the new law impact employers and employees?

It provides clarity and legal protection.

What penalties apply for non compliance?

Fines and legal actions may apply.

    • What are the documents required for a re-entry permit application?
    • How long is a re-entry permit valid for?
    • Can I extend the validity of my re-entry permit?
    • What happens if my re-entry permit expires while I’m outside the UAE?

Discover the latest re-entry permit news to the UAE, will help you resolve your doubts in this regard. Thanks to this permit, you will be able to enter the country if you have to spend more than 6 months outside of it for some relevant reasons. This way, you will not have to apply for a new visa and you will save time and money in the process.

In this article, we will show you what you need to know regarding this permission, including its importance. You will also know how to request it and we will answer some re-entry permit questions to clear up common doubts.

Importance of Re-Entry Permits

Knowing the re-entry permit news for UAE after the allowed period will help you know how you can enter the country. Therefore, below, we will show you what the updates are regarding this permission.

Significance for UAE Residents

Expatriates holding the majority of residence visas in the country cannot stay more than 6 months outside the country. For example, those who have a work permit are expected to remain in the country, even more so if they have dependents. Thus, if they are away for more than 6 months, this significant period calls their residency into question.

However, the exceptions to this rule are golden and investors visa holders in the country. The rules for this type of permit have not changed significantly in recent years, only during the pandemic period.

Scenarios Requiring Re-Entry Permits

The cases in which it is necessary to obtain a re-entry permit UAE are those in which the citizen remains outside the country for more than 6 months. However, residents must have a valid reason why they stayed out of the country longer than the allowed time. In addition, they must present proof of residence as one of the essential requirements to receive the permit.

However, there are no established guidelines that define the valid reasons for requesting said permission. However, some of them may be medical reasons, humanitarian reasons, or have to do with work. Additionally, there are exemptions whereby none of the qualified persons in certain categories require said permit, including:

  • Golden visa holders.
  • Students studying courses in foreign institutions.
  • Residents whose sponsors are diplomatic or consular representatives.
  • Domestic workers accompanying Emirati students studying abroad.
  • Domestic workers accompanying Emirati patients receiving medical treatment abroad.
  • The foreign wife of an Emirati citizen.
  • Domestic employees accompanying members of diplomatic and consular missions that represent the country abroad.
  • Residents who work in the public sector and were sent to attend a training or specialization course abroad.
  • Employee in the public sector who work in the offices abroad of their employer.
  • Any other person that the ICP decides to exclude.

Overview of Previous Re-Entry Permit Regulations

The re-entry permit news that was previously given in the country was due to the Covid-19 pandemic. These were due to the need to alleviate procedures to facilitate the entry of residents into the country during the contingency.

Summary of Previous Regulations

During 2020, the height of the pandemic, expatriates with expired visas were able to enter the country. In this way, the authorities recognized the existing challenges regarding travel restrictions and global closures at the time. However, starting in mid-2021, they began to gradually resume the old measures to resume residency.

Challenges or Limitations

During the period in which measures were relaxed due to the pandemic, the authorities did not reduce precautions. Therefore, although they allowed resident expatriates to enter the country, they had to update their documents. In addition, the authorities guaranteed pre-approval of entry, so they did not need to apply for an entry permit.

Recent News and Changes

The most current re-entry permit news are those that originated in 2022 and came into effect in 2023. From then on, the regulations remain the same, so the permit is mandatory in most cases.

Detailing the Latest News

Residents of the nation with more than 6 months abroad can resume their status through online services. This is due to new regulations by the Federal Authority for Identity and Nationality, Customs and Port Security (ICP). This would only be for people who can justify the period outside the country, which may be for work, studies, or medical treatment.

Nevertheless, golden visa holders do not need to apply for one of these permits as they can stay abroad longer than this time. For those who do require approval from the authorities, you must comply with the requirements and apply to the ICA.

Modifications to Regulations

  • Since the easing of regulations by the authorities, and after Covid 19, the request can be made in the online system.
  • Resident foreigners must now obtain approval to obtain a re-entry permit UAE.

Key Changes Explained

The changes to the regulations that took place starting in 2022 favor expatriates who have spent 6 months or more abroad. Below you can see a summary of the rules and requirements to obtain the permit.

Breakdown of Key Changes

The re-entry permit news indicates that the applicant must know and comply with the following requirements:

  • The request must be made on the official ICA website.
  • You must do it after 180 days outside the UAE.
  • The applicant must have a legitimate reason to justify the prolonged stay outside the country.
  • You will have to pay AED100 for every 30 or fewer days outside the UAE.

Impact on UAE Residents

The new regulations regarding this permit benefit foreigners who remain outside the country for more than the allowed time. However, the rule is only limited to reasons that authorities must consider valid for issuing the permit. In this case, the reasons may include personal emergency reasons, or to receive medical treatment.

In addition, the measure can be beneficial for the local economy, by retaining talent in the country due to this type of facility. This can also attract foreign investment, as the country seeks to diversify its economy and works on every aspect of it.

Application process Simplified

One of the re-entry permit questions is about the process to obtain it, which you can do online.

Streamlining of Application Process

Residents who have obtained their residence permit in Dubai must follow different guidelines than those of the other Emirates. To begin, you must seek the assistance of an agent in the country to apply at an Amer Center. On the other hand, if the applicant has a sponsored work visa, the employer must apply.

In the same way, if a person is the sponsor of the applicant, it is this person who must request the permit. Self-sponsored people can apply for a permit at public service facilities at personal expense.

For the other Emirates, you must apply for permission on the ICP website, that Is the autorize authority. In this case, applicants for the re-entry permit UAE must comply with the steps that we will detail below:

  1. Go to the Smart Services section on the ICP website
  2. Next, you will need to select Issue permission to stay outside the UAE for 6 months.
  3. Then click Start Service.
  4. Indicate your personal information, as well as that of your sponsor if you have them, and add information about your passport and residence.
  5. You must indicate the reason why you are spending more than 6 months outside the UAE.
  6. Finally, pay the application fees.

The authorities will process your request, and if they accept it, you will receive an email at the address provided in the request. After receiving the approval email, you will have 30 days to enter the country.

Tips for Navigating

According to the re-entry permit news, the authorities offer facilities to request said permit. The request must be made only through the channel established for this purpose, the official ICP website. You must go to the smart services on the same website since that is where you will find the service you must request.

Also, make sure you enter all the data correctly, which will avoid delays or rejection of the application. You must have access to the email you provide as you will receive approval there, otherwise, you will not be able to enter without confirmation.

Extended Validity Periods

The validity period of the permit has remained the same since the announcement of the return of the entry permit as a requirement. In this case, once you obtain approval from the authorities, you will have a specific period to return to the country.

Extensions or Adjustments to Validity Periods

Since the re-entry permit news announcing the return after the pandemic, the authorities established a maximum period to enter the UAE. This period is exactly 30 days, which means that you will not be able to enter the country after that time. Therefore, if you exceed this time, you will have to justify it if you want to apply for the permit a second time.

Benefits for UAE Residents

UAE residents who have been out of the country for more than 6 months will have the opportunity to re-enter with the permit. The 30-day period they offer after approval allows you to get everything to return in time before the approval expires. However, we recommend that you make the request when you no longer have pending matters so that you do not have complications when returning.

Implications for Residents

With the new requirement for a re-entry permit for the situations we have indicated, there are different perspectives to consider. The regulations have brought benefits that residents can take advantage of, always complying with regular procedures. Below we explore some of the effects that these rules brought:

Effects of Updated Regulations

Resident citizens can now travel outside the country for more than 6 months but with a valid reason. This means that, if the reasons for the absence are not justified according to the authorities, you may suffer serious consequences. Therefore, although the measures are beneficial, you must stay within the law to avoid problems.

Furthermore, it does not mean that the absence has no consequences, in addition to the leave, you will have to pay the fees for the excess period. Thus, although there are no legal consequences, you do have to consider the financial implications as the permit also has a cost. Therefore, residents should be cautious if they have an urgent need to travel abroad for an extended period.

Adapting to Changes

Resident foreigners can take advantage of this opportunity to address matters of interest that justify leaving the country. However, you should ask what is considered a reason that justifies extending your absence beyond 6 months. Additionally, residents should consider the financial consequences and be prepared to assume them.

Ensuring Compliance and Avoiding Pitfalls

Upon hearing the re-entry permit news, you already know the guidelines you must follow to meet the requirements. This way, you ensure safe processing and increase your chances of obtaining permission to continue your residence. Below, you will see some tips to comply with the regulations and avoid inconveniences when requesting re-entry.

Tips for Compliance

  • Find out about the legal reasons for being away longer than the 6 months allowed by government authorities.
  • Ensure you have your documentation (passport, residence visa, and Emirates ID) in order and up to date.
  • You must ensure that you have the financial resources necessary to pay the application fee and overstay fees.
  • Have everything ready before applying for the permit to avoid delays.
  • Collect evidence to show why you went over the allowed days.
  • Make sure you fill out the application correctly.

Common Pitfalls to Avoid

  • Not knowing current regulations can lead you to make compliance errors.
  • If you go over the allowed time and do not have a valid reason, you may be denied permission.
  • The ICP is the agency authorized to issue the permit, so you should avoid using third-party pages for the application.
  • Make the payment to the authorized agency (ICP), using the correct payment methods.
  • See whether or not you qualify for an entry permit exemption and avoid the unnecessary process.
  • Avoid sending personal information to unauthorized agencies for these procedures.

Resources and Additional Information

Apart from the re-entry permit news that we have informed you, You can consult the ICP website about other aspects. This way, you can be aware of changes or aspects related to your particular situation.

Official Government Resources

  • Smart services from the Federal Authority For Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)
  • General Directorate of Residence and Foreign Affairs (GDRFA) Website
  • ICP App
  • Dubai Now app

Contact Details for Clarification

For more re-entry permit news or other relevant information, you can contact us through the following means:

  • Website icp.gov.ae
  • Call center 600522222
  • Email contactus@icp.gov.ae

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is a UAE re-entry permit?

The re-entry permit UAE is a solution for foreign residents who stay more than 6 months outside the country. This way, if they approve the application, they can enter the country without applying for a new residence visa. However, the permit is only valid for 30 days, so you must enter before it expires.

Why do I need a re-entry permit?

This permit is necessary if you have spent more than the allowed time (6 months) outside the country if you are a resident. It is a requirement to facilitate re-entry into the country and maintain your residency in the UAE. Otherwise, you will have to apply for a residency visa again, which involves going through the process again and paying fees.

How do I apply for a re-entry permit?

To request one of these permits, you must enter the ICP website or through an authorized travel agency. In the first case, you must locate the smart services section and enter the Entry Permit section after 6 months. If your application is approved, you will receive an email authorizing entry into the country within 30 days.

What are the documents required for a re-entry permit application?

To request this permit, residents must submit the documents listed below:

  • Copy of the passport of the applicant
  • Copy of the residence visa of the applicant
  • Proof of the reason for the stay outside of what is permitted
  • Original Emirates ID of the applicant or sponsor
  • Copy of visa and passport of the sponsor (if applicable)
  • International Bank Account Number (IBAN) of the sponsor (if applicable)

How long is a re-entry permit valid for?

After approval of the permit, the applicant will have a maximum of 30 days to re-enter the country. Otherwise, you will have to apply for a new permit for consideration by the authorities.

Can I extend the validity of my re-entry permit?

As we have mentioned, the permit is valid for 30 days, which is not renewable. Therefore, since you will need it to enter, you must apply again to have 30 more days to enter.

What happens if my re-entry permit expires while I’m outside the UAE?

As we have reported in the re-entry permit news, you will have 30 days to enter once you receive the permit. If you are still abroad after those 30 days, you must apply again to the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security or ICP.

If you require more information regarding this and other similar topics, just contact us.

title: UAE Investor Visas: Requirements, Process, Cost and Benefits
content:

    • What is the minimum investment required for a UAE investor visa?
    • How long is the UAE investor visa valid?
    • Can an investor sponsor family members?
    • What are the benefits of an investor visa in the UAE?
    • How is an investor visa different from a Golden Visa?

To encourage foreign investment in various sectors, the authorities established the UAE investor visa. There are several possible options for people who want to apply and have the opportunity to take advantage of the commercial and social advantages of the country. Thanks to this visa, you can also obtain a visa for your family members to live in the country.

In this article, we will show you the different requirements for each of the investor visa types. You will also be able to learn about the process and financial requirements, as well as the benefits of getting one of them.

What is a UAE investor visa?

The authorities created the UAE investor visa for foreigners who invest or create a business in the country. However, applicants must meet the specific requirements for each type of investor visa. Additionally, this visa allows holders to sponsor their family members so that they can live in the peace of mind of the UAE.

Apart from the necessary documentation according to the classification, you must meet financial criteria to establish a business, invest in one, or the real estate market. There is even a visa for citizens over 55 years of age to retire in the UAE.

UAE Investor Visa Requirements

One of the UAE investor visa requirements is that the applicant must be over 18 years of age. Therefore, this further broadens the eligibility criteria for those who wish to enter the business market. Next, we will show you the specific requirements to be able to apply for an investor visa when establishing or investing in a company.

Minimum investment Thresholds

Regarding the minimum investment requirements to obtain the visa, you must meet one of the following aspects:

  • You can invest in one or more properties totaling AED 1 million or more. However, you must be the sole owner of the property and have a maximum mortgage value of 50%.
  • If more than one person is investing, each person must contribute at least AED 1 million.

In both cases, the properties must be residential and not commercial, and off-plan properties are not eligible.

Business Ownership

To obtain a UAE investor visa, applicants must meet one of the following conditions:

  • They must start a business in the UAE or have a stake in a business with a minimum capital of AED 72000.

The benefits in the case of establishing a company in a free zone are having full ownership and freedom from taxes. Similarly, when investing or establishing the business, you can apply for a 3-year investor visa.

Finance Documentation

For the processing of your investor visa application, you must provide various documents for certain checks. For example, the business license to prove that you created or invested in a company in the country. Likewise, to demonstrate your financial capacity and investment, you must present a bank statement from the previous 6 months.

Background Checks

To comply with the investor visa requirements, you must also present proof that you have no legal problems. In this case, to prove it to the authorities, you must present a certificate of good conduct.

Health Insurance

It is mandatory to apply for one of these visas to obtain health insurance that covers your stay in the UAE. Said insurance can be obtained from one of the insurance providers authorized to issue this type of document. You can choose from different levels of coverage which generally include the following benefits:

  • Hospitalization
  • Outpatient services
  • Maternity
  • dental insurance
  • Ophthalmological

However, before choosing a plan, you should consider your requirements and the demands of the authorities.

UAE Investor Visa Process

Applying for a UAE investor visa consists of a series of steps and preparation to make the process flow. Next, we will show you the stages of the visa application that you must comply with:

Pre-application Steps

Preparation is essential so that the entire process is simpler and so that there are no delays in it. To begin, you must have ready the required documents according to the method you are using to obtain the visa. The investment evidence and other documents that you must present to prove that you qualify are the following:

  • Commercial license of the company created or in which you invest
  • Memorandum of Association or MoA
  • Company establishment card
  • Partnership Certificate
  • Company training certificate
  • Cancellation of any other type of visa

Application Submission

After you have the documentation and ensure that you meet the requirements of the investor visa, you can start the application. To properly comply with the process, you must make the request following the steps that we will indicate:

  1. Start by submitting the required documentation.
  2. You will then need to complete the application form and submit it to the immigration authorities of the Emirate where you wish to settle.
  3. Pay the fees that comprise the UAE investor visa cost.
  4. The next stage is to undergo a medical examination and register your biometric data.
  5. Lastly, apply for an Emirates ID, which is an essential document for everyone living in the country.

Review and Approval

After submitting the documents and visa application to the immigration authorities, you must wait for review and approval. If you have submitted each document and meet the requirements, it will only be a matter of time before to receive your visa. Generally, the processing time from company incorporation to obtaining the document can take between 15 and 20 days.

Visa Issuance

If the authorities approve your application, you will receive your visa and can begin living in the country legally. A UAE investor visa can be valid for 2, 3, 5, or 10 years depending on the type of application. Therefore, you must be attentive to renewing your visa because staying in the country illegally will have negative consequences.

Renewal process

As we just said, renewing your investor visa is essential to continue living in the country. To renew it, your company must be registered with the Directorate of Nationalization and Residency Department (DNRD). This government entity provides facilities so that investors can renew their visas easily.

If you have an e-DNRD account, go to an authorized typing center and complete the process without going to an immigration office. On the contrary, if you do not have an account, you must complete the following steps:

  1. Go to one of the typing centers and submit the necessary documentation for the process.
  2. Pay the corresponding renewal fees according to the type of visa and its validity period.

UAE Investor Visa Cost

The UAE investor visa cost consists of various fees that include the application and other mandatory procedures. Additionally, you must consider the financial criteria that establish the type of investor visa you wish to obtain. Below, you will see a breakdown of the fees and other financial aspects involved in the visa application:

Initial investment

One of the investor visas with the highest amount of validity is the golden visa, in which you must invest a minimum of AED 2000000. In this case, the authorities decreased the down payment for the purchase of a property from 50% to 20%. Additionally, for this 10-year visa, you can purchase the property at any stage of construction.

On the other hand, to get a 2-year visa, you must purchase a property of at least AED 750000 To do this, you can use a loan at an authorized local bank but you will have to pay 50% of the total value of the property.

Application Fees

The fees to obtain a UAE investor visa vary depending on whether the applicant is inside or outside the country. The request can be made at an Amer Center, and includes the following fees:

  • Entry permit outside the UAE, AED 525.
  • Entry permit for people within the country, AED 1175.
  • The change of status costs AED 675 for those in the country.
  • Visa stamping costs approximately AED 870.

Renewal Expenses

Renewing an investor visa also involves paying certain fees, which vary depending on the processing time. Here is a breakdown of the costs associated with renewing this type of visa with medical proof and UAE ID:

  • The cost is AED 3600 for normal time, AED 4600 if urgent, and AED 5100 for Royal processing.
  • Normal processing is 5 days, urgent processing is 2 days, and royal processing is 1 day.

On the other hand, the simple renewal, which does not include the medical exam or the Emirates ID, has the following cost:

  • AED 2,730 for normal processing, AED 3,730 for urgent, and AED 4,230 for Royal.
  • Normal processing is 8 days, urgent processing is 4 days, and royal processing is 2 days.

Additional Expenses

Apart from the document application fees, the UAE investor visa cost includes additional expenses. The procedures that fall within the financial aspects that you must consider are:

  • The cost of the Emirates ID is AED 100 for each year of validity.
  • The medical exam costs between AED 250 and AED 350

UAE Investor Visa Benefits

Having an investor visa and residing in the United Arab Emirates offers a host of advantages. Next, we will show you the benefits of obtaining one of these visas for establishment or investment in a business:

Residency Privileges

One of the UAE investor visa benefits is having the opportunity to reside long-term in the country. Depending on the type of investment and other requirements, you can opt for a visa of up to 10 years. Furthermore, once you are residing in the country, you can renew the visa for the same period and continue enjoying the other benefits.

Business Opportunities

Another advantage is that the dynamic and favorable environment offers a wide variety of business opportunities. The UAE has an established economy that continues to grow, encouraging foreign investment to diversify the market. Thus, with this visa, you can explore various types of business and participate in recognized businesses.

tax Advantages

One of the advantages of doing business in the UAE is that it has a favorable tax environment, especially in the free zones. For example, there is no personal income tax, although there is a very low corporate tax (maximum 9%). This way, you can retain a greater amount of income and profits from your activities.

Quality of Life

Another advantage of having a UAE investor visa is living in one of the safest countries in the world. Plus, thanks to the thriving economy of the nation, you can enjoy a luxurious standard of living. Likewise, you can bring your family and enroll your children in the high-level Emirati education system.

Global Mobility

With this visa, you can also travel between GCC countries for both business and pleasure without complications. By having investor status in the country, you may have greater opportunities to obtain a travel visa to the region. This is an advantage over the work visa, with which it is more difficult to travel between countries.

Types of Investor Visa

There is no single type of investor visa in the UAE as you can apply in different ways to obtain different validity. We will show you the different types of visas according to the requirements for obtaining each one below:

UAE Residence Investor Visa

This investor visa is for those people who want to invest or create a company in the country. However, individuals must meet the requirements, primarily creating or investing in a business worth AED 2 million. In addition, you have more than 2,000 options for business activities in which you can invest or create your own company.

UAE Free Zone Investor Visa

The UAE investor visa can also be obtained, and is more common there, in a free zone when establishing a business. Nevertheless, rates and requirements may vary depending on the free zone, and the nature of the business, among other characteristics. This will allow you to have 100% ownership if you decide to establish the business, as well as tax advantages.

Golden Visa

This visa is for both business and real estate investors but also entrepreneurs. In addition, it allows a residence in the country of 10 years for the holder and his family as well. To obtain it, you must invest at least AED 2 million in real estate or the public sector.

UAE Startup Visa

Entrepreneurs can also obtain an investor visa with a technical business idea or one that involves risk and innovation. This visa allows the holder to reside and do business in the country for 5 years, which are renewable. However, the investment must be at least AED 500 thousand, certified by an auditor and a business incubator.

Investor Visa for Real Estate Investment

The UAE investor visa requirements also allow the purchase of real estate to obtain it. In this case, the property or the sum of the value of the properties must be at least AED 1 million. This visa is for 3 years but if you want to obtain one for 5 years, the investment must be AED 2 million or more.

Investor Visa for Specific Sectors

The authorities can also grant an investor visa for those who make a certain investment. You can have an investment of AED 10 million in the public sector, by setting up investing in a company and owning property. Nonetheless, investment in sectors other than real estate should not be less than 60% of the total.

Investor Visa for Bond Investors

It is possible to obtain one of these visas by making a considerable investment in a local investment fund. However, to obtain the UAE investor visa in this case, you must comply with the following:

  • Submit a letter from an accredited investment fund, indicating the investment of AED 2 million.
  • Commercial or industrial license with Memorandum of Association (MoA), indicating the previous investment.
  • Letter from the Federal Tax Authority proving that the applicant pays at least AED 250000 annually.

In any case, the capital must not be a loan and you must have valid health insurance in the UAE.

Family Investor Visa

The family visa allows the stay of dependents, spouse, child, or parents, for the same time as the visa of the sponsor. To obtain a family visa from investors, you must meet the following requirements:

  • Housing lease contract.
  • If the visa is for a spouse, you must provide the certified marriage certificate.
  • Birth certificates if you will sponsor your children.
  • Make a refundable deposit of AED 3,000 per dependent.

Retirement Visa for Investors

People over 55 years of age who meet the requirements can obtain a retirement visa, which is a type of investor visa. The requirement is that the applicant must meet one of the following requirements:

  • own a property of AED 2 million
  • possess funds raised of at least AED 1 million
  • Have an active income of AED 20000 monthly or more.

This visa is valid for 5 years and can be renewed for the same amount of time.

Investor Visa Renewal Options

There are two options for renewing the investor visa, regardless of the type or validity. If you have a DNRD account, go to a typing center to complete the process with your username and password. If you do not have an account, you must go to one of these centers with the documentation and pay the necessary fees.

How Connect Zone can help you to Get an Investor Visa in UAE?

To obtain a UAE investor visa you must invest in a business, real estate, or create your own company. In this sense, at Connect Zone, we offer you a professional service to establish your company. Therefore, if you require more information in this regard, schedule a consultation by contacting us.

FAQs

Investor visa is for people who want to either invest in or own a business in UAE.

What is the minimum investment required for a UAE investor visa?

The requirement varies depending on business structure and emirate.

How long is the UAE investor visa valid?

Investor visas are usually valid for two to ten years.

Can an investor sponsor family members?

Yes, eligible investors can sponsor family members.

What are the benefits of an investor visa in the UAE?

It offers residency, business ownership, and long term stability.

How is an investor visa different from a Golden Visa?

Golden Visa offers longer validity and higher eligibility thresholds.
