title: Freelance Visa UAE | Key Requirements & Their Importance
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle
  • Types of Freelance Visas: Exploring Options Available in the UAE
  • Eligibility Criteria: Requirements for Obtaining a Freelance Visa
  • Documentation Requirements: Essential Papers for Freelance Visa Application
  • Financial Requirements: Understanding Financial Criteria for Freelance Visa Approval
  • Health Insurance: Mandatory Coverage for Freelancers in the UAE
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC): Importance and Issuance Process
  • Free Zone Selection: Choosing the Right Free Zone for Freelance Activities
  • Application Process: Step-by-Step Guide to Obtaining a Freelance Visa
  • Renewal and Cancellation: Procedures for Managing Freelance Visas
  • Rights and Responsibilities: Legal Obligations for Freelancers in the UAE
  • Freelance Visa Requirements in UAE FAQs
    • Who qualifies for a freelance visa in UAE?
    • Is freelance permit compulsory?
    • Can freelancers sponsor family in UAE?
    • How much does a freelance visa cost?
    • What activities are allowed under freelance visa?
    • How long is freelance visa valid?

The freelance UAE visa requirements are of utmost importance for independent professionals. Especially those who want to work in this prosperous Middle Eastern country. Obtaining a freelance visa in the UAE involves meeting certain criteria. In addition, having to present the corresponding documentation following all the conditions. From work experience to financial solvency, these requirements are the guarantee that freelancers can legally practice in the country. Thus, you can take advantage of the business opportunities available in Dubai and the other emirates.

In this article, we will explore each of the freelance UAE visa requirements. That is, how independent professionals can begin the application process. In addition, we will analyze the benefits of having an independent visa in the country and how you can enjoy exciting projects. If you are a freelancer interested in working in Dubai, read on to understand how this visa can affect your career and lifestyle.

Types of Freelance Visas: Exploring Options Available in the UAE

Since 2024, in Dubai, you can find a range of services for freelancers in the UAE. The idea is that they can satisfy your various professional needs.

Each of these visas allows independent workers to work independently and legally in the city. Specifically, for those who meet the freelance UAE visa requirements. Currently, there are a few common categories that you will see below in this list.

  • Freelance Work Permit: The Dubai freelance work permit is a good option for foreigners who want to work independently in the city. The request for this permit is especially for some independent professionals. For example, writers, graphic designers, web developers, and more.
  • Investor/Freelance Visa: If you are an investor/self-employed person who has an interest in Dubai this is the visa for you. Its purpose is to link your status as an independent worker to an investment in a company in the Dubai-free zone. If you establish a business entity in a free zone, you can obtain such a self-employed visa.

Thus, you have the possibility of providing the flexibility to manage your independent work under the shelter of the company.

  • Media freelancer visa: Any media and creative industries professional can apply for the Media freelancer visa. Specifically, journalists, content creators, and photographers. This visa is special to serve people who work to meet the unique needs of these fields. As a result, you can enjoy prosperity in Dubai’s vibrant media landscape.
  • Freelancer license registration in the UAE: The Dubai Virtual Company License is an innovative solution for freelancers who want to establish their online presence. Especially if you do not have the means to enjoy a physical office. This option allows freelancers to interact with clients and partners virtually in Dubai and the world.

Eligibility Criteria: Requirements for Obtaining a Freelance Visa

Before starting your freelance journey in Dubai, there are certain freelance UAE visa requirements that you have to meet. Below, you will see a list of all the eligibility criteria that you have to meet if you want to enjoy the freelance Dubai visa.

  • Unique abilities: The analogy is often made with superheroes who have superpowers. That is, just like them, you need special skills or knowledge in a specific field.
  • Proof of your skills: That is, show evidence of your skills, which can be with certificates, diplomas, or work experience. It is similar to showing your report card but more professional.
  • Valid passport: You must ensure that your passport is ready to travel at least six months before its expiration.
  • Important documents: Finally, you must have all the freelance UAE visa requirements. Especially, you have to have a special plan for your business and proof that you are financially stable.

If you are in Dubai

  • You have the option of applying for an independent work permit if you live on a spouse or parent visa. That is a unique opportunity to start your adventure as an independent.
  • Despite having a full-time job, you can obtain a license to work as a freelancer. But, if that is your situation, your sponsor or employer has to give you a No Objection Certificate (NOC). That is, a way to ask permission to be able to work on your own.

If you do not live in Dubai

  • Initially, you have to apply for a self-employed visa to work and live in Dubai.
  • Finally, you will need a residence visa so you can start your work activities.

Documentation Requirements: Essential Papers for Freelance Visa Application

Initially, you have to apply for the self-employed permit, which is a special permit for independents. To do this, you only need a copy of your self-employed license and a mobile phone number in the UAE.

Subsequently, you have to wait between 8 and 12 business days to have your card and with this, you can apply for your self-employed visa.

If you already have your freelance permit you have to comply with the following freelance UAE visa requirements.

  • Original passport of the independent professional.
  • Establishment card if you have your company in the country.
  • Recent passport-size photo of the independent professional.
  • Medical insurance valid in the territory of the UAE
  • If you have any type of visa in the UAE you have to bring it.
  • No Objection Certificate or NOC from any sponsor.
  • In some circumstances, you may be asked for a bank reference letter.
  • Curriculum vitae

Finally, it is important to keep in mind that if your intention is to belong to the educational sector, you have to present proof of academic qualifications. To be valid, they must be certified by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or the Consulate of the UAE in your country of origin.

On the other hand, if your intention is to join the media sector you have to send your work sample or portfolio. However, if you are applying in the technology or education sector, you can only choose one activity when applying for a permit.

Financial Requirements: Understanding Financial Criteria for Freelance Visa Approval

In principle, self-employed people have to meet the following financial criteria to apply for a freelance visa in the UAE.

  • Freelance permit from MOHRE or Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratization.
  • Proof of annual income of AED 360,000 within two years before applying.
  • Proof of financial solvency of the self-employed professional during the period of residence.

On the other hand, it is essential to highlight that when applying for this visa, you have to cover certain costs and that is part of the financial requirements. These prices may depend on a few factors, for example, the specific free zone or continental authority.

Health Insurance: Mandatory Coverage for Freelancers in the UAE

Any freelancer needs health insurance to be able to protect their health against unforeseen events. However, they do not have the same advantages that a salaried individual may have. That is, you have to make sure you look for coverage with enough benefits on your own.

Below you will see a list of all the reasons why health insurance coverage is one of the freelance UAE visa requirements.

  • Absence of employment benefits: It is common knowledge that employees of the public sector or companies have numerous benefits. For instance, health and life insurance coverage, provident funds, and more.

However, freelancers are self-employed therefore they have to make their own money investments. As a result, a term insurance plan is essential to survive.

  • Single premium life insurance: If you want to avail a term insurance plan for a duration of 30 years, you have to pay a single premium. That is, you will have protection in case of unfortunate events without having to belong to a company or the public sector.
  • Financial support in case of terminal illnesses or disabilities: Long-term insurance plans have different coverages depending on the interests of freelancers. Among the additional benefits, it is worth mentioning critical and terminal illnesses, disability coverage, and others.

Since your family and income depend directly on you, any eventuality can be devastating. This is why you need to have health insurance to have ample security against threats to you, your business, or your family.

No Objection Certificate (NOC): Importance and Issuance Process

Another of the freelance UAE visa requirements is the No Objection Certificate or NOC. An NOC is a legal document from the relevant authorities that affirms the absence of objections or obstacles to obtaining a freelance visa. Specifically, to affirm that your sponsor has no legal problem with your plans.

The No Objection Certificate can also be requested for other legal procedures. For instance, if you want to buy a property you have to apply for an NOC to affirm that the property is free of encumbrances or legal disputes.

If you want to have a freelance visa you have to have an NOC and to obtain it you just have to follow the following simple steps:

  • Identify the issuing authority: In principle, you have to determine the corresponding authority to issue the NOC. It will probably be your sponsor who does all the corresponding paperwork.
  • Complete the application form: It is time to obtain and complete the application form to have the No Objection Certificate. Generally, this form requires information about the sponsoring applicant and any supporting documentation.
  • Submit the application and pay the corresponding fees: You have to submit the completely filled application form along with the corresponding fees. To find out what the corresponding rates are, you just have to go to the authority where you do the procedure.
  • Wait for processing of the application: After submitting the application the issuing authority has to process it. Processing time will depend on the complexity of the case and the number of requests at the time.
  • Collect the NOC: At the end of the process, the applicant will be able to collect the NOC from the corresponding issuing authority.

Free Zone Selection: Choosing the Right Free Zone for Freelance Activities

In the UAE, many free zones issue licenses for self-employed workers. In this way, if you comply with all freelance Visa Requirements you will be able to work as a freelancer in one of the following free zones:

  • Dubai Internet City: It is a technology park that was created to promote innovation in the IT sector. Additionally, it serves as a regional headquarters for many global technology companies.
  • Dubai Media City: Was established to boost the media footprint of the UAE. Additionally, it is home to regional and global media companies. It is a thriving space for the production of advertising, media, communication, and media services.
  • Ajman Free Zone: Offers cost-effective installation solutions and a wide range of facilities for companies in all sectors, including services, trade, and industry.
  • Dubai Knowledge Park: This is dedicated to human resource management, educational excellence, and professional learning. In this way, it is a center for academic institutions, human resources companies, and training centers.
  • Fujairah Creative City Free Zone: Targets the creative industries and provides a platform for events, media, communications, education, consulting, and marketing professionals to thrive.
  • Dubai Design District: It is known as D3 and is dedicated to the fashion and design industry. Additionally, it is a creative ecosystem that fosters emerging local talent and gives international design, luxury, and fashion brands a home.
  • Ras Al Khaimah Economic Free Zone: This is tasked with providing profitable trade solutions and serves a wide range of sectors. These include the commercial, industrial, and service sectors.

Application Process: Step-by-Step Guide to Obtaining a Freelance Visa

If you want to obtain a freelance visa, it is important that you know the application process for a freelance visa. In this way, you will be able to know what the Freelance Visa Requirements in UAE are and the steps to follow shown below:

  • Choose the field: You need to decide in which field you are going to work as a freelancer. This way you can find fields such as media, technology, design, or education.
  • Apply for a Freelance Permit: You will need to apply for a self-employed permit in your chosen field. This permit will act as a license to operate as a freelancer in the UAE.
  • Gather the necessary documents: Freelance Visa Requirements include documents such as a copy of passport, CV, academic certificates endorsed by the UAE consulate, professional references, NOC of the resident’s sponsor, etc.
  • Submit your application through the official website of the UAE government.
  • Receive your freelancer permit: When your application is approved you will be able to receive your self-employed permit which will allow you to work legally in the UAE as a freelancer.
  • Apply for your freelancer visa: Having your permit you will be able to apply for a self-employed visa. In this way, you will be able to reside in the UAE while working as a self-employed person.
  • Generally, the application requires a freelancer permit/license, health insurance, passport, UAE telephone number, and passport-size photographs.
  • Undergo medical testing: You must undergo a medical fitness test as part of your visa application process. Additionally, you must obtain health insurance.
  • Visa Issuance: When your application is approved and you pay all fees, your self-employed visa will be issued. This way, you will be able to live and work in the UAE legally.

Renewal and Cancellation: Procedures for Managing Freelance Visas

You already know about the freelance Visa Requirements in UAE and the application process. Therefore, it is important that you know that the self-employed visa has an expiration date. In this way, you must renew it from time to time.

Renewal of the freelancer visa: If you want to renew your UAE self-employed visa you must take this into account:

  • Duration: A self-employed visa can last between 1 and 3 years.
  • Renewal: You must ensure you renew it before your visa expires. This way, you can avoid any type of problem.
  • Stay alert: Always keep in mind the date your self-employed visa expires and start the renewal process early. This way, you will avoid sanctions or any legal problems.

Below, you can see a step-by-step guide to renewing your self-employed visa:

Gather the documents:

  • Medical fitness test certificate.
  • Make sure your insurance is up to date.
  • Renew your establishment card.
  • Apply for your self-employed visa.
  • Pay all fees.
  • The wait may take between 2 to 3 weeks to renew your visa.
  • In the end, you need to make sure that all the details of your visa are correct. If you have an error, you should contact the authority in charge and solve the problem as soon as possible.

Cancellation of freelancer visa: To cancel your visa you must take this into account,

  • How to do it: If you do not want to work as a freelancer in the UAE you must correctly cancel your visa,
  • Stay informed: You need to communicate with the right people or your sponsor. This way, you can start the process of canceling your visa and obtain all the information necessary for this process.

Rights and Responsibilities: Legal Obligations for Freelancers in the UAE

Knowing about the UAE visa rules and the legal responsibilities of freelancers is important. In this way, a freelancer from the UAE must comply with specific regulations so that they can operate within the legal framework of the country.

  • Residency considerations: They can work in the UAE as residents or non-residents. Residents need a valid residence visa and a sponsor. On the other hand, non-residents must apply for a self-employed visa.
  • Business License: A freelancer person must obtain a self-employed license or permit. This way, you can operate under your own name. Additionally, this permit allows you to offer your services in specific sectors.
  • Compliance with UAE regulations: All freelancers have to comply with the laws and regulations of the UAE. Additionally, you must pay taxes, if applicable, and track your expenses and income.

Freelance Visa Requirements in UAE FAQs

Who qualifies for a freelance visa in UAE?

Individuals with skills in approved fields like media, tech, design, and business can qualify if they meet the free zone or authority requirements.

Is freelance permit compulsory?

Yes. You must have a freelance permit before applying for the UAE freelance visa.

Can freelancers sponsor family in UAE?

Yes. Freelancers can sponsor family members if they meet income, visa, and accommodation requirements.

How much does a freelance visa cost?

In 2026 the total cost usually ranges from AED 7,000 to AED 12,000, including the permit, visa stamping, medical tests, and Emirates ID.

What activities are allowed under freelance visa?

Allowed activities depend on the permit authority but typically include digital media, consulting, IT, content creation, and professional services.

How long is freelance visa valid?

A freelance visa is usually valid for 1 to 3 years, depending on the free zone and permit conditions.

The UAE Golden Visa is an innovative long-term residency program designed to provide unparalleled golden visa benefits to foreign talent. Investors and their families. This strategic initiative aims to attract qualified professionals and contribute to the UAE’s dynamic growth and global presence.

In this article, we will take a closer look at the five main benefits of UAE golden visa and see. How it can transform your experience of living and working in the UAE. This goes beyond the typical visa benefits and includes unique benefits such as ownership. No local sponsor requirements, access to world-class healthcare and education, and tax benefits.

Global Mobility and Travel Freedom with UAE Golden Visa Benefits

Golden visa UAE benefits is holders enjoy global mobility. Allowing them to travel freely to many countries without a visa or with a reduced visa process. This promotes business travel, tourism and international connections, opening the door to new opportunities and experiences around the world.

Also, the golden visa benefits not only allow you to enjoy the benefits of long-term residency. But also comes with a variety of benefits and discounts not currently available to standard UAE residency visa holders. In general, the benefits include:

Access to visa-free or visa-on-arrival travel

In addition, the golden visa benefits program offers multiple entry points for professionals to enter and exit the country. This makes the UAE an ideal base for entrepreneurs and talent with global connections, facilitating seamless business and personal travel.

As well, it facilitates family travel, allowing you to maintain ties to your home country and explore new horizons. Without having to apply for a new visa each time you leave the UAE.

Examples of accessible destinations for Golden Visa holders

The golden visa benefits is an excellent opportunity for those who wish to reside in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and enjoy its benefits. Here are some destinations accessible to Golden Visa holders in the UAE:

  • Dubai: This city is a hub of modern innovation and ancient heritage. It offers a unique blend of breathtaking skyscrapers, golden sandy beaches and vibrant nightlife. Also, golden Visa holders can enjoy the full freedom of this visa.
  • Abu Dhabi: The capital of the UAE is famous for its futuristic architecture, such as the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and the Louvre Abu Dhabi. Also, it offers a high quality of life and opportunities for foreign investors.
  • Sharjah: This neighboring city of Dubai is known for its focus on culture and the arts. It has museums, galleries and a beautiful corniche for strolling.
  • Ras al-Khaimah: Besides, if you are looking for a quieter destination, Ras al-Khaimah is an excellent choice. It offers beaches, mountains and an authentic Emirati experience.
  • Fujairah: This coastal city is ideal for diving and snorkeling enthusiasts. Its crystal-clear waters and natural beauty make it an attractive place to live.

Convenience for frequent travelers and businesspersons

The UAE golden visa benefits allow unlimited entry and exit from the UAE without visa restrictions. Investors can take advantage of the UAE’s favorable business environment to establish businesses, invest in real estate and engage in commercial projects. So, this makes it a favorable option for both cases.

Residency and Citizenship Opportunities Through UAE Golden Visa Benefits

The advantages of golden visa UAE offers a residency period of up to 10 years (much longer than a standard visa) and provides a solid foundation for long-term personal and professional development.

As well, this is especially useful for those who wish to stay in the UAE for a long period of time. It provides opportunities for professional development and business growth that may be difficult to achieve due to the limitations of short-term visas.

In addition, this long-term residency allows individuals and their families to become more deeply immersed in the UAE community and culture. This enhances their overall experience in the country, providing a better understanding of local customs and traditions and a greater sense of belonging.

Pathway to residency or citizenship offered by Golden Visa programs

The United Arab Emirates (UAE) offers golden visa benefits that provide opportunities for both residency and citizenship. Below, I provide you with information on both avenues:

Golden Visa for UAE Residency:

  • Investors can obtain a residency visa in exchange for one or more real estate properties in the UAE, provided that the total value of the investment is not less than AED 2 million.
  • Golden Residency Visa holders can enjoy a high quality of life, advanced technology and unique experiences in this luxurious country.

Golden Visa for UAE Citizenship:

  • The UAE has announced a new policy allowing expatriates to apply for citizenship. This is in line with its 10-year Golden Visa program, which grants permanent residency to wealthy real estate investors, entrepreneurs and creatives.
  • Although not a direct path to citizenship, long-term residency through the Golden Visa program can be a step towards naturalization.

So, golden Visa programs in the UAE offer attractive opportunities both for residency and for those interested in exploring the possibility of obtaining citizenship in the future. So, if you would like more details, I invite you to consult the sources provided for complete information.

Different types of residency and citizenship options available

The United Arab Emirates (UAE) offers several options for both residency and citizenship. Here is a summary of the different avenues available:

  • Residency Visa through Company (Company Registration): Investors can obtain a residency visa by establishing or investing in a company in the UAE.
  • Dubai Gold Residency Visa (UAE): Also, this visa is granted for 10 years and is intended for investors and entrepreneurs who meet certain requirements.
  • Residence Visa for Investment through the Purchase of Real Estate: By purchasing real estate in the UAE, investors can obtain a residence visa.
  • Green 5-Year Residency Visa: Therefore, this visa offers a 5-year residency and is available for investors and professionals.
  • Origin: Citizenship can be obtained by birth in the country or by descent from Emirati parents.
  • Marriage: Marriage to an Emirati citizen can be a pathway to citizenship.
  • Naturalization: Although rare, some individuals may obtain citizenship through a naturalization process.
  • Exceptional Merit: In exceptional cases, outstanding individuals may be considered for citizenship.

Long-term security and stability provided by Golden Visa benefits

The golden visa UAE advantages in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) offers long-term security and stability for investors and applicants. Some of the key benefits include:

  • Durable Residency: Golden Visa holders can reside in the UAE for an extended period, providing peace of mind and continuity in their lives.
  • Access to Quality Services: Golden Visa beneficiaries can enjoy high standards of health, education and social security services.
  • Freedom of Travel: The Golden Visa allows unrestricted entry and exit from the country, facilitating international travel.
  • Business and Investment Opportunities: Investors can take advantage of the UAE’s favorable business environment to establish businesses, invest in real estate and participate in commercial projects.
  • Talent Attraction and Creativity: Golden Visa programs attract talented, entrepreneurial and creative professionals, enriching the country’s cultural and economic diversity.
  • Possibility of Naturalization: Although not a direct path to citizenship, long-term residency through the Golden Visa program may be a step toward naturalization in the future.

Investment Diversification and Returns: Leveraging UAE Golden Visa Benefits

Golden visa benefits find more favorable conditions in free zones and mitigate tax obligations. These locations, mainly located in Dubai, offer exemptions from corporate tax, value-added tax and import and export duties. In addition, foreign investors can own the entirety of companies in these free zones.

Besides, whether you want to start a business, invest in real estate or participate in the country’s dynamic economic environment, you can explore business and investment opportunities in the UAE.

Various investment options associated with Golden Visas

The United Arab Emirates (UAE) Golden Visa program offers a variety of investment options for those seeking permanent residency. Here, we take a look at them:

  • Public Investment Investors: If you invest in a recognized investment fund in the UAE, you can obtain a Golden Visa valid for 10 years without a sponsor.
  • Real Estate Investors: if you own one or more properties in the UAE, you can obtain a Golden Visa which can be renewed under the same conditions and is valid for 5 years without sponsor.
  • Joint ownership between spouses: Spouses can own property jointly to meet the investment requirements of the Golden Visa.

Potential for investment diversification and attractive returns

Offering unprecedented access to job and business opportunities, the UAE Golden Visa stands out as a significant advantage for entrepreneurs and talented individuals. The UAE is known for its world-class infrastructure and amenities, including a high-tech ecosystem, state-of-the-art medical facilities and modern transportation networks.

Also, this combination of features creates an ideal environment for businesses and professionals to thrive. In addition, the ease of setting up a business, combined with the UAE’s strategic geographical location, makes it an attractive draw for international entrepreneurs and professionals.

As well, this approach opens the door to endless opportunities for professional growth and business expansion in a competitive and innovative environment on a global scale.

Success stories of investors leveraging Golden Visa benefits for wealth growth

Testimonials from investors who have expanded their wealth through the Golden Visa in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) reflect the success and opportunities the program offers. Here are some examples based on the information available:

  • Global Entrepreneurs: Many entrepreneurs have shared how the Golden Visa has enabled them to expand their operations internationally. With UAE residency, they have been able to establish valuable business connections and access new markets.
  • Real Estate Investors: Some investors have testified that investing in UAE real estate, with a minimum value of AED 2 million, has not only granted them the Golden Visa but has also resulted in a significant return on investment due to the growth of the real estate market1.
  • Highly Skilled Professionals: Professionals from various industries have taken advantage of the Golden Visa to reside in the UAE, enabling them to work on innovative projects and collaborate with industry leaders, thus improving their financial and professional situation.
  • These testimonials highlight how the UAE Golden Visa has become a strategic tool for investors and professionals looking to grow and prosper in a dynamic and developing economic environment.

Therefore, one outstanding testimonial is from an investor who expanded his wealth by investing in UAE real estate. With an investment of at least AED 5 million in a property, this investor obtained the Golden Visa, allowing him to reside in the UAE and manage his investment more effectively.

So, the economic stability and growth of the real estate market in the UAE contributed to a significant return on investment, thus improving his financial situation.

Education and Healthcare Access: UAE Golden Visa Benefits for Families

Visa holders are generally entitled to high quality medical care in the UAE, including world-class medical facilities and services for themselves and their families. Also, this allows families to enroll their children in prestigious UAE schools and universities, providing them with quality education and diverse cultural experiences.

Access to high-quality education and healthcare systems

The UAE Golden Visa offers significant benefits to families with children through educational opportunities. In particular, the inclusion of higher education benefits makes it economically viable to provide higher education opportunities to families. So, this discount opens the door to international universities in Dubai.

Here, students can study a variety of fields and earn internationally recognized degrees. The granting of this educational incentive demonstrates the UAE’s commitment to promoting excellence in education and providing families with the resources they need to support their children’s academic growth and success.

Educational and healthcare benefits for families of Golden Visa holders

The advantages of UAE golden visa offer families an excellent healthcare system, an important aspect of the country’s high quality of life. This access includes advanced medical facilities equipped with the latest technology and staffed by world-class medical experts.

As well, these advanced medical services provide residents with access to care, peace of mind and security regarding their health and well-being. Along with medical care, the visa opens the door to world-class leisure and entertainment opportunities in a secure living environment.

Importance of these benefits for family well-being and development

A key feature of the UAE Golden Visa program is that it allows holders to sponsor family members, including spouse and children. This option makes it easier for families to live together in the UAE without each family member having to apply for a separate visa.

Also, this inclusion is an important benefit as it strengthens family ties and provides a deep sense of security and connection to the UAE.

As well, the ability to sponsor a family on a single visa simplifies the residency process and highlights the family aspect of the UAE Golden Visa, making it an attractive option for those seeking a stable and integrated family life in the UAE.

Tax Advantages and Financial Incentives with UAE Golden Visa Benefits

The UAE gold visa offers tax advantages to its holders, such as exemption from personal income tax, capital gains tax and value added tax (VAT). This can lead to considerable savings, especially for individuals with a high income or a substantial investment portfolio.

Tax benefits and financial incentives offered by Golden Visa programs

One of the most important benefits of UAE golden visa is that it applies to those who comply with the UAE’s income tax exemption policy, which means significant financial benefits.

So, this policy, which is part of the UAE’s general tax regime, means that residents, including Golden Visa holders, do not have to pay personal income tax. This includes income from employment, investments or other personal income.

Opportunities for tax optimization and wealth preservation

The opportunities for tax optimization and wealth preservation in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) are significant due to its attractive tax environment. Here are some key ones:

  • Tax Exemption: The UAE offers full exemption from income and corporate taxes, which is beneficial for wealth preservation and tax optimization.
  • Special Economic Zones: Special economic zones and free zones in the UAE allow for 100% ownership, repatriation of profits and an extensive double tax treaty network.
  • Double Taxation Treaties: The UAE has close to 80 double tax treaties, which can significantly reduce the overall tax burden for businesses and individuals.
  • Pro-business Government: The UAE government encourages foreign investment and provides the necessary infrastructure for business growth and stability.

Also, these characteristics make the UAE a favorable destination for investors and entrepreneurs seeking to optimize their tax situation and protect their wealth.

Strategies for optimizing financial situations through Golden Visa benefits

The United Arab Emirates (UAE) Golden Visa program offers several advantages to individuals seeking long-term residency. Here are some strategies to optimize your financial situation through the Golden Visa:

  • Long-term residency and exclusive benefits: The Golden Visa allows foreign talents, including investors, entrepreneurs, scientists, prominent students and graduates, to live, work or study in the UAE while enjoying exclusive benefits.
  • Multiple bank accounts: Golden Visa holders enjoy the flexibility of opening multiple bank accounts. This provides a secure financial setup to safeguard and preserve their funds. Becoming a legal resident of the UAE also allows you to become a tax resident.

So, there is no personal income tax, capital gains tax or inheritance tax in the UAE. This favorable tax environment can significantly benefit your financial situation.

What is the UAE Golden Visa, and who is eligible?

Holding a UAE gold visa will give you residency for five to ten years. Such residency is not tied to a specific employer and does not need to be renewed every two to three years. Result. UAE Gold visas allow UAE expatriates to live, work and study in the UAE with no domestic sponsor and with 100% ownership of their mainland UAE business.

So, under the recent changes to the UAE Residence and Entry Scheme, more individuals can apply for a golden residence visa. Those included in these categories are eligible to apply:

  • Investors: You can qualify for the Golden Visa based on the following criteria:
  • Property Ownership: Owning property worth AED 2 million or more.
  • Fixed Deposit: Maintaining a two-year fixed deposit of AED 2 million in a local bank.
  • Monthly Salary: Having a minimum monthly salary of AED 30,000.
  • Key Positions: Holding key positions such as Director, General Manager, or any skilled designation.
  • Real Estate Investors: If you own a property or a group of properties, you may be granted a Golden Visa for a period of 5 years, renewable under the same conditions and without a sponsor.
  • Other Categories: The Golden Visa is also available for outstanding students, graduates, humanitarian pioneers, and frontline heroes

What are the investment opportunities associated with the UAE Golden Visa?

The UAE Golden Visa program offers several investment opportunities for eligible individuals. Let us explore them:

  • Investors in Public Investments: If you invest in an accredited UAE investment fund, you may be granted a Golden Visa for a period of 10 years without needing a sponsor.
  • Real Estate Investors: Owning a property or a group of properties in the UAE can also qualify you for the Golden Visa. Real estate investors may be granted a Golden Visa for a period of 5 years, renewable under the same conditions and without a sponsor. The recent update in January 2024 removed the AED 1 million minimum down payment requirement for real estate investment, encouraging more residents and investors to establish deeper roots in the country.
  • Innovative Business Projects: Introducing an innovative business project with an esteemed value of AED 500,000 can make you eligible for a 10-year Golden Visa. This pathway allows entrepreneurs to contribute to the UAE’s economic growth while enjoying long-term residence benefits

Can Golden Visa holders access education and healthcare in the UAE?

Golden Visa holders in the UAE enjoy access to education and healthcare, enhancing their quality of life. Here are the details:

  • Golden Visa holders can access educational institutions in the UAE. Whether you are pursuing higher studies or enrolling your children in schools, you will find a range of options.
  • Also, the UAE hosts several prestigious universities and schools, offering diverse programs and curricula.
  • Besides, families with Golden Visas can ensure their children receive quality education in a multicultural environment.
  • As well, golden Visa holders benefit from exclusive health insurance plans tailored for them.
  • Therefore, the Esaad privilege card provides access to discounts on hotels, school fees, restaurants, flights, and more.
  • Additionally, Golden Visa holders can avail themselves of special health insurance policies with premiums starting from as little as Dh2,393 for an annual coverage limit of Dh300,00012.
  • Dubai’s exceptional services include a range of world-class healthcare facilities, acting as a catalyst for potential relocation for cash-rich retirees

How can I apply for the UAE Golden Visa, and what is the process like?

Applying for the UAE Golden Visa involves specific steps and requirements. Let us walk through the process:

  • Eligibility Check: Prior to submitting your application, please ensure that you meet the eligibility criteria. The Golden Visa is available for investors, entrepreneurs, scientists, outstanding students, graduates, humanitarian pioneers, and frontline heroes.

Required Documents:

  • Passport copies.
  • Passport-sized photographs.
  • Proof of medical insurance for yourself and family members (if applicable).
  • Relevant investment-related documents (for investors).
  • Property ownership documents (for real estate investors).

Application Submission:

  • Visit one of the Amer Centers to submit your application.
  • Follow these steps:
  • Head to an Amer Center.
  • Select the required service at the reception.
  • Submit the necessary documents to the service employee.
  • Your documents will be checked.
  • Pay the applicable fees.
  • Submit your application.

Online Application:

  • Alternatively, you can apply online through the UAE Government’s official portal.
  • Fill in the required data, attach the documents, and pay the service fees securely through the smart platforms.

Processing Time:

  • The processing time varies, but you will receive an entry visa for six months with multiple entries to proceed with residence issuance.
  • Once approved, you will receive a long-term, renewable residence visa valid for 5 or 10 years.

What are the implications of the UAE Golden Visa for my family?

The UAE Golden Visa has significant implications for your family, offering exclusive benefits and opportunities. Here is how it impacts your loved ones:

As a Golden Visa holder, you can sponsor your family members, including:

  • Your family members can enjoy long-term residence in the UAE, just like you.
  • The Golden Visa is valid for 5 or 10 years, providing stability and security.

Education Opportunities:

  • So, your children can access quality education in the UAE.
  • The country hosts prestigious universities, schools, and educational institutions.
  • Therefore, Golden Visa holders and their families benefit from exclusive health insurance plans.
  • The Esaad privilege card provides additional discounts on various services.

Tax Advantages:

  • Becoming a tax resident in the UAE means your family members also benefit from the country’s tax-free environment.
  • Besides, there is no personal income tax, capital gains tax, or inheritance tax.
  • As ell, the UAE offers a high standard of living, safety, and a vibrant multicultural environment.
  • Also, your family can explore the rich culture, modern amenities, and recreational activities.

If you would like more information on this and other interesting topics, click here for our blogs. Also, if you would like to engage our services contact us today to get started.

What is a UAE Golden Visa and who is eligible?

The golden visa is a long term residence visa for investors, professionals, entrepreneurs, students, and exceptional talents.

How long is the Golden Visa valid in the UAE?

It is valid for five or ten years depending on eligibility category.

What are the key benefits of a Golden Visa?

It offers long term residency, no sponsor requirement, business flexibility, and family sponsorship benefits.

Can Golden Visa holders sponsor family members?

Yes. Holders can sponsor spouses, children, and in some cases parents and domestic staff.

How to apply for a UAE Golden Visa?

You apply through official UAE portals or with professional assistance by submitting eligibility proof and documents.

Is it possible to convert a regular visa into a Golden Visa?

Yes. Eligible residents can upgrade their existing visa to a Golden Visa.

title: Investor Visa Dubai: Everything You Need to Know
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle

  • Investor visas Dubai new rules

    • Invest in innovation and technology

  • Renewal and long-term considerations
    • Investor visa Dubai renewal fee
  • What is the 5-year investor visa Dubai?
  • What is the 3-year investor visa Dubai?
  • What is the 2-year investor visa Dubai?
  • What is an investor visa in Dubai, and how does it differ from other types of visas?
  • What are the financial implications associated with obtaining an investor visa in Dubai?
  • What are the renewal requirements for an investor visa in Dubai?
  • Are there any tax considerations for investor visa holders in Dubai?
  • What long-term opportunities does an investor visa in Dubai offer, such as residency and citizenship?
  • How much do I must invest to get residency in Dubai?
  • FAQs
    • What is an investor visa in Dubai?
    • How much investment is required for an investor visa in Dubai?
    • How long is the investor visa valid in the UAE?
    • Can foreign nationals apply for a Dubai investor visa?
    • What are the benefits of holding an investor visa in Dubai?
    • What is the difference between an investor visa and a partner visa?

Obtaining an investor visa Dubai is the solution to having a business and residing in the UAE with the possibility of renewal. This way, you can take advantage of the advantages of doing business in the country, such as low corporate taxes. You will also be able to have your family with you in the country as the visa will allow you to sponsor your dependents.

In this article, we show you the most relevant details of this type of visa and the benefits it offers. Additionally, you will learn about investment opportunities and fees associated with visa processing and issuance.

Benefits of investor visas in Dubai

The investor visa Dubai allows foreigners who meet certain criteria to live and do business in the UAE. In addition, they obtain other considerable benefits for their residential and business aspirations such as:

  • Take advantage of business opportunities thanks to the favorable business environment and the prosperous economy.
  • You can obtain residency for yourself and your family for up to 10 years depending on the investment visa you obtain.
  • Dubai, and the UAE in general, offers a favorable tax environment with no personal income tax and low corporate tax.
  • It provides access to regional markets thanks to the strategic location of the nation in the Middle East.
  • Another of the Dubai investor visa benefits is that the city has a business and technological infrastructure and a high standard of living.
  • The city has a high level of security so you can rest assured for the duration of your stay.
  • Investors over 55 years of age can have a peaceful retirement in the UAE.

Investor visa requirements in Dubai

The investor visa Dubai requirements include that the investor must be over 18 years of age. In addition to this criterion, applicants for one of these visas must meet one of the following requirements:

  • Make a public sector investment of at least AED 10 million in various assets.
  • Buy a property worth at least AED 1 million.
  • Establish a business in the UAE with a project investment with a minimum capital of AED 500.

Cost of obtaining an investor visa in Dubai

You can apply for the document at an Amer center and the investor visa Dubai cost consists of the following:

  • The entry permit costs AED 1,175 for within the UAE and AED 525 for applications outside the country.
  • Change of status for people within the UAE costs AED 675.
  • Stamping the visa costs about AED 870.
  • The Emirates ID is worth AED 500.
  • Mandatory medical tests cost approximately AED 350.

However, you must consider other additional fees such as the required immigration settlement card. Additionally, you should note that you must obtain a business license from the Dubai Economic Department (DED).

Investor visas Dubai new rules

The authorities have made some changes to the investor visa Dubai, including reducing the minimum initial deposit. To begin with, for the 10-year golden visa, investors will only have to pay 20% as a down payment on the property. Previously, the down payment was 50% of the property value, which is still AED 2 million.

In addition, the new rules allow the property to be purchased at any stage of its construction. However, foreign property investors are still required to purchase the properties in the freehold areas.

Investment options for investor visas

To obtain a Dubai investor visa, you must invest in any of the types of businesses in the UAE. The important thing is to invest with the value established by the authorities in one of the following options:

Real estate

The most popular option for investors who want residency is to buy one or several properties in the country. In this case, Dubai has a thriving real estate market, with both residential and commercial properties. In this way, you can aspire to obtain a golden visa for a renewable period of 5 years.

Establish a company

The other option you have to obtain the investor visa Dubai is to establish a company with established capital. You can establish a business both on the mainland and in one of the free zones in the Emirate. Furthermore, there are a wide variety of industrial areas that you can choose from to start your business activities.

An option for entrepreneurs is the establishment of a company or technical or future economic project. Additionally, you must meet requirements such as verification through a project auditor worth AED 500,000.

Public investments

People who invest in a public investment fund can also aspire to obtain a 10-year golden visa. However, you must meet any of the following conditions to apply for one of these visas:

  • Letter from an accredited investment fund certifying a deposit of AED 2 million.
  • Have a valid commercial or industrial license as well as a Memorandum of Association certifying investment capital of AED 2 million or more.
  • Letter from the Federal Tax Authority stating that the investor pays the government at least AED 250,000 annually.

Additionally, you must meet other criteria including possessing the capital and providing health insurance.

Economic contribution to the country

You can also receive a Dubai investor visa if you contribute to the economy of the UAE. Some of these forms of contribution include those mentioned below:

  • Direct investments in specific sectors
  • Employment creation
  • Participation in government initiatives

In this way, you can demonstrate that you are committed to and contribute significantly to the economy.

Invest in the financial market

Apart from the above, financial markets are also a viable option for investing in the UAE. In this case, you can buy stocks or bonds, invest in mutual funds, or trade commodities. Therefore, making investments in the financial markets can increase your chances of obtaining an investor visa Dubai.

Invest in innovation and technology

People who wish to invest in the country can also do so in the technology sector, as the country promotes this type of investment. For example, you can invest in the renewable energy, Artificial Intelligence, or healthcare sectors. These are investments aligned with the vision of the country of being one of the technological powers in the world.

Business opportunities and networking

Among the Dubai investor visa benefits is the opportunity to establish a wide variety of businesses and join a global business network. This is due to the strategic location of the country and other factors that facilitate the connection. These aspects include state-of-the-art infrastructure, and world-class transportation-related facilities (ports and airports).

All this and more have helped the nation attract investors and business owners from companies around the world. Therefore, through networking, you can grow your business in the country and even expand regionally or globally. In Dubai and the other Emirates, you can find a wide variety of trade exhibitions, international chambers of commerce, workshops, and seminars.

This way, you can take advantage of opportunities to establish meaningful relationships with partners, distributors, and customers. However, you should prepare properly by researching which companies and influencers will be attending this variety of events. There you can publicize your company and the projects you are developing or want to develop to connect with the right people and businesses.

Familia sponsorship and dependents

With an investor visa Dubai, holders can sponsor their family members or dependents to reside in the country. Nevertheless, you must meet the following requirements to sponsor your family members to obtain a residence visa:

  • You must have a housing lease contract.
  • Present the certified marriage certificate, if you want to sponsor your spouse.
  • Present certified birth certificates to sponsor your children.
  • Make a refundable deposit of AED 3,000 for each family member you wish to sponsor.

Renewal and long-term considerations

Renewing an investor visa is an important step for your aspirations to continue doing business and living in the UAE. The Directorate of Nationalization and Residency Department (DNRD) makes its electronic renewal services ( eDNDR ) available to entrepreneurs. Below you can see the renewal process which consists of a few simple steps:

If you have an e-DNRD account, you can go to a typing center and present your username and password. In this case, it is not necessary to go to the immigration office to complete the visa renewal process. However, if you do not have an e-DNRD account, you must follow the steps that we will list below:

  1. Find the form at the typing center and submit the following documents:
  • Original passport with a six months validity at least
  • 2 photographs of the same size as the passport with a white background
  • Original medical certificate
  • Health insurance
  • Copy of Emirates ID renewal form
  • A certified copy of a lease
  • Last utility bill (copy)
  • Copy of company bank statement
  • International Bank Account Number of the sponsor (IBAN)
  • If a professional license, a copy of the Service Agent Agreement
  • Copy of the immigration establishment card
  1. Finally, you must pay the renewal fees corresponding to the validity of the visa.

Investor visa Dubai renewal fee

The investor visa Dubai cost for renewal includes the following fees:

  • Renewal with medical proof and Emirates ID costs AED 3,600 regular, AED 4,600 urgent, and AED 5,100 Royal.
  • Simple renewal costs AED 2,730 regular, AED 3,730 urgent, and AED 4,230 Royal.

The difference between each renewal package is the processing time, which is as follows:

  • The complete package (medical exam and UAE ID) is 5 days normal, 2 days urgent, and 1 day Royal.
  • The basic package, has 8 days of normal processing, 4 days of urgent, and 2 days Royal.

On the other hand, the cost of the medical examination for visa renewal is as follows:

  • Normal (3 to 5 days) AED 320.
  • 2 days AED 420.
  • 1 day AED 540.
  • VIP (3 hours) AED 750.

What is the 5-year investor visa Dubai?

The investor visa Dubai gives you the option of obtaining residency for 2, 3, 5, and 10 years. However, each of them has certain conditions that all applicants must meet according to the validity period. To obtain one of these visas for 5 years, the applicant must meet the following conditions:

  • You need to buy a property worth at least AED 2 million.
  • You can purchase the property for the said amount with a loan from an authorized local bank.
  • Have a minimum ownership retention period of 2 years.
  • Invest in one or more off-plan properties in an authorized real estate company.

On the other hand, the investor visa Dubai requirements for 5 years for entrepreneurs are as follows:

  • Invest AED 500,000 (at least) in an approved or existing project by an accredited business incubator.

What is the 3-year investor visa Dubai?

The 3-year visa for investors is for people who want to open or invest in a free zone or mainland company. In this case, you must invest in a company or start one with a minimum capital of AED 72000. Investors in free zones can enjoy 100% foreign ownership, tax freedom, and no mandatory local partners, among others.

What is the 2-year investor visa Dubai?

The 2-year visa for investors in the UAE is for those who make a minimum investment of AED 750000. However, interested parties can only purchase a finished property for the indicated value or greater than that amount. Additionally, if you register a property for this visa for two years, the minimum value increases to AED 1 million.

What is an investor visa in Dubai, and how does it differ from other types of visas?

An investor visa Dubai is a document that allows investors or entrepreneurs to establish themselves long-term in the UAE. You can apply for a visa for establishing a company or investing in real estate, both for a set amount. Since there are obvious differences with other types of visas (work, study, family, and more) we will emphasize the difference with a partner visa.

visas are for those with a sole proprietorship, while the partner visa is for those with shareholders in their business. A clear example of this type of company is the Limited Liability Company or LLC in the UAE. Nevertheless, the benefits and other features of these visas are the same.

What are the financial implications associated with obtaining an investor visa in Dubai?

Obtaining one of these visas requires meeting financial requirements depending on the type of investment and the validity period. Below, you can see the financial implications to consider apart from the cost of the visa:

  • For property investments, these must be of a value equal to or greater than AED 1 million. In addition, the applicant must have sole ownership of the property with a maximum mortgage value of 50%.
  • For property investors, each must have AED 1 million shares in the joint property.
  • People who want to open a company to obtain a visa must have a minimum capital of AED 72000. It also applies to people who obtain a share in an established company for the same amount.
  • Investors aged 55 and over must purchase one or more real estate properties for a minimum of AED 2 million.

What are the renewal requirements for an investor visa in Dubai?

Renewing an investor visa Dubai requires the presentation of various documents and other requirements. For example, you must undergo a medical examination, renew your Emirates ID, and renew your health insurance. The renewal of the document must be carried out at an authorized typing center.

Are there any tax considerations for investor visa holders in Dubai?

The holders of this visa can enjoy a tax-free environment. For example, you will not have to pay VAT and you will be able to have 100% ownership of the company in a free zone. Likewise, the government authorities have several double taxation agreements with a large number of countries.

What long-term opportunities does an investor visa in Dubai offer, such as residency and citizenship?

The United Arab Emirates does not offer direct or indirect citizenship in any form, only long-term residency. Visas for investors can range from 2 years to 10 years (golden visa) with the possibility of renewal. The golden visa applies to investors, entrepreneurs, CEOs, students with merit, and scientists.

How much do I must invest to get residency in Dubai?

As we have mentioned, it requires a particular investment depending on the type of investment you want to make. The minimum investment amounts in this case are the following:

  • Property investments AED 1 million.
  • Open a company with a capital of AED 72000 at least.
  • Share in an established company AED 72000.
  • Investors over 55 years, AED 2 million.

For more information about employment or visa issues in the UAE, you can contact our experts.

FAQs

What is an investor visa in Dubai?

An investor visa is designed for foreigners. Under this visa, they can live, work, and manage their businesses in Dubai.

How much investment is required for an investor visa in Dubai?

Investment starts from 750,000 dirhams. It may vary, depending on the investor visa type.

How long is the investor visa valid in the UAE?

Investor visas are valid for two, five, or ten years. The visa can be renewed if expired.

Can foreign nationals apply for a Dubai investor visa?

Foreign nationals can apply and fully own businesses in the Dubai mainland and free zones.

What are the benefits of holding an investor visa in Dubai?

As an investor visa holder, you enjoy the following benefits:

  • Residency
  • Business ownership
  • Family sponsorship
  • Banking access, and
  • Long-term stability.

What is the difference between an investor visa and a partner visa?

Investor Visa:

An investor visa suits sole owners.

Partner Visa:

A partner visa applies to shareholders in joint businesses.

title: The Requirements for Obtaining a Golden Visa in the UAE
content:

  • Renewal Requirements for the UAE Golden Visa
  • Tips for Meeting the Requirements of the UAE Golden Visa
  • FAQs
    • What are the eligibility requirements for a UAE Golden Visa?
    • Who can apply for a 10-year Golden Visa in the UAE?
    • What is the minimum investment needed for a Golden Visa?
    • Can family members be sponsored under the Golden Visa?
    • How long does Golden Visa processing take in the UAE?
    • Is a Golden Visa renewable after expiry?

Meeting the golden visa requirements and eligibility is practically a guarantee of obtaining the document. The authorities updated certain rules to make the requirements for this type of visa more flexible. In this way, applicants can fall into one of the categories that are now broader.

In this article, you will learn about the Dubai golden visa requirements and the other Emirates in the nation. Likewise, you will learn what the eligibility criteria are according to the categories, as well as the financial aspects of the procedure.

Understanding the Eligibility Criteria

Before talking about the golden visa requirements, you need to understand what this document in the UAE is all about. This is a long-term residence visa (5-10 years), which allows eligible individuals to live, study, or work in the country. Golden visa holders in the UAE can enjoy the following benefits:

  • Live in the country for the duration of the document, which can be 5 or 10 years.
  • You do not need a sponsor.
  • You can leave the country for more than 6 months without losing the validity of the visa.
  • Ability to sponsor domestic workers.
  • You can sponsor your family members, spouse, or children regardless of their ages.
  • If the holder dies, family members can remain in the country for the duration of the golden visa.

The authorities expanded the eligibility criteria so that people belonging to specific categories can apply. Applicants must meet the UAE golden visa requirements determined for each category. Below we will show you the categories allowed for applying for a golden visa in the United Arab Emirates:

Investors

Two types of investors can apply for a golden visa in the nation, investors in the public sector and real estate. In the first case, investors must do so in an investment fund with specific financial criteria. These investors must provide proof of health insurance and have full ownership of the invested capital.

On the other hand, real estate investors must have a property investment of at least AED 2,000,000. However, those who purchase a property with a loan from a local bank authorized by the local entity can obtain a golden visa.

Entrepreneurs

The golden visa requirements for entrepreneurs include possessing a technical or innovative risk-based economic project. However, you must have a letter of approval from the following people and authorities:

  • An auditor who certifies that the value of the project is not less than AED 500000.
  • Certification by the authorities of the emirate in which the investment will be made indicates that it is a technical or future project.
  • An incubator authorized to establish the activity that the entrepreneur has proposed.

Exceptional talents

Authorities also issue golden visas to exceptional talents, including inventors, innovators, and talents in certain fields. In the latter case, they include areas such as those we will mention below:

  • Culture
  • Art
  • Sports
  • Digital technology

Talents in these areas can apply for a visa regardless of their educational qualifications, professional level, employment status, or monthly salary. However, one of the golden visa requirements UAE for Exceptional Talents is the recommendation or approval of a federal or local government entity.

Researchers and scientists

Researchers and scientists with significant achievements or influence in their field also qualify to apply for a golden visa. However, in both cases, they must have the recommendation of the Scientific Council of the United Arab Emirates. Additionally, applicants must have a doctorate or master’s degree in engineering, technology, life sciences, or natural sciences.

Moreover, the degree must have been obtained from one of the best universities in the world and have significant achievements.

Professionals

Professionals or workers with high qualifications and sufficient experience and educational qualifications can apply for this visa. Next, we will show you the areas that fall within the category of professionals who want the golden visa:

  • Medicine
  • Science
  • Engineering
  • information technology
  • Business
  • Administration
  • Education
  • Right
  • Culture
  • Social Sciences

Applicants must have an employment contract and be within the first or second occupational level of the UAE. These levels are determined by the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratization (MOHRE), which regulates labor relations. Two of the golden visa requirements are that the applicant must have a minimum bachelor’s degree and a monthly salary of AED 30,000 or more.

Outstanding students and graduates

Excellent students in UAE secondary education (at least 95% average) are also eligible for this visa. Likewise, university students with high grades at a university classified by the Ministry of Education as A or B are calcified. The cumulative GPA of the university student must be at least 3.5 for class A and 3.8 for class B.

In addition, outstanding students from foreign universities can apply for the visa as long as the said university is among the 100 best in the world. However, they must have a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5 and must be no more than 2 years out of graduation.

Humanitarian pioneers

Humanitarian pioneers who meet the golden visa requirements Dubai or other Emirates can apply for it. In this case, these are distinguished members and employees of both international and regional charities. In both cases, they must have worked in said organizations for no less than 5 years.

Also, the authorities also include those who meet any of the following characteristics:

  • Prominent members and employees of civil associations and public interest institutions.
  • People who have received recognition from a local, regional, or international organization focused on humanitarian work.
  • Individuals funding humanitarian work worth not less than AED 2 million or its equivalent.

Frontline Heroes

In this category are people who do healthcare work or frontline workers. These workers must have helped in extraordinary circumstances, such as the recent COVID-19 pandemic. In this case, it includes nurses, physician assistants, laboratory technicians, pharmacologists, and personnel approved by the Office of Frontline Heroes.

Financial Requirements for the UAE Golden Visa

Golden visa requirements for certain eligible categories include those we will describe below:

  • Those making public investments must have a deposit or capital of at least AED 2000000. Make an annual payment to the Federal Tax Authority for a total amount of AED 250000.
  • Real estate investors must own one or more properties in the country with a minimum value of AED 2 million.
  • For investors, one of the UAE golden visa requirements is to have a project with a minimum value of AED 500000.

Exploring the Business Requirements for the UAE Golden Visa

Investors must meet the golden visa requirements that we will describe below:

  • To apply for a 10-year golden visa, the applicant must have a public investment of at least AED 10 million. In this case, it includes both investment funds and an investment in a company.
  • Similarly, business partners who contribute AED 10 million each can also extend the 10-year visa.
  • On the other hand, those who invest AED 5 million can obtain a golden visa with a validity of 5 years.
  • Another requirement is that individuals must keep the amount for 3 years, so they should not lend it.
  • Natural persons must also fully own the assets and must not have more than 60% in real estate.

Document Requirements for the UAE Golden Visa

The documents that you must submit when applying for a golden visa depend on the category. However, within the golden visa requirements common to each of those who fall within the eligibility criteria are:

  • Passport of the applicant
  • Emirates ID
  • Copy of visa
  • Photograph the same size as the passport
  • Title deed for property owners
  • Salary certificate
  • No Objection Company certificate for salaried workers
  • Professional and educational certifications
  • Audit reports for investors

In the same way, you must meet other essential requirements to be able to apply for the visa, which are:

  • Possess a valid health insurance policy
  • A valid residence in the UAE
  • Do not have considerable debts in the country

Academic and Professional Qualifications for the UAE Golden Visa

Golden visa requirements for some categories include the delivery of certificates of professional qualifications. Next, we will show you which categories require it and what certificates it requires:

  • Outstanding students who wish to obtain a golden visa must have a minimum grade of 95%, both in public and private secondary schools.
  • College students must have a GPA of at least 3.8 to apply for the visa.
  • For CEOs, the requirement is to have a bachelor’s degree.
  • Engineering and science majors must have a bachelor’s or master’s degree.

Sponsorship and Dependent Requirements for the UAE Golden Visa

The UAE Golden Visa allows holders to live, work, and study in the country for the duration of the visa. Plus, you can do it without having a job with a local company, so you can live without working in the country. It means that the visa holder can work for a local company or work independently without the need for a sponsor.

On the other hand, holders of this type of visa can sponsor their parents, spouses, children, and domestic workers. This means that those you sponsor will be able to live in the country for the same years that the visa of the holder lasts.

Step-by-Step Guide to Applying for the UAE Golden Visa

If you meet the golden visa requirements UAE you can start applying at some of the qualified entities. Therefore, we will show you the three possible methods to apply for a visa in the country:

Online application through the ICA

The online application process on the Federal Authority website for Identity and Citizenship (ICA) is as follows:

  1. Enter the official website of the ICA.
  2. Go to Golden Visa in the Public Services section.
  3. Next, select Visa to Complete the Golden Residency Procedures.
  4. Then, you must fill out all the requested information.
  5. Submit the documents that require the golden visa requirements.
  6. Lastly, pay the service fees.

Upon completing the process, you must wait for approval from the authorities to obtain your golden visa. However, if you are outside the UAE, the ICA will issue a 6-month entry permit (renewable for 6 more months) to complete the application procedures.

Online application on the GDRFA website

Upon meeting the Dubai golden visa requirements or in other Emirates, you can apply at the GDRFA. In this case, you can visit the website of the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs and follow the steps that we will indicate:

  1. Go to the GDRFA website.
  2. You will need to select the golden visa form from the list of services.
  3. Then, you must select Investor Residence Visa (Golden Visa).
  4. Select Start Service, provide the necessary information, and submit the documents.
  5. Next, pay the fees and wait for the authorities to contact you.

However, you can go to one of the authorized typing centers to have your request processed by professionals. If you meet the golden visa requirements, the authorities will send you a message and the original entry permit.

Property Ownership Requirements for the UAE Golden Visa

Owners of property or properties in the UAE can also obtain a renewable 5-year golden visa. Additionally, you will not need any sponsor but you must meet one of the following requirements:

  • Submit a letter from the Land Department of the emirate in which you are applying for the visa. In it, you must indicate the possession of one or more properties with a value that cannot be less than AED 2 million.
  • Buy a property using a loan from one of the banks approved by the competent local entity.

Renewal Requirements for the UAE Golden Visa

The renewal process for a golden visa allows you to extend it for the same period as the initial application. Below we offer 3 methods to request the renewal of the document:

GDRFA website

  1. Go to the GDRFA website or the smart application.
  2. Log in to the system using your username or a UAE Pass.
  3. Select the service (golden visa renewal).
  4. Then, complete the information requested by the system.
  5. Pay the applicable fees.

Customer Happiness Centers

  1. You will need to go to a customer happiness center in the relevant Emirate.
  2. Get an automated turn ticket and wait your turn.
  3. Submit the renewal application and documents to the customer service employee.
  4. Pay the fees

Amer Service Center

  1. Go to one of the Amer centers
  2. Get an automated turn ticket and wait your turn.
  3. Submit the renewal application and documents to the customer service employee.
  4. Pay the fees

Tips for Meeting the Requirements of the UAE Golden Visa

Obtaining this document is not difficult if you meet all the golden visa requirements based on the category you qualify for. This is one of the most requested visas due to all the benefits it grants to the holder of said document. Some of the things you can do to meet the requirements to obtain a golden visa are:

  • Be sure to check the requirements for the category you fit into.
  • You must have a passport with sufficient validity, so renew it if necessary.
  • Obtain the necessary educational qualifications and certify it with the relevant entity.
  • Verify that you have all the documents before starting the procedures so that there are no delays.

Obtaining one of these visas depends on meeting the golden visa requirements according to the eligibility category. This visa allows you to obtain great benefits, such as sponsoring your family, working in the UAE, or enjoying the convenience of living in the country. If you have any questions or would like to consult us about employment issues in the UAE, you can contact us.

FAQs

What are the eligibility requirements for a UAE Golden Visa?

Investors, professionals, entrepreneurs, and exceptional talents qualify.

Who can apply for a 10-year Golden Visa in the UAE?

High-value investors, scientists, executives, and specialized professionals.

What is the minimum investment needed for a Golden Visa?

Property or business investments meeting government-set thresholds qualify.

Can family members be sponsored under the Golden Visa?

Yes, spouse, children, and dependents can be sponsored.

How long does Golden Visa processing take in the UAE?

Processing usually takes two to four weeks.

Is a Golden Visa renewable after expiry?

Yes, renewal is allowed if eligibility conditions continue.

mainEntity.name: What are the eligibility requirements for a UAE Golden Visa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eligibility for the UAE Golden Visa includes investors (public or real estate), entrepreneurs, exceptional talents (scientists, artists), and skilled professionals. In 2026, the criteria expanded to include AI specialists, long-serving nurses (15+ years), experienced educators, and content creators through specific recognition programs like Dubai’s Creators HQ.

mainEntity.name: Who can apply for a 10-year Golden Visa in the UAE?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 10-year residency is available to high-value investors with AED 2 million in public investments, specialized talents with endorsements (like scientists or doctors), C-suite executives with a salary above AED 30,000-50,000, and outstanding graduates from top global or local universities.

mainEntity.name: What is the minimum investment needed for a Golden Visa?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a 10-year property investor visa, a minimum investment of AED 2 million in one or more properties is required. For entrepreneurs, having a startup with annual revenues of at least AED 1 million or a project value of AED 500,000 can qualify for a 5-year Golden Visa.

mainEntity.name: Can family members be sponsored under the Golden Visa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Golden Visa holders can sponsor their spouse and children regardless of the children's age. They can also sponsor unlimited domestic helpers. In the event of the primary holder's death, family members can remain in the UAE until the end of their visa duration.

mainEntity.name: How long does Golden Visa processing take in the UAE?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard processing typically takes 2 to 4 weeks. However, in 2026, many categories can receive an initial 'Approval in Principle' much faster, and applicants can use a 180-day multiple-entry permit to complete the final medical and biometrics within the UAE.

mainEntity.name: Is a Golden Visa renewable after expiry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the Golden Visa is renewable for another 5 or 10-year term as long as the holder continues to meet the original eligibility criteria, such as maintaining the required investment or professional status.
