Starting a business in the United Arab Emirates is a fairly simple process. However, it is necessary that you comply all the regulations that the country has. Depending on the activity you want to carry out in the UAE, you must choose between several types of licenses to be able to operate legally, these can be: Professional, commercial, industrial, or a tourism license. Today, we will talk about the difference between the professional license and the commercial license.

In this article, you will find information about what these licenses are, who can acquire them, what is the difference between the professional license and the commercial license, and more. Let us see:

  1. What is the DED professional license?
  2. Who can acquire this license?
  3. Benefits of the DED professional license
  4. What is a UAE commercial license?
  5. Who can acquire a UAE commercial license?
  6. Benefits of the commercial license
  7. How to obtain these licenses?
  8. Differences between the professional license and the commercial license
  9. How can we help you obtain a license in the UAE?

1. What is the DED professional license?

 

A professional license is an official document of the United Arab Emirates and is authorized by the Department of Economic Development (DED). It was created for those individuals interested in offering a professional service based on some physical or mental ability that allows them to generate an income.

Some of the industries where you can generate income with this license are the following:

  • Auditing
  • Engineering consultancy
  • Business setup consultancy services
  • Medical and educational services
  • Crafting and designing of products
  • Accounting

2. Who can acquire this license?

Those professionals who offer services such as designing, tourism guidance, research, or any other service based on experience, talent, or ability, must apply for one of these licenses at the Department of Economic Development (DED).

By having a professional license, you can legally operate and offer your services to anyone in the UAE. And also, you have the power to undertake the activities depending on your qualifications or your area of ​​expertise.

Take into account that dedicating yourself to a professional service requires skills, intellectual abilities, talent, and experience to carry out certain projects and tasks. And meet the expectations and quality margins of the country’s authorities and your customers.

It must be remembered that even if the professional license allows you to run a large number of services, certain tasks will require authorization or approval from other authorities. These authorities are established in each Emirate of the country and their objective is to maintain security, reinforce rules, manage industry standards and ensure that services are only offered by authorized professionals who are governed by the laws defined by the corresponding Ministry.

3. Benefits of the DED professional license

3.1 Diversity of activities

This type of license is not exclusive to a group of companies or businesses. On the contrary, it offers great diversity when choosing which activity you want to do. The list of activities offered by the DED increases every day, which is why more people are inclined to acquire a professional license.

If you are a new entrepreneur and you have an idea to form a company, it is most likely that your idea is on the list of activities accepted by the authorities. You should keep in mind that even if the authority accepts an activity, you still need to go through the approval process.

For example, if you want to offer training services, your company must have the necessary materials, such as whiteboards, screens, projectors, among others. And enough space to carry out the training process.

3.2 Cost-effective approach

Purchasing a professional license will be very helpful if you want to save money in the long run. This license will allow you to establish your company in any area of ​​Dubai and the United Arab Emirates, which means zero ties to any special authority. Basically, you will have the freedom of a Limited Liability Company.

In addition to this, many businesses that are just starting see co-working spaces as a viable option. This will allow them to have an efficient work area while minimizing the costs of running a company. Currently, the market fee when renting an office is 2.5 percent, which makes this option the cheapest.

3.3 Adaptable market

This license allows entrepreneurs to maintain 100% ownership of their company when carrying out commercial activities in the UAE. Also, you can carry out your daily operations without needing the presence of a local shareholding party.

In addition to this, with this license, you can do business with different clients, in different markets. You will be able to offer your services and to make contract with other companies as well (this includes educational institutions and government-related agencies)

4. What is a UAE commercial license?

 

Basically, a commercial license is an official document that allows you to trade almost any product you can imagine. From toys and jewelry to electronics, food, and packaging. Also, you can trade services under a commercial license, for example, brokerage and real estate services.

This license is issued by the Department of Economic Development and the products you trade may be exported for sale outside the UAE, imported and sold in the country, or traded solely within the United Arab Emirates.

5. Who can acquire a UAE commercial license?

Obtaining this license means being able to work in different sectors of the economy, for example:

  • Auto trading
  • Import/export
  • Self storage services
  • General store
  • Rental services
  • General warehousing
  • Restaurant management
  • Tv station, radio, cinema theater equipment installation and maintenance
  • Shoe trading
  • Plumbing and sanitary contracting

These are some of the activities that individuals in the United Arab Emirates can do. However, you can see the full list of permitted activities at the Department of Economic Development, or you can check with a company setup specialist, such as Connect Zone.

6. Benefits of the commercial license

Some entrepreneurs are unaware that having a commercial license can bring multiple personal and corporate benefits. Some of these are the following:

  • If you decide to establish a company in a free zone and acquire this license, you will be able to enjoy unique incentives from that zone. For example, tax exemptions and free repatriation of income to the entrepreneur’s home country.
  • Companies applying for this license are free to establish their headquarters in any part of Dubai.
  • With the commerce license you can import and export a wide variety of products.
  • Having this document makes it easier to obtain work visas for foreign nationals.
  • Companies that have this license will not have to carry out audits to extend their licenses.

Commercial licenses allow entrepreneurs who established their company in the United Arab Emirates to carry out their operations and sell services and products throughout the country as well as internationally. One of the lesser-known aspects of this document is that it facilitates international employee visa admission. In this way, businesses can recruit a greater number of foreign workers.

7. How to obtain these licenses?

The process to acquire these licenses is quite simple and consists of the following steps:

7.1 Mainland or Free Zone

One of the most important decisions you have to make is the location of your company. Both options offer incentives unique to the area. For example, at Fujairah Creative Zone you can enjoy a quick incorporation setup and zero currency restrictions.

There are several types of licenses in the free zones, for example, industrial, commercial, professional, and e-commerce services. On the other hand, you will also find a wide variety of licenses on the Mainland. Companies established here can do business directly with the UAE market and enter into lucrative contracts with the government.

The right setup for you will depend on the nature of your company. A business formation expert, like Connect Zone, can help you make this decision.

7.2 Your company name

Choosing the name of your company is extremely important when registering a UAE business. For this reason, there are certain conditions that you must take into account before choosing the name. Firstly, the name must be governed by the moral values ​​of the United Arab Emirates society, secondly, it cannot be registered by another company or organization and thirdly, it cannot have any type of relationship with any government entity or religious deity.

7.3 License application

Once you have chosen the place, the name, and the type of productive activity of your company, it is time to apply for your license. To do so you must submit some documents and deliver them to the Department of Economic Development on the Mainland. On the other hand, if you decided to establish your company in a free zone, then you should approach the relevant authority in that zone.

In any case, it is always a good idea to have the services of a company formation specialist at this stage to ensure a successful outcome.

7.4 Required documents

Whether you are carrying out the application process on your own or through a company formation agent, the documents that you must deliver to the authorities are the following:

  • Memorandum of Association (MoA)
  • Duly filled application form.
  • Fee-receipt.
  • Permit from Dubai Municipality’s Building Department allowing the business to use the office space as a business address.
  • Passport copies of the shareholders
  • Original lease contract of the company’s register address

8. Differences between the professional license and the commercial license

8.1 Commercial license

As shown above, the commercial license allows a company to carry out trading activities. It is the most basic license available and covers a wide variety of tangible and available commodities such as real estate, hardware, general trading, clothes, construction, etc.

A commercial license is used by those companies that want to have more than ten commercial activities in a single license. Foreign entrepreneurs who have this license can only own 49% of the shares of the company on the Mainland. Also, the company has limited liability, which means that it obtains the suffix LLC.

From a strategic point of view, this license has multiple benefits, including tax benefits (low VAT, zero corporate and income tax), visa allocation for employees and their dependents, and also a supportive business ecosystem and international trading scene.

In Dubai, the minimum paid-up capital for a commercial license is AED 300,000

8.2 Professional license

Meanwhile, the professional license is more aimed at those individuals whose goal is certain special practices that fit into their educational attainment and craftsmanship. This license is service-oriented, which means that the same individuals provide the service. Customers pay for their craft because they have the experience to do it or because they have a license.

Contrary to a commercial license, foreign entrepreneurs can maintain 100% ownership of their company under a professional license. Also, the owner or professional has unlimited liability on the company. This is a main difference between the professional license and the commercial license.

If an entrepreneur wants to engage in consultancy activities, they must acquire a professional license. However, if a professional want to trade products or goods that they have made, they must then obtain a commercial license.

By having this type of license, the professional must pay a fixed annual fee for their license. Also, the official regulations of the United Arab Emirates require that the entrepreneur be completely transparent when dealing with clients. Moreover, they are eligible to apply for a residence visa in the UAE.

The minimum paid-up capital for a professional license is AED 150,000.

Although the difference between the professional license and the commercial license is notorious, both are very effective when it comes to establishing a business. If you want to succeed in this country, choosing a license that suits the essence of your company is the most important thing.

9. How can we help you obtain a license in the UAE?

With more than twenty years of experience, we have helped hundreds of clients to successfully establish their companies. We are the ideal partner to guide you through each step of this process.

At Connect Zone, we will take care of applying for the perfect license for your business model. Also, with us, your visa processing will be easy and safe. Additionally, we help you choose a place for your office in one of the best business centers.

 

Are you interested in learning more about us and the services we offer? You can contact us at the following number +971 43 316 688 or by writing an email to contact@connectzone.ae. Where one of our representatives will assist you shortly.

If you want to work with us or apply for a wide range of job opportunities, you can start sending applications through thetalentpoint.com. You can also send an email with your resume attached to contact@thetalentpoint.com. You do not have to worry; we will not save or share your information.

FAQs

What is the difference between professional and commercial license?

A professional license lets you offer services or skills (consulting, freelancing). A commercial license lets you buy, sell, and trade goods and products.

Which license is better for consultants?

A professional license is best for consultants because it’s made for service‑based work.

Can trading be done with a professional license?

No. A professional license does not allow buying and selling goods. For trading, you need a commercial license.

Is visa eligibility same for both licenses?

Yes. Both license types allow you to sponsor UAE resident visas if you meet the requirements.

Can license type be changed later?

Yes. You can change from one license type to another by updating your trade license with the relevant authority and meeting requirements.

Which license is cheaper in the UAE?

A professional license is generally cheaper than a commercial license because it has lower fees and fewer requirements.

title: Emirates ID – Everything You Need to Know
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle

    • How long does it take to process an Emirates ID?
    • How to renew an Emirates ID in the UAE?
    • How to replace a lost Emirates ID?
    • How to check Emirates ID status online?

The Emirates document ID is a mandatory card for UAE residents and citizens and is issued by the ICA (Federal Authority for Identify and Citizenship). This physical identification card must be carried by all citizens and residents all the time. However, the National Identity Institute recently announced a new digital/electronic version of the card while applicants wait for their physical card.

In this article, you will learn everything regarding how to get an E-version of the Emirates ID and the step-by-step procedure. Similarly, by the time you finish reading, you will understand the benefits and who can apply for this ID in Dubai and the UAE. In other words, the new identification document has additional electronic and visual features that will stop identity fraud in the country.

1. What is an Emirates ID?

It is the main resident card and identification for all UAE residents and citizens. It is a national database that holds all residents’ information and it is mandatory to be carried at all times. The Emirates Identification Authority (EIDA) is the government body in charge of issuing the identification card.

Likewise, this identification card has an electronic chip that contains all important information about the resident such as, fingerprints or biometric data, basic details and the photo. Residents can use the card in plenty of transactions such as paying fines, registering vehicles, and paying phone and internet bills.

Similarly, the UAE government is planning that the emirates ID takes the place of the residents’ driving license and debit card. In the year 2016, the Emirates identification card replaced health insurance cards.

Establishing in the country doesn’t have to be a complex process, we have an article on how to start a company in the UAE.

Read More About : How to Get a5 Year Multiple Entry Tourist Visa UAE

2. How to get your electronic Emirates ID in 3 steps

In early August of 2021, the UAE government presented a new generation of Emirates ID cards. This new generation of cards includes the date of birth of the holder, enhanced protection of the holder’s ‘non-visible information’, a 3D picture and a longer validity period of 10 years.

The new generation of emirates ID will also have additional data such as employment information.

The Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship has begun issuing the new advanced version of the Emirates ID. However, you can use the electronic version of your physical ID on the ICA smart app, the app is totally free to download on Android and iOS stores. Similarly, UAE residents can use this electronic version for all government services and it is valid like its physical version.

That is to say, the ICA has organized with all business and service providers, as well as the authorities concerned to offer their services based on the new version of the Emirates ID.

The Federal Authority made a tweet about the new phase of upgrading all national identity documents, “according to the transition to the new generation of passports and identity cards”. There are three steps to get a new electronic identification card:

  1. Download the ICA app via iOS or Android.
  2. Scan the QR code to generate an electronic card in your document wallet in the app.
  3. Use the e-version of the identification card for all UAE services.

3. Is the digital version of the Emirates ID free?

The digital and electronic version of it is available for free on the Federal Authority for Identify and Citizenship website. Likewise, it is available on both Android and iOS devices.

4. Is the e-version of the Emirates ID legal?

This new version of the Emirates identification ID in Dubai and the UAE is valid for all institutions and all government-related services that require the physical Emirates ID. This process of getting an e-version of the identification card is simple and is available for free on any device.

However, the it is an important identification for both UAE nationals and residents. You can also check the status of your card process online. Having an emirates ID has several advantages such as opening a bank account, apply for a Dubai driver’s license, secure a home internet package, etc.

In case you want to keep learning, we have a guide on opening a Dubai Trading Company in Dubai.

5. How to acquire an Emirates ID card?

Individuals who want to obtain an Emirates ID card as a UAE national, GCC national or ex-pat will realize that is an easy-to-follow procedure. The government is trying to make the process as simple as possible so more and more people apply for it and bond to the process of an innovative future in Dubai and across the UAE.

Companies sponsoring ex-pats (not including GCC nationals) can apply for acquiring the Emirates ID by themselves.

Application: Individuals who want to obtain the Emirates ID card must complete the application form. Applicants can complete the application at an approved typing office or online.

EIDA: at the EIDA office you must fulfill standard information such as photos and fingerprints. After that, they will give you a receipt that you must keep in order to collect your ID when is ready.

After the application form has been submitted, applicants receive an SMS on their phones. This message will set a time and date, as well as the EIDA branch you must visit.

After that, will need the following documents:

For UAE nationals:

  • Family book.
  • Valid passport.
  • Emirates ID application.

For UAE Residents:

  • Passport
  • Work permit or visa
  • Emirates ID application.

Fee: AED100 annually.

Tracking: you can track your application process on EIDA’s website by typing the account number.

Delivery and collection: the EIDA will send the emirates ID card to the applicant’s local post office. Similarly, although you can check the process status online, the EIDA will send an SMS to your phone.

Most importantly, applicants must collect their IDs in a 90 days period or it will be discarded by the EIDA.

Renewal: when your ID card expires, you must follow the same process all over again.

6. Things to know about the Emirates ID

  • Carry your card: as we mentioned earlier, it is mandatory for all UAE residents and nationals to carry their identification ID all the time. Not carrying it can lead to legal mishaps.
  • Lost identification card: since carrying your Emirates ID card is a mandatory requirement and you must carry it all the time; you need to replace it as soon as possible in case you lost it.
  • Changing your name: if holders get married and change their name, they must notify the EIDA.
  • Children: all Dubai and UAE citizens must have a valid Emirate ID; including newborns and children.
  • Wrong details: if you realize that any of your printed information is wrong, you must visit an EIDA office and correct the details.

7. How to renew your identification ID?

All Emirates ID has their own expiration date, this depends on the validity period of the card. For example, all UAE residents and citizens have a month from their expiration date to renew their card. After this period, they risk a fine of 20AED every day. This fine can accumulate up to 1,000AED.

UAE nationals are usually requested to renew their ID 30 days before the card expires. This is different with ex-pats, since they only can apply once their card expired.

The process of renewing is the same as the first application which was first processed. ID holders can renew online or through any of the typing centers.

These are the renewal rates based on their validity period:

  • 1 Year: 290 AED.
  • 2 Year: 390 AED.
  • 3 Year: 490 AED.

8. Documents required for renewal

All documents required for the renewal of the Emirates identification card are the same as the first application process. However, the only additional thing you need in this case is that you must hand in your old Emirates ID card. This applies to all UAE citizens and residents as well as GCC residents.

In other words, ex-pats instead of showing their entry permit, they must hand in their residency visa under the renewal process while applying for the identification ID renewal.

The textile industry is one of the most important in the country, learn how to start a business of this type.

9. Losing your emirates ID card

The UAE government has also given guidance if you’re your Emirates ID has been, stolen, damaged, or if you lost it. There are some basic procedures you must follow if any of the previously mentioned mishaps happens to you.

  • Firstly, the holder must report that has been lost or stolen. Therefore, this event will be reported to the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship and your identification card will be deactivated at once.
  • Secondly, if the holder lost the card outside the country; you must inform the UAE embassy.
  • The cardholder must apply for a replacement card and follow the previously mentioned process.
  • After that, the cardholders must pay all the necessary fees and their card EIDA will issue within 2 days.

10. How can Connect Zone provide you with an electronic version of the Emirates ID?

Now that you know why the e-version of the Emirates ID is so innovative and important for UAE citizens and residents. And in case you decided to apply for one, you should find a business partner that helps you in this process. A good partner will make this process smooth and hassle-free.

However, ConnectZone is the best option when you are trying to settle your company in the UAE. We offer you a massive list of options in all the Emirates whether you are looking to settle in:

  • Mainland.
  • Free zone.
  • Offshore.

Ou packages including general special discounts, group visa packages, and multi-year deals.

We work side-by-side with local authorities and government departments across the UAE; our vast market knowledge that helps all types of companies in different industries in the UAE to grow. Connect Zone is part of Connect Group; we have other services that assist companies such as bank account opening, PRO services, and others.

We have more than 22 years of experience and we will guide you and your company throughout every step and we will assist you in any way you need.

After you get the e-version of the Emirates ID, you may want to request our services to boost your business’s growth. In addition, in case you want to improve your HR department, you can ask for HR consultancy and payroll services.

Would you like to contact us to get the useful tips and information about the e-version of the Emirates ID?

You can email us at contact@connectzone.ae or visit our website to obtain more information. Similarly, feel free to contact us any time you want if you want to request any of our services by calling us on +971 4331 6688.

FAQs

How to apply for an Emirates ID in the UAE?

You should apply for your Emirates ID in the UAE through ICP after your visa has been issued.

How long does it take to process an Emirates ID?

It will take a few days for your Emirates ID to be processed.

How to renew an Emirates ID in the UAE?

You should renew your Emirates ID online before it expires.

How to replace a lost Emirates ID?

For replacing your lost Emirates ID, you can apply for its replacement through ICP services.

How to check Emirates ID status online?

You can use the ICP website or mobile app for checking your Emirates ID status online.

title: How to Get a 5 Year Multiple Entry Tourist Visa UAE : A complete guide
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle

    • 5. What documents do you need?
    • 6. Things to know before you apply for the visa
    • 7. Can the visa be rejected?
    • 8. How can Connect Zone help you get 5-year multiple entry tourist visa?
  • FAQs
    • What is a 5‑year multiple-entry tourist visa for UAE?
    • Who is eligible for 5‑year UAE tourist visa?

    • How to apply for a 5‑year tourist visa UAE?
    • Can family members apply under this visa?
    • Is medical insurance required for 5‑year visa?

Would you like to visit the UAE on a regular basis? Whether it is to visit your friends and family or to do some tourism around the beautiful sceneries that the emirates offer, you can now apply for a 5-year multiple entry tourist visa UAE.

This visa is especially for those individuals who are not eligible for visa on arrival or a visa-free entry to the UAE. Being one of the topmost countries to undergo the largest number of tourists every year, the United Arab Emirates has even larger policies when it comes to visas.

 

In this article, you will learn everything you should know about the 5-year multiple entry tourist visa in the UAE, such as its purpose, cost and the necessary requisites and documents. Let’s observe:

  1. What’s a 5-year multiple-entry tourist visa?
  2. What’s the cost for a 5-year multiple entry visa?
  3. Is the visa open to all nationalities?
  4. How to apply for it?
  5. What documents do you need?
  6. Things to know before you apply for the visa
  7. Can the visa be rejected?
  8. How can Connect Zone help you get a 5-year multiple entry visa?

1. What’s a 5-Year Multiple Entry Tourist Visa UAE?

Stunning landscapes and sophisticated structures are things that characterize the United Arab Emirates. Certainly, it’s one of the most attractive destinations for those who love to travel and get to know new cultures.

But of course, in order to do this, it is necessary to obtain a special type of visa that adjusts to your needs. Recently, the immigration department in the United Arab Emirates has opened the applications for the 5-year multiple-entry tourist visas in order for visitors to enter the country.

In other words, this visa allows tourists to visit the UAE multiple times and remain in the country for 90 days on each visit. However, it is possible to extend this visa for another 90 days in case the tourist wishes so.

 

On the other hand, this extension does not apply to the following groups:

  • Tourists or visitors who are residents in GCC countries.
  • Residents who are accompanying GCC nationals.
  • Individuals on special entry permits
  • Individuals on 96-hour permits for special missions.

Depending on your plan, tourism visas to the UAE can be issued for 30 days or 90 days of duration, whether they are single entry or multiple entry.

It is possible to extend all types of visit and tourist visas can be extended for 30 days two times. For this, it is necessary to apply for it and obtain successful authorization from the relevant authority.

 

2. What’s the cost for a 5 Year Multiple Entry Visa?

Applying for the 5-year multiple entry tourist visa UAE has a cost of AED 650. It is necessary to realize this payment on the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship (also called ICA) webpage. Additionally, if you wish to renew or extend your visa, the cost will be AED 600 for every renewal.

Nevertheless, those individuals whose visa has expired and do not renew it will have to pay a fine. The cost of this will be of AED 100 for each day of their overstay.

3. Is the visa open to all nationalities?

In an effort of the UAE government to boost international relationships and tourism, the 5-year multiple entry tourist visa is available to all nationalities. However, there are certain requisites to be eligible for it.

For instance, female individuals who are under the age of 18 cannot apply for this type of visa unless they are traveling to the UAE along with their parents.

On the other hand, a lot of people in the UAE will benefit from this special kind of visa. For example, UAE nationals who possess a residency visa and live abroad won’t have to return to the UAE every six months in order to keep their residency visas valid.

In the case of tourism, people around the world will be able to travel to the UAE more straightforwardly. Business trips to the UAE will be more straightforward and increase the production and economy of the United Arab Emirates.

Read More About : Opening a General Trading Company in Dubai

4. How to Apply for it?

Those interested in applying for a 5-year multiple-entry tourist visa in the UAE can apply directly on the ICA webpage. Without a doubt, this process can be long and tedious taking into account all the steps in the middle. Even as a tourist, traveling comes along with a pile of paperwork, requirements and legal regulations. Sometimes it may take almost a month to complete all formalities.

If you are looking for sincere, skilled and economic UAE visa services providers or you wish to get assistance and make this procedure more efficient, you should contact us on Connect Zone.

Namely, there are a series of steps to start the application process, such as:

  1. Upload your application data. This includes your name, address within the UAE, address outside the UAE and service beneficiary details of the individual.
  2. Submit the requested attachments. Include a photo in color, copy of the passport, medical insurance, and bank statement for the last six months. Applicants must have a balance of USD 4,000 or its corresponding equivalent in their currency in the last six months.
  3. Review the application thoroughly and correct in case there is any mistake.
  4. Pay the corresponding fee for the application.
  5. Wait until the visa is ready, it will be delivered via your registered email.

5. What documents do you need?

It is necessary to mention that the requested documents may change depending on if you have a sponsor or not. In order to apply for the 5-year multiple entry tourist visa, it is necessary to hand out the following documents:

  • Sponsored Passport
  • Sponsored Personal Photo
  • Receipt of bank guarantee refund
  • Health Insurance card
  • Salary Certificate
  • PRO card / delegate letter
  • Consanguinity Proof
  • Sponsor Passport
  • Labor Contract
  • Establishment Card
  • Partnership Contract

Read More About : How to Start a Business in Dubai UAE.

6. Things to know before you apply for the visa

There are certain conditions that may affect your eligibility for the 5-year multiple entry tourist visa.

For instance, entrepreneurs must have an existing project with a minimum capital of AED 500,000 or receive the authorization of a recognized business incubator in the UAE. Also, this visa allows entrepreneurs to include the spouse and children, a partner and three executives in the visa.

In addition to this, there are several travel experts that are in agreement that this new type of visa is aiming to make it easier for UAE nationals to bring their relatives to visit the country. This process was certainly very complex on the previously obtainable tourist visas.

Furthermore, some people have also ventured that the market for investment in traveler apartments in the UAE will flourish now that it will be possible for citizens from abroad to occupy more time in the country.

On the other hand, regarding to how many days prior to your travel you should apply for the visa, this varies depending on the visa you will apply for. Even though occasionally the visa requires to be applied 30 days in advance to the date of the travel, in certain cases it becomes necessary to apply for it at least 2 months in advance to the aforementioned date.

7. Can the visa be rejected?

Applying for any type visa is a complex process most of the time and it requires you to submit an application form and provide the documents required by the respective government of the country you are traveling to. While it may appear like a straightforward process, there are times when the visa may be rejected.

For example, some of the reasons why your 5-year multiple entry tourist visa may be:

  • The applicant possessed a residence visa in the past and left the UAE without cancelling visa beforehand.
  • The individual handed in a hand written passport (These kinds of passports will get rejected automatically by the UAE Immigration)
  • If the applicant possesses a record with a previous criminal offence, fraud or misbehavior perpetrated in the UAE.
  • The visa applicant had applied previously for a tourist visa but did not enter the United Arab Emirates in the stipulated time. This condition applies as well for employment visas.
  • The visa application form contained typo errors in the name, passport number, profession code, etc. This may cause either a delay in getting the authorization or the automatic rejection of the visa.
  • The photos in the copies of the passport provided to the UAE immigration system are not clear or are blurred. In the same way as in the aforementioned point, this could cause o delay in the approval or automatic rejection.

It should be noted that if your visa is rejected, the application fees paid will not be refunded to the applicant; only the security deposit (if there is any) will be refunded.

Furthermore, the UAE may or may not provide a reason as to why your visa applications was rejected, since the government is not mandated to do so. The visa is approved to the applicant at the private discretion of the government.

content:
Table of Contents

Toggle

  • Benefits of Joining a Startup Incubator or Accelerator

    • What are startup incubators in Dubai?
    • How do startup incubators help new businesses?
    • Who can apply for startup incubator programs in Dubai?
    • Are startup incubators in Dubai government-supported?
    • What benefits do incubators offer to entrepreneurs?
    • How long do startup incubator programs last?

Dubai is a center of innovation and entrepreneurship, being one of the most cosmopolitan and dynamic cities in the world. With a diverse, young, and highly educated population, Dubai offers an ideal environment for startups who want to scale and grow their businesses. One of the best ways to take advantage of the opportunities of this city is to participate in a startup incubators Dubai program. These programs are to offer support, guidance, financing, and access to a network of contacts for startups. Especially, they want to develop their ideas and turn them into viable solutions for the market.

In this article, we present you a complete guide on startup incubators Dubai. The idea is to explain what they are, how they work, and what the benefits are of participating in one of them. In addition, we will give you some advice on how to choose the ideal one for your project. We also show you some of the best examples of startup incubators Dubai that currently exist and how to apply. If you have an innovative business idea and want to put it into practice in Dubai, this article is for you. Read on and discover everything you need to know about startup incubators Dubai.

Role of Startup Incubators Dubai’s Startup Ecosystem

Startup incubators Dubai play a crucial role in fostering innovation. In addition, it supports the growth of companies in their early stages. These companies provide a conducive environment for new companies to develop their ideas. They can also access resources and receive mentorship from experienced professionals. Below, you will see the different ways startup incubators can contribute to the thriving startup ecosystem.

Provide mentoring and guidance: One of the main functions of a startup incubator Dubai is to offer mentoring and guidance to the founders. Generally, incubators have a network of industry-expert entrepreneurs and investors. All of them are willing to share their knowledge and provide valuable ideas.

Access to essential resources: A startup incubator Dubai provides startups with access to a wide range of resources that would otherwise be difficult to obtain. For example, office space, legal and accounting services, equipment, marketing support, and financing opportunities.

Create a supportive community: If you are part of a startup incubator Dubai it means that you are part of a supportive community of people. Especially, those who are like-minded in facing similar challenges. This community aspect encourages knowledge-sharing, collaboration, and networking opportunities. Any startup can learn from the experiences of others, exchange ideas, and form partnerships.

Credibility and validation: Being part of a reputable startup incubator can provide credibility and validation. Especially, in the eyes of potential investors, clients, and partners. The selection process that many incubators have acts as a seal of approval, indicating that the startup has potential. In addition, it gives security that it is worth investing in that company. This validation results in significantly increasing a startup’s chances of attracting customers and obtaining funding.

Understanding Startup Incubators and Accelerators

To thrive in the startup ecosystem, a complete understanding is a must. The startup ecosystem is the network of organizations, resources, and individuals that support the development and growth of new businesses. This ecosystem provides an essential role in accelerating and fostering the success of startups. Specifically, because they are given access to mentorship, funding, networking opportunities, and other valuable resources.

A key aspect of the startup ecosystem is the presence of startup incubators in Dubai. These organizations aim to support startups in their initial stages. Especially, providing them with mentorship, a nurturing environment, and access to a network of experts and investors. Startup incubators typically provide a variety of services. For instance, business development support, office space, networking events, and more.

To better understand the startup ecosystem, we will provide you with some interesting tips.

Research and stay updated: The startup ecosystem is constantly evolving. That is, new technologies, trends, and financing opportunities periodically emerge. This is why you have to constantly research industry news. For this, you can attend conferences and interact with the startup community.

Network strategically: Building a strong network is essential for success in the startup ecosystem. To do this, you have to attend industry events, join communities on relevant lines, and look for mentoring opportunities. You need to surround yourself with experienced investors and entrepreneurs who can provide you with valuable knowledge and connections.

Understand the funding landscape: In startup growth, funding is a critical factor. You have to familiarize yourself with the different financing options for companies. For example, venture capital firms, government grants, and angel investors. In addition, knowing where to find financing and how to present your new company. Thus, you can significantly increase the chances of success of your startup.

Benefits of Joining a Startup Incubator or Accelerator

Among the key benefits of joining a startup incubator Dubai is the opportunity to receive expert guidance and mentoring from professionals in the sector. Generally, incubators have a network of entrepreneurs, advisors, and investors who are dedicated to helping startups succeed. These counselors can share experiences and provide valuable knowledge.

In addition, it offers guidance on various aspects of managing a company. For example, product development, fundraising, marketing strategies, expanding operations, and more.

Next, we will give you more details about the benefits of hiring a startup incubator Dubai.

Networking opportunities: If you are part of a startup incubator you will have the option to open the doors to a wide range of networking opportunities. Incubators typically bring together like-minded entrepreneurs who are at similar stages of their startup journey. As a result, collaboration, and exchange of ideas and knowledge will be encouraged.

Startups have to learn from the failures and successes of others. In addition, in the future form associations or collaborations.

Access to investment and financing opportunities: In the growth of companies it is essential to obtain financing. Startup incubators Dubai can play a vital role in connecting startups with potential investments. Today, incubators have relationships with venture capitalists, angel investors, and other funding sources.

If you are part of an incubator, startups have access to these networks. As a result, the possibilities of obtaining investments. Additionally, some of the startup incubators Dubai can provide seed funding to emerging companies.

Dubai’s Top Incubators and Accelerators

If you are starting a business in Dubai, you must understand that there are several incubators and accelerators in Dubai. For this reason, choosing among the best startup incubators in Dubai will be essential for you. Below you will see a list of the best incubators in Dubai to make your startup successful:

Faster Capital: This is a startup incubator and accelerator located in Dubai. In addition, it has two startup programs, one is Idea to Product and the other is Grow Your Startup. In this way, the first program helps founders develop their MVPs and discover ways to make money. On the other hand, the second program is an accelerator that helps companies grow by investing in marketing.

Intelak: This is a major startup hub located in the UAE and is focused on industries such as aviation, tourism, and travel. In addition, it has an incubator for early stages and an accelerator for late stages. Companies helping to fund both programs include Emirates, Microsoft, and Accenture.

Hub71: Was created by the Abu Dhabi government to help technology companies. In this way, they hope to promote the growth of technology companies.

TURN8: This is an international venture capital firm. Among the different industries in which they work, we can find artificial intelligence, health technology, smart cities, and many others.

Area 2071: Encourages the world’s talents to establish and develop their businesses in the UAE. Thus, companies that want to establish their presence in the 2071 area must first obtain authorization from the Dubai Future Foundation Program.

Incubation Process

A Dubai startup incubator follows a process so that it can be successful. For this reason, we will present the process carried out by a startup incubator:

  • Plan the business: Here the viability of your idea is evaluated. From understanding all the needs your business wants to address, to how it can manifest itself in reality. Also, the type of people you are looking to connect with and the geographies. All aspects of feasibility and viability are evaluated and documented in a clear plan.
  • Launch the business: The next step involves establishing a business license. In this part you must identify which legal structure is correct, the correct business activities that fit your business plan, and the location to establish your business. In this way, you will need services such as:
    • Marketing consulting.
    • PRO Services.
    • Help with regulatory compliance.
    • Opening of a bank account.
  • Manage the business: When you have established the company, you will need the right operational support from the incubation services company. These may include training your staff, developing your brand awareness, developing your lead generation mechanism, and most importantly, converting efforts into measurable revenue.
  • Growing the business: The final stage involves obtaining financing, expanding the business, or growing the product or service lines your company offers.

Conclusion

Doing business in Dubai is one of the best ideas for investors who want to establish their business in a good environment. For this reason, we find many startup incubators Dubai that offer access to many services. Among these, we can find financing, mentors, and resources.

According to studies, startups currently represent 50% of the companies registered in the emirate, while they employ half of its workforce. In addition, we find different incubators and accelerators in Dubai. For instance, Faster Capital, Intelak, Hub71, TURN8, and Area 2071.

Thanks to this, you will be able to find a wide variety of incubators that adapt to the needs of your company. Additionally, you can choose the one that best suits your company and have the help of experts in the industry. In this way, you will be able to have the support of a team of experts who will guarantee the growth of your company.

In summary, Dubai is the ideal place for all people who decide to start a business in a favorable environment. Additionally, you can count on the help of incubators who are willing to guide you and contribute throughout the incubation process and even after it. For this reason, if you want to know more about Dubai incubators, do not hesitate to search for more information.

FAQs

What are startup incubators in Dubai?

Dubai’s startup incubators support startups with mentoring, funding, and resources.

How do startup incubators help new businesses?

The startup incubators provide guidance, workspace, networking, and investor access.

Who can apply for startup incubator programs in Dubai?

Early-stage startups, entrepreneurs, and innovators can apply for startup incubator programs.

Are startup incubators in Dubai government-supported?

Many incubators receive government backing and partnerships from the Dubai government.

What benefits do incubators offer to entrepreneurs?

Incubators offer mentorship, funding opportunities, and business development support to entrepreneurs.

How long do startup incubator programs last?

The startup incubator programs run between three and twelve months.

mainEntity.name: What are startup incubators in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Startup incubators in Dubai are specialized centers—often government-backed like in5, Dtec, or Hub71—that provide early-stage companies with mentorship, networking, and technical resources to transform an idea into a viable business.

mainEntity.name: How do startup incubators help new businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: They offer subsidized licensing (starting around AED 3,500), interest-free loans, equity-free grants, and access to 'sandboxes' where you can test products legally. They also provide high-tech labs, co-working spaces, and introductions to VCs and angel investors.

mainEntity.name: Who can apply for startup incubator programs in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early-stage founders with a Minimum Viable Product (MVP), tech-enabled startups, and innovators in sectors like AI, Sustainability, and Fintech can apply. 2026 rules have made it easier for international founders to apply for 'Approval in Principle' even before landing in the UAE.

mainEntity.name: Are startup incubators in Dubai government-supported?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, major ones like Area 2071 (Dubai Future Foundation) and Dubai SME are directly supported by the government. These programs often provide direct access to government contracts through pilot projects with entities like RTA or Dubai Health Authority.

mainEntity.name: What benefits do incubators offer to entrepreneurs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Benefits include 100% license fee waivers (for the first year), 3-year Golden Visa sponsorship for founding teams, non-dilutive funding (grants), and 1:1 mentorship from industry veterans.

mainEntity.name: How long do startup incubator programs last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most incubation programs run for 3 to 12 months. However, hubs like in5 offer renewable 12-month memberships, while fast-track accelerators like Dubai Future Accelerators typically last 10 weeks.

What is the Department of Economic Development (DED) in Dubai?

The Department of Economic Development (DED) oversees Dubai’s economic dynamism. It is a pivotal entity shaping the city’s business landscape. The DED serves as the regulatory heartbeat, orchestrating diverse economic activities with finesse.

Firstly, to delve into the multifaceted role of the DED, it is vital to grasp its core functions. DED activities span from business registration to licensing, reflecting its commitment to fostering a conducive environment for entrepreneurs.

In essence, the DED acts as a cornerstone for businesses seeking to establish themselves in Dubai. From the inception of a business idea to its operationalization, the DED plays a vital role, ensuring that every facet aligns with the established regulations.

The DED operates on a transparent framework, allowing businesses to flourish while maintaining regulatory compliance. This transparency extends to the cost structure associated with various services, necessitating the use of DED payment vouchers for seamless transactions.

Moreover, the DED facilitates a user-friendly experience through its e-services, allowing businesses to access and navigate various processes online. This digitization not only streamlines operations but also enhances accessibility, enabling entrepreneurs to obtain DED payment vouchers with ease.

In tandem with Dubai’s vision for economic growth, the DED continually evolves its services, staying ahead of the curve. This proactive approach ensures that businesses can adapt effortlessly to the ever-changing economic landscape, supported by the DED’s robust framework.

In conclusion, the Department of Economic Development in Dubai is the linchpin for businesses. It provides a structured and transparent platform for their inception, operation, and growth.

How can I obtain a DED voucher?

To seamlessly integrate into Dubai’s vibrant business ecosystem, understanding the process of acquiring a DED payment voucher is paramount. The Department of Economic Development (DED) offers a streamlined procedure through its user-friendly online portal and DED service center.

Firstly, entrepreneurs can conveniently access the official DED website, where a dedicated section for e-services provides a gateway to various essential functions. Navigating through this portal, users encounter a comprehensive menu of services, including the issuance of DED payment vouchers for diverse business activities.

Within the e-services platform, individuals can meticulously select the specific service or activity requiring payment. Whether it is for licensing, fines, or other regulatory processes, the user-friendly interface ensures a hassle-free experience. As the user inputs the necessary details, the system generates a customized DED payment voucher, reflecting the precise amount owed.

For those who prefer an in-person approach, the DED’s physical service centers offer a personalized touch. By visiting a DED service center, entrepreneurs can access expert guidance and assistance in real-time. The knowledgeable staff at these centers not only facilitate the generation of DED payment vouchers but also address any queries or concerns related to the payment process.

Once you enter the required details, proceed to make secure online payments through the portal. The system generates instant confirmation, and users can effortlessly download the finalized DED payment voucher for their records.

In conclusion, obtaining a DED payment voucher is a straightforward process, facilitated by both the user-friendly online portal and the personalized services available at DED service centers. This seamless approach ensures that entrepreneurs can efficiently manage their financial transactions within the regulatory framework of Dubai’s business landscape.

What is the procedure for verifying my DED fines?

Navigating the process of verifying and addressing outstanding fines with the Department of Economic Development (DED) in Dubai is an essential aspect of maintaining a clean business record. So, to initiate the verification process, individuals can easily access the official DED website or visit a DED service center. The online platform, known as DED e-services, serves as a comprehensive hub for various regulatory functions, including fines verification.

Upon entering the DED e-services section, users can locate the fines verification option. This dedicated section provides a transparent breakdown of any outstanding fines associated with their trade license. Certainly, it is a user-friendly interface designed for simplicity and clarity.

Once within the fines section, users input their trade license details, prompting the system to retrieve and display any applicable fines. The platform meticulously lists each fine, detailing the nature of the violation and the corresponding amount due. This transparency empowers business owners to fully comprehend the nature of their fines.

After reviewing the fines, users can proceed to settle them directly through the online platform. The DED payment process is secure and straightforward, allowing users to make immediate transactions to clear their outstanding dues. For those who prefer a face-to-face approach, a visit to a DED service center is a viable alternative. Knowledgeable staff at these centers are available to guide individuals through the fines verification process, offering personalized assistance where needed. This dual approach, combining online accessibility with in-person support, ensures that individuals can efficiently manage their fines with the DED.

Renewing Your DED Trade License – Step-by-Step

Ensuring the continuous operation of your business in Dubai necessitates a step-by-step understanding of the process for renewing your Department of Economic Development (DED) trade license. This meticulous process involves both online and offline elements, allowing for flexibility in adherence to regulatory requirements.

Commencing the renewal process involves timely action, ideally beginning at least one month before the expiration date. The DED’s online portal, a hub for DED activities, or a visit to a DED service center initiates the renewal journey.

Upon logging into the DED’s e-services, individuals seamlessly navigate to the license renewal section. Here, a comprehensive menu unfolds, outlining the steps for a hassle-free renewal experience. The platform guides users to select the renewal option, triggering the systematic process.

Simultaneously, individuals provide the requisite documents for verification. This step ensures compliance with ongoing regulatory standards and underscores the commitment to ethical business practices. Once you submit the documents, the platform prompts users to proceed to the DED payment phase.

Generating a DED payment voucher specific to the renewal fees, users complete the transaction securely online. The system calculates the fees based on the nature of the business and ensures a transparent breakdown of costs. This personalized approach allows for a precise and informed DED payment.

The culmination of the renewal process is the electronic issuance of the renewed trade license. This seamless integration of online and offline elements underscores the DED’s commitment to facilitating business operations in Dubai. A combination of user-friendly online platforms and in-person support at DED service centers ensures that entrepreneurs navigate the license renewal process with ease, ensuring uninterrupted business activities.

DED Trade License Cost in Dubai

Conclusion

In conclusion, navigating Dubai’s business landscape necessitates a comprehensive understanding of DED processes, particularly the acquisition of payment vouchers. As we explored the multifaceted role of the Department of Economic Development (DED), it became evident that obtaining a DED trade license is not only a legal requirement but a strategic move for entrepreneurs.

The seamless steps, from selecting the service to downloading the payment voucher, underscore the efficiency of Dubai’s business infrastructure.

Moreover, addressing fines and renewing trade licenses emerged as pivotal responsibilities for business owners. Verifying and settling fines, coupled with a systematic renewal process, ensures not only compliance but also the sustained operation of businesses.

Then, delving into the cost structure of DED trade licenses revealed a tailored approach based on business activities. The clarity provided by the DED’s official fee schedule empowers entrepreneurs to calculate and generate payment vouchers accurately.

What is a DED payment voucher used for?

It is a proof of payment document you use to pay government fees like trade license renewal, fines, or other DED charges.

How do I get a DED payment voucher?

You request it through the Dubai DED eServices portal or the relevant authority’s online system using your license details.

Is DED voucher mandatory for payments?

Yes. You usually need the voucher to make official payments and complete transactions with DED.

How long is a DED voucher valid?

The voucher is valid for a limited period set by the authority, so you must pay before it expires.

Can someone else apply for the voucher?

Yes. An authorized person, partner, or consultant can apply if they have the required access or authorization.

What happens if voucher expires?

If it expires, you must generate a new voucher and pay again; expired vouchers are not accepted.

If you want to start the formation of your company in Dubai, one of the most attractive places when it comes to economic expansion opportunities for new investors, you must take into account the laws and regulations of the United Arab Emirates. In order for your company to operate legally and freely, you must first obtain a Trade License in Dubai.

In this article, you will find information about what is a Trade License, what are the types of trade licenses in Dubai, what documents do you need to apply for this type of license, what benefits can you get when applying for a Trade License and how we can help with the process of obtaining this license for your company.

  1. What is a Trade License?
  2. How many different types of trade licenses are there?
  3. Procedure to get a Trade License
  4. What are the necessary documents to obtain a Trade License?
  5. Dubai Trade License cost
  6. How is the Trade License renewal Dubai?
  7. Differences between the Offshore, Mainland, and Free Zone licenses
  8. Benefits of applying for a Trade License

1. What is a Trade License?

A Trade License in Dubai is an official document issued by the Department of Economic Development (DED) that allows different companies to operate legally in the United Arab Emirates.

This license is valid for different activities in Dubai, such as the export and import of products and services and any commercial activity.

Companies established in a Dubai Free Zone can acquire one of these licenses, as can professionals who offer services related to the industrial area.

2. How many different types of trade licenses are there?

There are four main types of licenses, and each is intended for a different activity. These are the following:

2.1 Professional License

These licenses are for those individuals or entities that offer a professional service that depends on their physical and mental abilities to generate profit. The professional license allows entrepreneurs to maintain 100% ownership of the company.

2.2 Commercial License

The UAE Commercial License is an official document issued by the authorities of the United Arab Emirates addressed to those companies or organizations that carry out activities related to the trade of goods and services.

Some businesses, such as real estate companies, retail firms, transport companies, business enterprises, among others, must apply for this license.

It is important to realize that by obtaining this license, you can trade, export, and import products within the United Arab Emirates.

2.3 Industry License

In essence, this license is intended for those companies whose activities are based on the transformation of natural resources into the material to operate or finished products.

An industrial company has global access to its customers and requires a large number of resources and manpower to operate.

2.4 General License

This type of license is ideal for those startups that are interested in doing business with a single license. Entrepreneurs who have this license can take advantage of business opportunities in certain areas, such as frozen foods, beverages, medical supplies, among others.

3. Procedure to get a Trade License

The process to obtain your Trade License in Dubai is quite simple, all you have to do is follow these steps:

3.1 Choose a business name

The first procedure that you must carry out is the choice of the name of your company. You must make sure that this name complies with all UAE regulations, Therefore, it cannot be offensive or indecent and cannot be related to any religious deity.

At the same time, the name must be unique and cannot be registered by some other company.

3.2 Select a legal structure

To continue with the process of applying for your Trade license, you must choose the legal structure of your company. This step will define how your company operates and who is responsible for the company.

3.3 Define a business activity

Once the name of your business and the legal structure are ready, the next step is to decide the activity that your company will carry out.

Be sure to name all the activities on the license and keep in mind that each license is limited to 10 activities.

3.4 Complete the application form

The Department of Economic Development will give you a form that you must fill in with some basic information about yourself and your company.

Once completed, submit the form to DED and wait for initial approval.

3.5 Additional approvals

Some productive activities require the approval of other government entities. For this reason, you must carry out good research before completing the process of forming your company. Otherwise, there may be delays or they may even reject your license.

3.6 Get the necessary documents

Along with the form submitted to the DED, you must submit several documents to acquire your license. Gather the documents and make sure all the necessary signatures are present.

3.7 Select a business location

If you choose to establish your company in the Mainland, you will need a physical office. Once you choose the location, you must get a Tenancy Contract.

Ejari will be the entity in charge of certifying the contract and you must submit it with the rest of the documentation.

Also, if you want to know how to obtain a Trade License without office space, you can contact us.

3.8 Submit the application

When you have all the corresponding documentation and the location of your chosen office, you can submit your application to the Department of Economic Development to receive your Trade License.

3.9 Pay the fees

To apply for this type of license you need to make a payment of the issuance fee and for the license fee.

4. What are the necessary documents to obtain a Trade License?

 

The application process for a Trade License requires the submission of certain documents. To get started, you need to fill out the application for your trade license and make sure all managers sign it.

Also, you will need to create a Memorandum of Association (MoA) (preferably with the help of a legal representative). After this, you must make sure to put the company name approval to your application.

The DED will send the approval after accepting the name of your company. Lastly, all shareholders must submit copies of their passports.

Keep in mind that you must check the license application carefully to avoid any type of delays.

5. Dubai trade license cost

Before starting the process of applying for your Trade License, you need to know the cost you could pay. This will help organize your budget and prevent future confusion.

The Dubai Trade License cost will depend on the type of product or service you want to offer or the approvals you need to get. Other factors that may affect its cost are the following:

  • Region of establishment
  • Type of business activity
  • Business Structures
  • Number of business partners
  • Partnerships with local sponsors

However, a Trade License in Dubai can cost anywhere from AED 15,000 to AED 50,000, generally speaking.

Also, remember that the cost of a Trade License in a Free Zone will be different from the cost of a Trade License in Mainland Dubai.

6. How is the Trade License renewal Dubai?

An important aspect of the Trade Licenses in the UAE is their validity. This type of license must be renewed every year if you want to continue operating legally in the United Arab Emirates.

Some of the steps you must follow to trade license renewal Dubai are the following:

6.1 Approvals

To start the process of renewing your license you need to receive the approvals of the relevant government entities. These approvals will depend on the activity carried out by your company.

 For example, transport companies must acquire approval from Dubai’s Road and Transport Authority. If you want to speed up the process, it is recommended that you obtain approval before proceeding with the Trade License Renewal Dubai process.

6.2 Documents

In addition to written approval from the relevant authorities, companies must provide certain documentation, for example:

  • A Tenancy Contract
  • Certified Ejari
  • Complete renewal form
  • Photo of all business partners
  • Payment number for renewal fees
  • Approval and authorization letters

All the shareholders must submit these documents to the Department of Economic Development to obtain approval.

6.3 Tenancy Contract

Before following the Dubai Trade License Renewal, you must have your Tenancy Contract up to date. It must be valid for no less than three months from the date on which you applied for your trade license renewal.

7. Differences between the Offshore, Mainland, and Free Zone licenses

The Trade License you choose will depend on where you decide to establish your company. Whether you decide to establish an offshore company or a Free Zone Company, certain factors vary from location to location.

A Mainland License is intended for those companies that carry out their operations in Dubai Mainland. It requires approval of various government entities and is issued by the Department of Economic Development.

The Free Zone Trade Licenses are issued by the corresponding government authorities of each zone.

In this zone, there are different limitations and benefits, for example, you can enjoy 100% ownership and 0% corporate tax.

If you want to start an offshore company in Dubai, you will need an offshore corporation certificate. Also, these types of companies cannot carry out commercial activities within the UAE.

8. Benefits of applying for a Trade License

Currently, there are multiple benefits in acquiring a Trade License in Dubai, for this reason, many entrepreneurs decide to set up branches or organizations in the United Arab Emirates. Some of the benefits you can enjoy are the following:

8.1 Improve credibility

It is common to see that many companies decide to try to go the easy way and skip some rules to get higher profits. However, those companies that decide to take the time to build their brand and follow the UAE regulations, earn the trust and preference of customers.

In addition, having a trade license increases your company’s exposure in the market, which increases confidence in your business and your product.

8.2 Few trade restrictions

One of the reasons why Dubai is so attractive to foreign investors is the few restrictions that exist when trading. As long as your products are registered in the license, you will not have to worry about any restrictions.

8.3 Promotes international and local trade

By having a Trade License, you have many opportunities to import and manufacture products. You can trade them in the local Dubai market or you can send them abroad and generate profits from other countries.

Also, this license allows you to re-export your own goods, which increases your company’s ability to trade services and products around the world.

8.4 Tax benefits

In the year 2021, more than 90,000 people decided to move to Dubai, this was with the motivation of being able to enjoy tax incentives. While most countries require investors to pay large amounts of money in taxes, Dubai remains an almost tax-free region.

In this way, new investors can generate additional revenue.

9. How can we help you get a Trade License in Dubai?

Obtaining a Trade License in Dubai is the starting point for any entrepreneur who wants to succeed in the United Arab Emirates. However, if you are not familiar with the company formation process and the different laws of the UAE, the process may take longer than usual. For this reason, Connect Zone is the ideal partner to help you with everything you need.

We are your trusted agency that will take care of all the paperwork for your Trade License application, we will advise you to make the right decisions and additionally, we can help you choose a place for your office in one of the best list of business centers in Dubai.

 

Do you want to know more about how to acquire a business license in Dubai? You can send us an email to contact@connectzone.ae where one of our representatives will answer all your questions.

Also, if you would like to apply for a job in our agency, you can submit your CV to thetalentpoint.com or you can send an email to the following address contact@thetalentpoint.com. The Talent Point does not store data sent via email or share it with third-parties.

FAQs

How can I get a trade license in Dubai?

Obtaining a trade license in Dubai requires you to apply through DET or a free zone authority. Start by selecting an activity, submitting documents, and completing approvals.

What documents are required for a Dubai trade license?

You need passport copies, visa details, application forms, and business activity information.

How much does a trade license cost in Dubai?

Dubai’s trade license costs depend on business activity, jurisdiction, office space, and visa requirements.

Can I apply for a trade license online in Dubai?

Dubai allows online applications through official government portals and approved free zone platforms.

What are the types of trade licenses in Dubai?

Dubai issues commercial, professional, industrial, tourism, and freelance trade licenses.
