title: E-commerce license Sharjah: Costs and requirements
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle
  • Steps to get your e-commerce license in Sharjah
    • Submit documents
    • Register for the e-channel and receive an immigration card
    • Visa processing
  • Cost of an e-commerce license in Sharjah
  • Benefits of starting an e-commerce business in Sharjah
  • FAQs
    • What is an e-commerce license in Sharjah?
    • How much does an eCommerce license cost in Sharjah?
    • What documents are required for an e-commerce license?
    • Can expats apply for an e-commerce license in Sharjah?
    • Is a physical office required for e-commerce in Sharjah?
    • How long does it take to get an eCommerce license?

Currently, electronic commerce is one of the most profitable and demanding activities in the world. It is important to know that in order to legally operate in this sector, you must obtain specific documentation. The purpose of this is to prove compliance with certain requirements and regulations. Also, depending on the emirate where you are, it changes. For instance, if you are in Sharjah, you need an e-commerce license Sharjah. Another option is, if you are in Dubai, you need the e-commerce license Sharjah.

In this article, we will explain everything you need to know about the e-commerce license Sharjah. In particular, the application process and the documents you must present. Other interesting information that you will see is the advantages of starting an e-commerce business in Sharjah. In addition, you will see the entire procedure for visa processing and many other things. Thus, you will be able to make a decision with the correct knowledge and take advantage of the opportunities that this growing market offers.

Steps to get your e-commerce license in Sharjah

If you want to start a business in the UAE, starting an e-commerce company in Sharjah may be the best decision. This is because many entrepreneurs and businessmen consider Sharjah as one of the best places to start e-commerce companies.

However, in order to open your company, you must have a business license in Sharjah that suits your business. In this case, get your e-commerce license in Sharjah as it is illegal for you to start an e-commerce in the UAE without this license.

First step: Choose your company’s legal business structure.

Second step: Register the business name for your company. For this, you must follow the specific naming rules. In other words, you should avoid using vulgar or nasty words and profanity. Also, you should try to stay away from famous company names and acronyms. Then, you must make sure that the chosen name is available for registration.

Third step: You must register in an electronic channel and obtain an immigration card. However, this step is only for holders who are foreigners.

Fourth step: Here you must process your visa and, like the previous step, it is only for foreigners.

Fifth step: You have to send the complete health form, the necessary documents, and the company or final name. Subsequently, you must have all the necessary documents for the application and you should be able to receive your license within hours.

Sixth step: You need to make the necessary decisions regarding employee recruitment, and office and warehouse spaces.

Seventh step: Now all that is left to do is remove the charges from Shams and you will be able to get your license. However, the fees vary between people and their experience. Once the procedures are done and the fees paid, your license will be issued.

Submit documents

In order to apply for your e-commerce in Sharjah, you must have all the documents required by the authorities. For this reason, in this article we will tell you what the documents are so that you can make your request without any problem:

  • A copy of your passport, which must be valid
  • A partnership memorandum.
  • Your lease and EJARI if you have an office or warehouse.
  • A copy of your visa.
  • Your Emirates ID or a copy of it.
  • A copy of the property title.
  • A No Objection Certificate or NOC if necessary.

It is important that when you apply for your e-commerce license in Sharjah you present all these documents. Otherwise, your application will most likely be denied and you will not be able to get your license.

Register for the e-channel and receive an immigration card

Currently, the backbone of the UAE economy is immigration. For this reason, the UAE guarantees a smooth entry and visa process. In this way, over the years, the UAE has perfected its immigration process for those who want to live and work in the country. Here, we find the e-channel system that the country has.

In short, the e-channel system is an online portal that makes it easy for people to apply for any immigration-related application. In this way, it eliminates personal visits to the centers, making the entire process faster and easier. Additionally, the system is open to people who submit their applications and sponsor others, such as companies that handle the immigration process for their employees.

Every person who wishes to use the e-channel system must register. This registration can be done by going to a typing center or simply by going to the website. Thus, when registering, you must first select an individual or establishment. After selecting this, you must click on registration and the process begins.

First step: Enter your email address and you will receive a confirmation email from the Ministry of the Interior.

Second step: You must follow the instructions in the MoL email, fill in all your details, and then click where it says complete registration.

Third step: All that remains is to wait for the final confirmation to be sent by mail to the previously registered email address.

Already being registered in the e-channel, you will be able to start enjoying its services immediately. In addition, from this portal, companies and other establishments will be able to verify the status of any existing application and upload documents for immigration purposes.

Visa processing

The process of obtaining a visa with the e-commerce license Sharjah will depend on the type of business structure you choose. That is if you establish yourself in a free zone or a continental territory. However, some general steps have to be followed. You will see all these steps below, all the exceptions that exist must be investigated separately.

First step: Present all the necessary documents to apply for the license, including the commercial name of the business.

Second step: Register for e-channel services and apply for the immigration card.

Third step: Once you have your immigration card, you must proceed to request an entry permit. This permit allows the applicant to stay in the UAE for a maximum of 60 days or two months. It is important to note that you can come and go during this period. However, it is recommended to avoid long round trips. This is in order to avoid immigration complications.

Part of the visa process is to submit the applicant to a medical check-up and to undergo a series of tests. For instance, blood tests, chest X-rays, and biometric scans. Also, this is the time when you can apply for your Emirates ID. This is an identification card that will give you access to most services in the country.

Another important point of these visas is that they can be for multiple entries or residences.

Fourth step: Finally, the last step you must follow is to pay the corresponding fees for the visas. Something important to note about this step is that, at this time, you have to pay the visa fees and the e-commerce license Sharjah fees.

Cost of an e-commerce license in Sharjah

Before talking about the cost of an e-commerce license in Sharjah, you should know what the conditions are for the holder. These conditions must be met before applying for the license. The purpose of these terms is to ensure that only persons who have the means to obtain the e-commerce license Sharjah can apply for it. Thanks to this, officials will only receive applications that meet all the characteristics, facilitating the process.

Below, you will see the terms that must be met before applying for the e-commerce license Sharjah. It is important to note that all these requirements may vary for the e-commerce license in the Sharjah-free zone.

  • The applicant for the e-commerce license Sharjah is at least 21 years old.
  • You have to be a citizen or resident of Sharjah.
  • The applicant can be both male and female.
  • The applicant has the option of opening a bank account in the country.
  • Finally, the applicant for the license can work in any region of the UAE. A good recommendation is to look for different business ideas.

Having this information, you can already know what is the cost of an e-commerce license in Sharjah. The first thing you have to know is that these prices will vary depending on several factors, which are.

Location: If the company is on the mainland or in a free zone, you should know that the prices will be different.

Commercial activity: Depending on the products or services you offer; you may need additional permits.

The number of visas and employees: If you need to hire staff or apply for visas for you and your shareholders, you will have to pay additional fees.

Generally, the initial cost of the license is AED 5750. However, it may vary depending on the above factors that suit your needs.

Benefits of starting an e-commerce business in Sharjah

By obtaining an e-commerce license Sharjah, entrepreneurs can enjoy different benefits. In addition, they provide the opportunity to capitalize on the country’s thriving business ecosystem. Below, you will see all the benefits of starting an e-commerce business in Sharjah.

The main benefit is the cost of this license, which is usually only AED 5,750. A lease, business license, and articles of incorporation are usually included in this price. In addition to the certificate of shares and constitution. Another advantage is that, if you wish, for the same price, you can add two extra commercial activities.

Another interesting advantage is that the incorporation of companies can be done virtually. In Sharjah, all types of digital verification are accepted through the customer portal. If you want to create your company in Sharjah with this license, you will not need any copy of your passport or corporate documentation. Of course, during the process of obtaining the e-commerce license. Furthermore, this license allows you to have up to a maximum of 50 shareholders.

In summary, the benefits of having an e-commerce license Sharjah are the following:

  • Enjoy a favorable business environment.
  • Highly cost-effective setup.
  • Businessmen can enjoy Sharjah’s strategic location.
  • Wide range of industries for your choice.
  • Growing consumer base.
  • Entrepreneurs can enjoy government support.
  • In Sharjah and throughout the UAE, there are many technological advances that you can access with this license.
  • Finally, you can access the great network of contacts and collaboration.

The documents, such as a passport copy, visa copy, business plan, and application form, are required for an e-commerce license.

Can expats apply for an e-commerce license in Sharjah?

Absolutely!

Expatriates are fully welcome to own eCommerce businesses in Sharjah.

Is a physical office required for e-commerce in Sharjah?

Not necessarily!

Most free zones allow virtual offices or flexi-desk options rather than a physical office.

How long does it take to get an eCommerce license?

The e-commerce license in Sharjah takes around five to ten working days.

title: Top 11 Successful Small Business Ideas in Dubai, UAE
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle

  • FAQs
    • What are the best small business ideas in Dubai?
    • Which small businesses are most profitable in Dubai?
    • Can foreigners start small businesses in Dubai?
    • What low-investment business ideas work in Dubai?
    • Which business is best for beginners in Dubai?

Dubai is one of the most diverse and interesting cities in the world. It offers a lot of opportunities for entrepreneurs who want to start their own small businesses. Whether you have a passion for food, technology, or jewelry, there is a niche market for you in Dubai. Considering how big Dubai, having a diversity of small business ideas in UAE is necessary.

In this article we will enlighten you about some of the best small business ideas in UAE. Here are some of the top successful business ideas in Dubai, UAE that you can consider.

Open an Advertising Agency

Advertising is a booming industry in Dubai and one of the best small business ideas in UAE. Many local and international brands compete for the attention of consumers. An advertising agency provides creative and strategic services to help clients reach their target audience and achieve their marketing goals. You can start an advertising agency with a small team of professionals who have skills in graphic design, copywriting, web development, social media marketing, and video production. You can also partner with other agencies or freelancers to offer a wider range of services. To succeed in this business, you need to have a strong portfolio and good network of contacts. You must have a clear understanding of the local market and culture. However, this is undoubtedly, one of the best business ideas in UAE.

Automobile Business

The automobile sector is one of the most booming and promising industries in Dubai. The city has a high demand for vehicles, which makes it one of the best small business ideas in UAE. Both new and used cars, as well as other related services, can be a great business. For example, maintenance, repair, modification, or rental. The automobile market in Dubai is also diverse and dynamic, meaning that you can cater to different segments and niches.

To start an automobile business in Dubai, you will need to obtain a license from the Department of Economic Development (DED). The, you need to register with the Roads and Transport Authority (RTA). You will also need to have a local sponsor or partner who is a UAE national or a company owned by UAE nationals. Also, you can choose to operate as a dealer, a mechanic, a modifier, or a renter, depending on your skills and preferences. There are some benefits from having this kind of business ideas in Dubai. Such as:

  • You can tap into the large and growing market of vehicle owners and users in the city.
  • Doing business through this industry can offer value-added services to your customers and create loyal relationships.
  • Benefit from the tax-free environment and the low import duties on vehicles and spare parts.

Consulting Business

Dubai is a hub for various industries and sectors, such as tourism, hospitality, finance, real estate, construction, and technology. Therefore, setting up a consultancy is among some of the best small business ideas in UAE. Many businesses and organizations in Dubai need expert advice and guidance to improve their performance and solve their challenges. A consulting business can offer professional services in several different areas. Such as, management, strategy, marketing, accounting, legal, human resources, IT, and more.

You can start a consulting business with your own expertise and experience or hire other consultants who have specialized knowledge and skills. Remember to focus on a specific industry or sector that you are familiar with or interested in. However, to succeed, you need to have a strong reputation, a loyal client base, and a high-quality service.

eCommerce Business

In such a high-tech city as Dubai is, eCommerce is a great UAE small business idea. eCommerce is one of the fastest-growing sectors in Dubai. Every day more and more people shop online for convenience and variety. An eCommerce business can sell any product or service online through a website or an app. You can sell your own products or services or act as a reseller or an affiliate for other brands. You can also choose a niche market that has less competition or more potential customers.

Some examples of eCommerce businesses are online fashion stores, online grocery stores, online travel agencies, online education platforms, and online gaming platforms. To succeed in this business, you need to cover different useful factors.

  • You will need an attractive software in a website or app
  • A secure payment system
  • Some trustworthy and reliable delivery service,
  • And finally, an effective marketing strategy.

In the modern world we live in an eCommerce company is a great small business idea in UAE.

Food Processing & Delivery Services

Food is a basic necessity and a huge industry in Dubai. People love to eat out and order food online, especially during the pandemic. If you have a knack for cooking or baking, you can start your own food processing and delivery service. You can make and sell ready-to-eat meals, snacks, desserts, or specialty foods that cater to different dietary preferences. Considering the diversity, this is among the best options for a business ideas in Dubai.

A delivery business can offer breakfast, lunch, dinner, or catering services for parties and events. You can also specialize in a certain cuisine, such as Indian, Chinese, Italian, or Lebanese. You can also partner with online platforms like Zomato, Talabat, or Deliveroo. Those will be able to help you reach more customers and increase your sales.

Home-Based Cooking Business

Another option for food lovers is to start a home-based cooking business. Stablishing food related companies are always among the greatest small business ideas in UAE. This is ideal for people who want to work from home and have low startup costs. You can cook your favorite dishes or cuisines and sell them to your neighbors, friends, or online customers.

Through a home-based cooking business, you can also offer catering services for small events or parties. You can promote your business on social media or through word-of-mouth. However, you will need to obtain a food license from the Dubai Municipality. You must always follow the food safety and high hygiene standards.

IT-Related Business

The IT sector is booming in Dubai, as more and more businesses are adopting digital solutions to improve their efficiency, productivity, and customer satisfaction. Some ideas for IT services are:

  • Web development
  • App development
  • e-commerce
  • Digital marketing
  • Cybersecurity
  • Cloud computing
  • Artificial intelligence
  • Blockchain

All of these are in high demand in various industries, such as logistics, banking, healthcare, hospitality, and education.

If you have the skills and expertise in any of these IT domains, you can start your own IT business in Dubai and offer your services to local and international clients. You can set up your business in one of the Dubai free zones that cater to the IT sector. For example at the Dubai Internet City or Dubai Media City. These free zones offer benefits. Such as, 100% foreign ownership, tax exemptions, low operating costs, and access to a network of IT professionals and companies. Considering how taxes work in Dubai, IT-related business is one of the best small business ideas in UAE.

Jewelry Making Business

The jewelry making business is another profitable and creative option for small businesses in Dubai. The city has a rich culture and tradition of jewelry making, as well as a large customer base of locals and tourists who appreciate fine craftsmanship and design. The jewelry market in Dubai is also diverse and dynamic. Meaning that you can cater to different tastes and preferences and that is a great small business ideas in UAE.

To start a jewelry making business in Dubai, you will need to obtain a license from the Department of Economic Development (DED) and register with the Dubai Gold and Jewellery Group (DGJG). You will also need to have a local sponsor. A sponsor or partner who is a UAE national or a company owned by UAE nationals. You can choose to operate as a manufacturer, a wholesaler, a retailer, or an online seller, depending on your skills and preferences.

Some of the benefits of starting a jewelry making business in Dubai are:

  • Expressing your creativity and passion for jewelry making and design.
  • Offering customized and personalized services to your customers and create loyal relationships.
  • Benefiting from the tax-free environment and the low import duties on gold and precious stones.

Real Estate Business

The real estate sector is one of the most lucrative and stable industries in Dubai. The city has a high demand for residential and commercial properties, as well as for tourism and hospitality facilities. The real estate market in Dubai is also dynamic and competitive, which means that you need to have a good knowledge of the trends, regulations, and opportunities in the sector.

To start a real estate business in Dubai, you will need to obtain a license from the Dubai Land Department (DLD) and register with the Real Estate Regulatory Agency (RERA). You will also need to have a local sponsor or partner who is a UAE national or a company owned by UAE nationals. You can choose to operate as a broker, an agent, a developer, or an investor, depending on your skills and preferences.

Some of the benefits of starting a real estate business in Dubai are:

  • Earning commissions from selling or renting properties, as well as from managing or maintaining them.
  • Building your network and reputation in the industry and attract more clients and referrals.
  • You can also diversify your portfolio and invest in different types of properties. Such as, apartments, villas, offices, hotels, or malls.

Recruitment Agency

Dubai is a hub for expatriates who come from different countries and backgrounds to work and live in the city. Therefore, a recruitment agency is one of the best business ideas in Dubai. The demand for skilled and qualified workers is high in various sectors such as construction, hospitality, retail, education, and healthcare. However, finding the right talent can be challenging for employers, especially in a competitive and diverse market.

This is where a recruitment agency can help. A recruitment agency can provide services such as sourcing, screening, interviewing, hiring, and training candidates for different job positions. A recruitment agency can also help employers with visa processing, payroll management, and employee retention.

To start a recruitment agency in Dubai, you need to obtain a license from the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE) or from a free zone authority. You also need to have a local partner or sponsor who owns 51% of the business if you operate outside a free zone. You can target both local and foreign clients who are looking for workers in Dubai or abroad.

Tourism

Dubai is among the most famous tourist cities in the world, attracting millions of travelers annually. The city offers a variety of attractions and experiences for tourists. Such as, shopping malls, skyscrapers, beaches, parks, museums, cultural events, sports activities, and entertainment options. Dubai also hosts major big events that draw huge crowds from around the world.

Tourism is a lucrative sector for small businesses in Dubai, as there are many opportunities to provide services and products to tourists. Some of the tourism-related business ideas that you can start in Dubai are:

  • Travel agency

You can offer travel packages, tours, tickets, visas, accommodation, transportation, etc. Also, other travel-related services to tourists who want to visit Dubai or other destinations.

  • Tour guide

You can provide guided tours to tourists who want to explore the city. Show them and teach them about its history, culture, landmarks, and attractions. You can specialize in a niche such as cultural tours, adventure tours, food tours, religious tours or desert tours.

  • Souvenir shop

You can sell souvenirs such as magnets, keychains, mugs, shirts and other products that travelers would buy to remember their trip.

Conclusion

In conclusion, Dubai has a large and growing shopping population. You can choose from different niches such as fashion, food, electronics, health, or education. Do not forget about the online shopping and that you will need to create an attractive and user-friendly website. Also, source or produce your products or services, and manage your logistics and payments. Another idea could be opening a branch of your already existing business in UAE.

Remember you will need to market your business online and offline. Finally, you need to register your business and obtain a license and a visa for one of your small business ideas in UAE.

 

FAQs

What are the best small business ideas in Dubai?

Popular ideas include e-commerce, consulting, digital marketing, food delivery, and freelancing services.

Which small businesses are most profitable in Dubai?

Mostly, low-overhead, service-based, and online businesses tend to generate strong profit margins.

Can foreigners start small businesses in Dubai?

Foreigners can start and fully own small businesses across Dubai.

What low-investment business ideas work in Dubai?

Businesses like freelancing, online stores, consultancy, and digital services require minimal initial investment.

Which business is best for beginners in Dubai?

Service-based and online businesses are ideal for first-time entrepreneurs.

title: Getting an ICV Certificate in the UAE: A Simple Guide
content:

    • Which companies need ICV certification?

    • Who issues the ICV certificate in the UAE?
    • Is ICV certification mandatory for government tenders?

Above all, in the dynamic landscape of business, certifications play a crucial role in establishing credibility and competitiveness. Businesses worldwide recognize the value of certifications in enhancing their credibility, fostering growth, and accessing new opportunities. Indeed, in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), one such accreditation for companies is the ICV certification.

This article presents a comprehensive guide to understanding and obtaining an In-Country Value (ICV) certification in the UAE. Most importantly, we will outline the significance, benefits, and the step-by-step process involved to acquire this essential document.

What is an ICV Certification in UAE?

Firstly, the acronym ICV stands for In-Country Value, a term that denotes the total economic contribution made by an entity within the UAE. An ICV certification, therefore, is a formal recognition of a company’s commitment to contributing to the nation’s economy through its operations. It is evidence of a business’s efforts to invest in the UAE’s development.

Overall, the ICV certification in the UAE embodies a commitment to bolster the nation’s economy from within. In-Country Value refers to the total contribution, both monetary and non-monetary, that an entity makes to the local economy.

Moreover, the ICV certification compresses the holistic essence of corporate social responsibility, as it encompasses not just financial investments, but also initiatives aimed at enhancing the well-being of the community in which the company operates.

The ICV certification body is the entity responsible for evaluating, verifying, and awarding the certificate to eligible companies. Of course, it ensures that the assessment process is transparent, accurate, and aligned with the UAE’s economic objectives.

For instance, several bodies in Dubai are responsible for issuing ICV certifications to companies. Some of the key bodies that issue ICV certifications in Dubai include:

  • Department of Economic Development (DED): Major government body actively involved in promoting economic development and ensuring the implementation of various economic initiatives.
  • Dubai Energy and Water Authority (DEWA): A key player in the energy and water sector, encourages ICV compliance within the companies operating in its domain.
  • Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) Group: Major player in the energy sector in the UAE, is known to be a pioneer in implementing the ICV program.
  • Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC): Committed to supporting the ICV initiative by promoting the growth of local industries and businesses.
  • Dubai Petroleum Establishment (DPE): Responsible for exploring and producing hydrocarbons within the Emirate of Dubai.

Benefits of the ICV Certificate

Certainly, the In-Country Value (ICV) certification holds a special place in the landscape of the United Arab Emirates (UAE). Obtaining an ICV certificate brings forth a variety of advantages, such as:

  • Elevating Market Standing:

In short, the ICV certification is an emblem that elevates a company’s market standing from the ordinary to the esteemed. In a market crowded with competition, it serves as a tangible testimony of a company’s commitment to not just profitability, but to the holistic growth of the UAE’s economy.

  • Building Stakeholder Trust:

Trust is the foundation upon which business relationships succeed. An ICV certification goes beyond being a mere document; it is an embodiment of transparency, integrity, and dedication. Holding this ICV certificate signals that a company is invested in transparency, ethical practices, and local empowerment.

  • Amplifying Business Opportunities:

Moreover, the UAE’s government projects are sought-after, with their potential to elevate businesses to new heights. The ICV certification aligns impeccably with the UAE’s vision of fostering local enterprises, making ICV-certified companies more appealing and eligible for government collaborations.

  • Enhancing Reputation

In the digital age, reputation travels quickly. Holding an ICV certification in Dubai or anywhere else in the UAE does not just reflect economic commitment; it mirrors a company’s embrace of corporate social responsibility. This reputation not only draws customers but also attracts potential employees who are aligned with the company’s ethos.

  • Gaining Competitive Edge

In the realm of business, a competitive edge is a valued asset. The ICV certification confers just that. This edge aids in market differentiation, rendering the company a preferred choice for collaborations, contracts, and partnerships. Overall, if you are thinking about the ICV certification meaning and process, we guarantee it is a strategic move worth considering.

Steps to Get Your ICV Certificate in the UAE

Obtaining an ICV certification (In-Country Value certification) stands as a pivotal achievement for businesses operating within the United Arab Emirates (UAE). In an economy marked by its dynamic growth and global significance, this certification carries substantial weight, reflecting a company’s commitment to enhancing local economic contribution.

The significance of this certification extends beyond its immediate meaning, resonating with questions like “What is ICV certification?”. For enterprises aspiring to demonstrate their dedication to the UAE’s economic development, understanding the ICV certification process is crucial.

With various ICV certification bodies in UAE, businesses gain the opportunity to align themselves with a standardized framework that evaluates their local content and in-country contributions. You must, however, check if your company is eligible for ICV certificate.

Generally, businesses that have operations in the UAE and engage with the local economy can apply for the certification. Review requirements set by the relevant ICV certification bodies in UAE.

Be it in Dubai or any other emirate, the pursuit of ICV certification UAE is characterized by meticulous steps and criteria, underscoring the nation’s drive for economic sustainability and diversification. Getting your ICV certificate involves a straightforward journey divided into four main steps. Think of it as a series of manageable tasks that collectively lead you to your goal.

In this section, we will unravel the intricate layers of the certification process. This exploration delves beyond formalities, illustrating how ICV certification in Dubai and across the UAE encapsulates a strategic investment in the nation’s thriving economic landscape.

1. Issue Audited Financial Statement

Firstly, choose an ICV certification body that is approved by the UAE government. These bodies are authorized to assess and verify your company’s ICV score.

The ICV certification journey begins with a company’s financial transparency. Businesses need to prepare and present their audited financial statements. These statements provide an accurate and comprehensive overview of the company’s financial performance, highlighting its revenue, expenses, and profits.

This step is crucial, as it establishes a foundation for evaluating a company’s contributions to the UAE’s economy. It is a fundamental requirement for the ICV certification process.

This is like creating a snapshot of your company’s financial health. Auditing means experts thoroughly review your financial records, ensuring accuracy and transparency. Think of this step as the foundation of your ICV certificate application; it helps showcase your financial stability and credibility.

It is also important to calculate your company’s ICV score based on the ICV formula provided by the certification body. The score is determined by factors such as Emiratization (hiring local workforce), local procurement, investment in the UAE, and other economic contributions.

2. Fill in the ICV Certificate Template

Collect the necessary documents for the ICV certification process. These may include financial statements, contracts, employee information, procurement records, and other relevant business documents.

Then, once the financial statements are in order, businesses proceed to complete the ICV Certificate Template. This template is a standardized form provided by the relevant authorities. It requires companies to input data related to their operations, investments, and expenditures within the UAE. Businesses must detail their spending on various elements, including local suppliers, workforce, and research and development activities.

This step ensures that companies are transparent about their in-country expenditures and investments. You will need to fill in details about various aspects of your business, such as your local spending, efforts to employ local talent, and contributions to the UAE’s economy.

Think of this template as a structured questionnaire. It is a bit like painting a picture of your company’s positive impact on the country’s growth.

3. Get Evaluated

After submitting the ICV Certificate Template, the next step involves evaluation by authorized ICV certification bodies in the UAE. These certification bodies thoroughly review the submitted data and assess its accuracy and compliance with the ICV certification requirements.

They will also assess your ICV score based on the provided data. The ICV score quantifies your contribution to the UAE’s economy, reflecting your commitment to local value creation.

The certification body will review your application, documents, and ICV score calculation. They might request additional information or clarification if needed. The evaluation process involves a comprehensive analysis of the financial statements, operational data, and expenditure information. This step is crucial to maintaining the integrity and credibility of the ICV certification process.

Additionally, depending on the certification body, you might need to undergo a self-assessment or have an external verification conducted. During this process, your company’s ICV data and documentation will be evaluated. In some cases, the certification body might conduct a site visit to verify the information provided in your application.

Imagine this step as a thorough examination by specialists. An approved ICV evaluation body will carefully review your submitted information. They will assess how much your business is contributing to the UAE’s economic development. Moreover, think of this step as the moment your efforts get measured and recognized by experts.

4. Get an ICV Certificate

Once your ICV score is determined and meets the required threshold, you will be granted the ICV certificate. This certificate is a formal recognition of a company’s commitment to supporting the UAE’s economic growth and development goals. It symbolizes a company’s adherence to investing in local resources, promoting job creation, and contributing to the nation’s overall economic progress.

This certification can enhance a company’s reputation and open doors to new business opportunities. This is like getting a diploma for your company’s commitment to the UAE’s economic progress. The certificate is not just a piece of paper; it is proof of your dedication to strengthening the local economy. Thus, think of this step as the achievement that signifies your active role in the nation’s growth story.

Nevertheless, keep in mind that the ICV certification is often valid for a specific period, after which you will need to renew it. Additionally, you might need to submit periodic reports to the certification body to maintain your certification.

To renew ICV certification in the UAE, companies must meet the In-Country Value (ICV) criteria set by the certification bodies. The process involves verifying contributions to the local economy, such as procurement, workforce, and investments.

Companies must submit required documents, undergo assessment, and achieve the specified ICV score. Timely renewal is crucial for uninterrupted business activities. Check with relevant ICV certification bodies in UAE for precise guidelines and deadlines for ICV certification renewal, especially to maintain compliance and continue benefiting from ICV certification.

Final words

In conclusion, obtaining an ICV certificate in the UAE is a vital step for businesses. Understanding what ICV certification entails, its meaning, and its significance is crucial. The ICV certification process, overseen by various certification bodies in the UAE, ensures compliance with in-country value standards. So, businesses seeking ICV certification in Dubai or throughout the UAE must engage with an accredited ICV certification body.

ICV certification enhances a company’s credibility and competitiveness while contributing to the UAE’s economic growth. By adhering to the ICV framework, businesses demonstrate their commitment to local development. This certification signifies a commitment to local job creation, supplier development, and investment in the nation’s economy.

In-country value certification is not just a requirement but a strategic move that aligns with the UAE’s vision of sustainable development. As businesses navigate the ICV certification landscape, they pave the way for increased opportunities, partnerships, and sustainable growth. With various ICV certification bodies available, businesses can find a suitable partner to guide them through the process.

In essence, this certification encapsulates the essence of economic localization and growth. It is a badge of honor that businesses wear proudly, showcasing their dedication to the UAE’s prosperity and future. As this certification continues to shape the business landscape in the UAE, companies embracing it position themselves for success while contributing to the nation’s economic resilience and progress.

If you want to learn more about this and other topics, go to our insights section.

FAQs

What is ICV certification in the UAE?

ICV certification measures a company’s contribution to the UAE economy. Measuring can be done through local spending, Emiratisation, and local sourcing. This is mainly for government procurement evaluation.

Which companies need ICV certification?

Companies bidding for UAE government or semi-government contracts require ICV certification. This may include oil, gas, manufacturing, and infrastructure sectors.

How long is an ICV certificate valid?

An ICV certificate is valid for 14 months from the date of issuance. It is based on the company’s most recent audited financial statements.

Who issues the ICV certificate in the UAE?

ICV certificates are issued by ADNOC-approved or government-authorised certifying bodies. These are issued by following the official ICV programme guidelines.

Is ICV certification mandatory for government tenders?

ICV certification is essential for competitive scoring and eligibility in most government and semi-government tenders.

title: How to start an import and export business in Dubai, UAE
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle

  • Top Imports and Exports in Dubai

  • FAQs
    • How can I start an import export business in Dubai?
    • What license is required for import export business in Dubai?
    • How much investment is needed for an import export business in Dubai?
    • Do I need customs registration for import export in the UAE?
    • Is the import export business profitable in Dubai?

Dubai’s heritage in trade and business is extensive and popular. The UAE continues to be a major international commercial hub for a variety of industries, with many of the most significant import and export transactions taking place in Dubai. The region is remarkable in its capacity to expedite trade within the East and the West due to its ongoing pivotal position between these two regions. All of this means that, having an import export business in Dubai can be really beneficial for UAE entrepreneurs.

In this article, we will be talking all about the details of the import export business in Dubai scene. Why is Dubai natural hub for import-export activity? Dubai provides a strong economic environment, liberal tax regulations, and probably most importantly, a continuously growing clientele with enormous purchasing power. Dubai’s world-class ports and airport are advantages for large-scale shipping, which makes the UAE’s export and import sector famous internationally.

Why Choose Dubai for Import-Export Business in the UAE

Before starting your own import export business in Dubai, it is crucial to understand why the city offers so many opportunities for the ultimate entrepreneurial experience. One of the main reasons is that the government and regulatory agencies take action to ensure that there is enough room for expansion that supports corporate operations.

For instance, import and export procedures in UAE are less expensive in the region. This, because the Middle Eastern country has some of the lowest business and personal tax rates in the world. If a business decides to put its main office in a financial region like a Free Zone, it will also avoid paying import taxes. This will just increase rather than decrease the possibility for generating income. Dubai becomes a natural center for import-export activity as a result of this.

Considering the UAE’s strategic geographic location, having access to nearby markets is quite advantageous for an import export business in Dubai. A readily available, diverse but unified transport and tourism system facilitates the movement of products both inside and outside of Dubai. With the benefits of a free zone, all you need to do to successfully launch your business is meet with the relevant officials and obtain your trading license.

The highly successful economic diversification strategy of the UAE Government draws in numerous international business owners looking for opportunities for growth and development in the Middle East. The majority of local business consultants think that this represents the city’s business peak.

The UAE is gaining recognition across the globe for the reasons here below:

  • It has large oil reserves.
  • Dubai’s towering buildings and brilliant lights.
  • Seven-star accommodations.
  • Moving business districts.
  • Their desert.

So, as you can see. Opening this type of business here, can be very beneficial for everyone.

Things You Can’t Bring and What You Need Permission for in the UAE

The flow of products across borders and between countries is an essential component of international trade. However, a number of rules and regulations prohibit the importation of goods with restrictions into the UAE, whether they are importing or exporting them from the nation.

These specific commodities are listed in the customs tariff codes developed by the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC). These division codes for custom indicate that a license is necessary for the commodities when completing online Customs Declarations.

All things that the UAE government has banned or restricted from importation can be seen here. This list contains items that are either entirely prohibited or only partially permitted to enter the area.

  • Recreational drugs and all other narcotics are included.
  • Goods produced in Israel or bearing Israeli trademarks, banners, and emblems.
  • Products that enter the UAE from countries or locations that are boycotted.
  • Goods made from raw ivory and rhinoceros horn.
  • Gambling-related equipment, gadgets, and implements.
  • Three-layered fishing nets.
  • Sculptures, engravings, statues, prints, and lithographs that are original works made from any material.
  • Worn, repaired, and inlaid tires for vehicles.
  • the byproducts of nuclear and chemical reactions, radiation, radioactive materials, and other contaminants.
  • Any artwork that questions or contradicts Islamic teachings, ethical standards, including prints, publications of all kinds, oil paintings, photographs, cards, magazines, books, and marble sculptures.
  • Any form of money, coin, or other item having monetary value that is fake or copied.
  • Homemade and prepared meals.
  • Fake goods such apparel and accessories, tools, technology, and machinery, in addition to unauthorized publications and content that violates copyright or trademark laws.
  • Supplies needed for sorcery, witchcraft, and associated activities.
  • Rare or legally protected types of animals.
  • Highly valuable or expensive items include jewelry, valuable metals, gemstones, souvenirs, and similar items.
  • Foods and plants that rapidly go bad.

Top Imports and Exports in Dubai

The main trading commodities in Dubai up until very recently were petroleum and natural gas, however the Emirate has a remarkable ability for growth and development. In recent years, non-oil goods have begun to be included among the main export commodities. Companies handling exports and imports in Dubai’s commerce sector are required to register with the relevant authorities, like Dubai Customs.

The UAE exported items worth an entire amount of $36.6 billion in August 2022, one year prior. This is a significant increase from the $ 35 billion in the month prior. The UAE’s total exports climbed by 37.8% in August 2022 comparing it to the same month the previous year, as per the IMF’s most current reports. Nevertheless, the value of all imports rose by 18.0% from the prior month to $ 28 billion in April 2022.

The investments incurred by import export business in Dubai contribute to the stabilization of the local economy. If your import-export business is just starting, keep an eye out for opportunities that can arise due to enticing factors like infrastructure and lenient tax regulations.

The following are a few of the region’s principal imports and exports:

Major Exports

United Arab Emirates are a member of the World Trade Organization and a major trading partner for around 32 countries worldwide. The main export commodities are petroleum and natural gas, in addition to food items and goods for re-export. Dubai also exports metals, including copper and aluminum, and its biggest commercial partners include India, South Korea, Thailand, Japan, and Iran.

  • Natural gas: The world’s natural gas resource holdings appear to ranking eighth by the UAE. A substantial volume of natural gas goes overseas. In the UAE, each region maintains its own manufacturing and management. Natural gas production across the entire Emirate averages 4.7 billion cubic feet per year.
  • Crude oil: Crude oil has been the UAE’s biggest asset in keeping brisk international trade activity going. The volume of crude oil available makes the emirates seem to be the hub for global exporting. Crude oil exports are Abu Dhabi’s primary source of revenue as the capital of the UAE. An export business in Dubai can ship crude oil along with any other type of material.
  • Date: The UAE ranks 4th in global rankings for date fruit exports. 40% of the dates grown in the UAE originate just in Dubai. The main countries that use freight forwarding companies in Dubai to export dates to are Europe, North Africa, Oman, South East Asia, and Europe.

Major Imports

The most frequently items brought into Dubai include food, chemical products, machinery, and supplies for transportation. Dubai also imports a range of essential items from China and India, including fabrics and metals, as well as textiles, cottons, devices, and tools. Jewelry and gold rank among the top imported products.

Germany, the United States, and Japan are major import suppliers. Electronic gadgets, precious metals, inorganic chemicals, furniture and appliances, minerals, shoes, clothing, leather, engines, ceramics, drinks containing alcohol, and dairy products are among the other goods imported into the UAE.

The most typical imports are:

  • Equipment and machinery: A vast variety of machinery and equipment are imported into the UAE. including vehicles, equipment for producing electricity, commercial and general industrial equipment. The UAE receives a lot of industrial machinery from China. Importing this equipment becomes quicker when working with a company in UAE that holds an import license Dubai.
  • Food: Due to its geographic location, the UAE finds it challenging to sustain a level of supply during the year. The UAE’s temperature is frequently hot throughout daytime and frigid at night because of the country’s extensive desert terrain. Companies in Dubai have access to a wide network of shipping brokers for a straightforward movement of goods. The United Kingdom, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Netherlands, India, Turkey, the United States, Bulgaria, Thailand, and France are the region’s top import partners.
  • Chemicals: Chemicals are crucial for a country’s healthcare system and for the growth of science. Without an ample supply of chemicals, it is challenging to maintain a good flow of drugs. Chemical raw materials are necessary to create medicines and other products that use chemicals. Shipping firms in Dubai import a lot of chemicals from countries including America, Australia, the UK, India, Switzerland, Spain, France, Italy, Germany, and Brazil.

Import/Export Clearance Procedure in Dubai

In order to facilitate the flow of cargo into or out of a nation (import and export), customs clearance is the act of moving products through the customs authority. To ensure that domestic and foreign vehicles, cargo, and other items are not being imported or exported illegally, the entire customs clearance procedure involves identification and monitoring at seaports, airports, and frontiers.

This procedure verifies that all tariffs are currently collected and that all products receive the necessary export authorization. In order to enter or exit a country or territory, you must also get import and export permits, generally referred to as a customs certificate or declaration.

In UAE, the customs department issues the Import-Export Code (IEC). It is necessary for moving commodities into and out of the UAE. A business that engages in such trade activity and holds a current trade license issued by the UAE licensing agency is eligible to apply for the UAE IEC.

You will need the following when applying for a customs code in Dubai:

  • Trading license.
  • Valid passport.
  • Valid visa.
  • Emirates ID.
  • Letter of undertaking. (Only if the applicant has a professional license in UAE).

You need a customs code if you wish to do import or export business in the UAE. Alongside your business license, this document is necessary. Firstly, applicants have to register on the Dubai Customs website in order to receive their Code.

To get your code, you must fill out an online form and pay the fee. Your application will then be under examination. Applicants will obtain the Customs Code you after the authorities accept it.

Your customs identity will initially be valid up until the day that your business license expires. Applicants have to renew your code each year once their business license has been updated.

Steps to Get an Import-Export License in Dubai

In Dubai, a range of import and export standards are available to launch your own import-export business in Dubai. In addition to acquisitions for re-export operations, these include procedures for import and export from local companies to free zones. As well as systems for imports and exports from local enterprises to the rest of the world. The protocol specifies the paperwork that is necessary for any form of import export business in Dubai.

  • Prior to beginning its import-export activities in a UAE Free Zone or on the mainland of Dubai, an entity must apply for an import-export business license with the DED.
  • The Customs Department is also responsible for handling exports and imports codes, customs record clearance, and trade license authorization.
  • All companies with active trade licenses must get import-export codes prior to beginning any import-export activities in or out of the Emirates.
  • It is also essential that you pay the import export license cost in Dubai.

So, this is how to start import export business in Dubai. In 2025, Dubai has been quite receptive to imports and exports, and things look well for 2026. Even though there will be many more prospects for an import-export business in Dubai, these will undoubtedly be the top opportunities in Dubai’s global trade. To achieve, all you need is a strong sense of drive and commitment.

With our support, companies can establish their businesses in the UAE without issues. So, get in touch with our team and enjoy the benefits of working with Connect Zone!

FAQs

How can I start an import export business in Dubai?

To start an import export business in Dubai, you need a trading license and customs registration. Don’t forget to take approvals from the relevant authorities.

What license is required for import export business in Dubai?

A commercial trading license is required for import and export activities.

How much investment is needed for an import export business in Dubai?

Import export business Investment depends on scale, licensing authority, and operational requirements.

Do I need customs registration for import export in the UAE?

Customs registration is mandatory to clear goods through UAE ports.

Is the import export business profitable in Dubai?

Dubai’s strategic location and logistics infrastructure make it highly profitable.

acceptedAnswer.text: To start an import-export business in 2026, you must select a jurisdiction (Mainland or Free Zone), obtain a Commercial License, and most importantly, register with Dubai Customs to get a Customs Client Code. You also need to open a corporate bank account and manage VAT/Corporate Tax registrations.

acceptedAnswer.text: A 'Commercial Trading License' is required. If you deal in various unrelated goods, a 'General Trading License' is recommended, although it has higher fees.

mainEntity.name: How much investment is needed for an import export business in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: The initial investment typically ranges from AED 21,000 to AED 45,000. This includes license fees (AED 13,500 - 28,500), customs registration, and initial visa costs. Prices vary based on whether you rent a physical warehouse or use a virtual office.

mainEntity.name: Do I need customs registration for import export in the UAE?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, customs registration is mandatory. You must obtain a 'Customs Code' through the Dubai Trade portal. The registration fee is approximately AED 100-120, and it must be renewed annually.

mainEntity.name: Is the import export business profitable in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is highly profitable due to Dubai's strategic location connecting Asia, Europe, and Africa. In 2026, high-demand goods include electronics, gold/jewelry, textiles, and organic food products.

title: A Guide to Dropshipping in the UAE
content:

Beginning a business is an excellent idea, especially in locations like the Middle East. However, a guide can come in handy to achieve success faster and for a longer time. In this sense, we want to help you with this guide to Dropshipping in the UAE.

We will use this article to present everything you need to know to start a dropshipping business in the UAE today. Logically, it includes details about setting up a dropshipping business in Dubai. So, let us help you begin your journey by discussing the following:

How the process of purchasing, selling, or acquiring goods functions

The UAE offers several options regarding starting a business in the Middle East today. For instance, locations like the Dubai International Financial Center are a hub for successful corporations. But what can you do if you want to run a remote business?

One excellent option is Dropshipping in the UAE. Indeed, it involves displaying your supplier’s products on a website to find customers. Once they buy, you tell your supplier to ship its products directly to them. Logically, you will win a commission for every sale.

The process seems simple and attractive for every businessperson, even if you have a logistics business in Dubai. Nonetheless, it requires knowledge related to E-commerce, advertising, and communication. Let us detail how purchasing, selling, or acquiring goods functions.

Above all, the process is simple for the buyer, even outside the UAE. After all, you visit a UAE dropshipping business website to select and buy one or more products. Lastly, you wait for a few days, and the products will arrive at your door.

On the contrary, it is a more complex process if you want to start a dropshipping business in the UAE. Remember, you must handle your website and become a direct contact between your clients and suppliers. Do you see why communication is a paramount feature?

In summary, you can consider setting up a dropshipping business in Dubai as an excellent idea. But what does dropshipping in the UAE require financially?

What Type of financial support is needed to initiate a dropshipping business?

If you are learning to do business in Dubai as an entrepreneur, you should acquire financial knowledge. After all, it is essential to determine the investment you need and the profit you require to avoid losses. But how does it apply to dropshipping in the UAE today?

The first aspect of this subject is the financial support you need to initiate your UAE dropshipping business. By all odds, you may believe you cannot enter this business without a considerable investment. Nevertheless, setting up a dropshipping business in Dubai is not that expensive.

So, what do you need financially? The financial support you need for dropshipping in the UAE divides into three parts. First, you will need a dropshipping license in the UAE. Therefore, you need to pay the required fee and the assistance you used to get it.

Second, you need to pay for your UAE dropshipping business website. Indeed, it involves buying your domain and paying your website developers’ rates. So, you may have to call your friend in the software company in Dubai for assistance and consultancy.

Lastly, your final investment must be about communications and technology. In other words, you cannot start a dropshipping business in the UAE without excellent workstations and efficient connectivity. Fortunately, it is an easy feature to cover in the Emirates.

You now know how dropshipping in the UAE works and what to pay to set up a dropshipping business. However, why should you enter this line of business in places like Dubai or Abu Dhabi?

Exploring the prospect and benefits of dropshipping in the UAE

The list of benefits can be extensive if you think about establishing a UAE branch of your company today. Nonetheless, dropshipping in the UAE involves a different set of advantages. Indeed, they still confirm that setting up a dropshipping business in Dubai is an outstanding idea.

By all odds, we can begin by highlighting that a UAE dropshipping business is an excellent choice, financially speaking. After all, it can be a business that requires low investment and generates high profits in no time. Indeed, it looks too good to be true.

On the other hand, you will meet several people after you start a dropshipping business in the UAE. From suppliers in mainland Abu Dhabi to clients in Europe, you will build an excellent contacts list fast. Who knows? You may find other suppliers among your customers.

Lastly, it is worth mentioning that dropshipping in the UAE is still a young market today. As a result, you will find little-to-no competition if you choose the correct products to sell online. So, setting up a dropshipping business in Dubai means taking advantage of unique opportunities.

In summary, it will be a no-brainer to say “yes” if someone asks you to start a dropshipping business in the UAE today. But what do you need to do to begin? Our following topic will be your step-by-step guide for it.

Initiating a dropshipping venture in the UAE: a step-by-step guide

We hope you arrived here convinced about setting up a dropshipping business in Dubai. After all, the UAE is a location where even PRO services a top-of-the-line without question. So, what steps should you take to begin with dropshipping in the UAE?

Depending on factors such as the type of product you want to offer or your suppliers, these steps may vary for you. However, we will present you with the four main ones you cannot avoid regardless of everything. In other words, they are your must-do to begin your business journey.

In addition, remember that it is essential to adjust these steps to your UAE dropshipping business. For instance, you may need additional resources, such as a Business Center in Dubai. Therefore, consider every aspect possible before beginning this process.

So, it is time to discover the process of setting up a dropshipping business in Dubai or elsewhere in the UAE. Do you want to learn about it? It involves performing these four essential steps:

Your new idea

Regardless of your industry, your first move to start a business in the UAE is developing a new idea. For instance, you can ask yourself simple questions: Is my product something I would buy? Does my project have potential regarding marketing and cost-effectiveness?

Furthermore, you cannot develop a new idea without considering an essential detail: demand. Indeed, dropshipping in the UAE is a supply-and-demand business. Therefore, you must focus your plan on covering an unsatisfied requirement in the market.

Lastly, it is worth mentioning that you should assess a demand that will potentially increase over time. After all, you do not want to start a dropshipping business in the UAE that will last a year or less. Fortunately, several professionals at the Abu Dhabi Global Market can help you.

In conclusion, your idea is your access card to dropshipping in the UAE today. What idea is the best? It is up to you to discover the answer. However, you will find it faster by following the second step of this guide: researching the market.

Researching the market

Dropshipping in the UAE relies primarily on one paramount element: knowing what to sell and how. Therefore, we recommend going to your office in the IFZA Free Zone and beginning the best step towards such knowledge: researching the market.

In this sense, it is essential to discover how to reach your clients and make them feel attracted to your business. Do they prefer a chat to contact you? Or will it be better to call them? Ask yourself these questions to start a dropshipping business in the UAE.

Moreover, this is the perfect stage to start spying on how other dropshipping businesses work in locations like Sharjah today. In other words, assess your competition to find demand they are not satisfying adequately. Did you find it? It will be the target market of your UAE dropshipping business.

Lastly, remember that the formula you use today may not work tomorrow in the UAE or elsewhere. Therefore, you should perform regular market research to adapt your business to every possible change. This way, you will ensure its survival and success.

Choosing your suppliers

So, imagine you know what to offer your clients and that one of them makes a purchase. By all odds, it will make you smile to see dropshipping in the UAE coming to life for you. But what about the people that must build and ship their registered products?

At this stage, your next step is to choose the supplies for your UAE dropshipping business. First, you should ensure that these suppliers manufacture products with excellent quality. Remember, you will get an angry call if one of these products fails to function adequately.

Furthermore, your suppliers must keep up with your business demand constantly. Indeed, you will find it uncomfortable to keep your customers waiting weeks for a product that they expect to get in mainland Ajman in days. We hope your suppliers see your demand as a challenge instead of a problem.

Lastly, remember that you should also evaluate your suppliers regarding money. After all, dropshipping in the UAE is a business where your profit depends on the product’s price. Therefore, you may find trouble if they change their prices regularly.

Complying with UAE regulations

As in every country, local laws and regulations dictate how to do business in the UAE. For instance, you must apply for a Professional License to provide your services in Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Nevertheless, how does this apply to dropshipping in the UAE today?

Setting up a dropshipping business in Dubai requires a dropshipping license in the UAE. Above all, it is a document you can get by submitting your application to the Department of Economic Development (DED). Do you only need this license for your UAE dropshipping business? No, there is more.

Dropshipping in the UAE is a commercial activity. As a result, your business may require a Commercial License to operate adequately in any one of the Emirates. Assuredly, you must register your company and trademark in the UAE before getting these licenses.

Finally, we arrived at the final step of setting up a dropshipping business in Dubai. With all the legal aspects covered, it is time to build an excellent store for your clients.

Building an outstanding E-commerce store

Remember the market research we mentioned earlier? Here is where your findings will make your business stand out. Indeed, the final step is to build an E-commerce store that is tough to ignore for your clients. But how can you do that in the UAE today?

Fortunately, the UAE is a place where several freelancers provide excellent services related to technology. We can ensure you will find one that will help you design and build a website worthy of an award for your UAE dropshipping business. Logically, it involves specific details.

For example, your E-commerce store should be attractive, simple, easy to explore, and with effective methods of communication. In other words, it should feel appealing for people in the US and Umm al Quwain simultaneously.

Lastly, most marketing professionals recommend using social media platforms for your advertising strategies. So, visualize how your business’s Instagram or Facebook profile will look as soon as you start a dropshipping business in the UAE.

In conclusion, dropshipping in the UAE is a business with more advantages than you can imagine. So, stop waiting for other business possibilities and focus on building your UAE dropshipping business. Undoubtedly, you will not regret it for a second.

 

FAQs

Is dropshipping legal in the UAE?
 Yes. Dropshipping is legal in the UAE, but you must have a proper business license to operate. Doing it without a license can lead to fines or penalties.

What license is required for dropshipping in UAE?
 You need an e‑commerce or trade license from a free zone or the mainland that allows online sales and lets you open a business bank account.

How much does a dropshipping license cost in UAE?
 In 2025, free zone e‑commerce licenses start around AED 5,750–15,000 per year, while mainland e‑commerce licenses typically cost AED 12,000–20,000 or more depending on office and visas.

Can foreigners do dropshipping in UAE?
 Yes. Foreigners can fully own a dropshipping business in UAE by registering in a free zone or a mainland setup that allows 100% foreign ownership.

Is dropshipping profitable in UAE?
 Yes. With high internet use, growing e‑commerce demand, and access to global suppliers, dropshipping can be profitable if products and marketing are chosen carefully.

Which free zone is best for dropshipping business?
 Top free zones for dropshipping include Dubai CommerCity, Meydan Free Zone, SHAMS, RAKEZ, and SPC Free Zone because they offer e‑commerce licenses, 100% foreign ownership, and flexible packages.

title: Everything You Need to Know About UAE’s Unified Number
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle

    • Find your Unified number UAE online

  • How to Get a Unified Number?
    • Documents to obtain the UID for a tourist visit
    • Documents to obtain the UID for a family visit
    • Documents to obtain the UID for a trade mission visit

    • Documents to obtain the UID for a work entry permit
