The United Arab Emirates is an attractive country to live in. Thousands of people decide to start a new life surrounded with:

  • tall skyscrapers
  • beautiful beaches
  • an avant-garde structure

Application for a UAE residence visa is necessary to achieve this.

Here you will find information about:

  • the UAE residence visa
  • who can opt for one
  • what are the requirements to apply for it
  • what is the cost of this type of visa
  • how we can help you obtain it

1. What is a residence visa?

A residence visa in the UAE is a permit. The government of the United Arab Emirates issues it. Foreigners live and work in the country with the permit.

This permit is valid for:

  • 2 years
  • 3 years
  • even 10 years

A person can renew it as many times as they need.

Many foreign families live in the Emirates for many years. They renew their visas at the appropriate time. Permanent stay does not exist in this country. Being a resident in the UAE means having a stamp in your passport and living in the country.

2. Types of residence visas in the UAE

The type of visa you apply for is related to your trip’s purpose. For example:

2.1 Work visa

This type of visa is for people:

  • who found work in the United Arab Emirates
  • who obtained the work permit

2.2 Family visa

Close relatives of citizens or foreigners who reside there can apply for this visa.

2.3 Student visa

Opting for this type of visa are:

  • foreigners who have applied in educational organisations
  • have been accepted in some of the institutions of the UAE

2.4 Investment visa

People who make a large investment in the UAE opt for this type of visa. This visa has a longer duration than the other residence visas. It is up to ten years.

2.5 Retirement visa

It is for elderly foreigners:

  • who want to return to the United Arab Emirates
  • have the financial support to do so

3. Who is eligible for UAE residency?

Foreigners apply for a residence visa if they are:

3.1 Employed by a company

The company that hired the person will act as their sponsor. It will apply for a residence visa while this person is within the UAE.

3.2 Employed by the government sector

The corresponding government entity will be in charge of acting as a sponsor. They will also be the one applying for the residence visa.

3.3 Owners of a property in the UAE

Those who own property in the United Arab Emirates are eligible for a residence visa. They qualify for aproperty visa too.. For this visa will be sponsored under the property they own.

3.4 University students sponsored

Students who carry out their studies in an Institute of the United Arab Emirates apply for this visa. The university will be in charge of being the sponsor. They will request the visa under the name of the institution.

3.5 Sponsored dependents

Dependents sponsored by:

  • A business owner/investor in the UAE
  • A property owner in the UAE
  • Someone who has found a job in the UAE

You must remember that dependents include:

  • parents
  • children
  • close relatives
  • maids

Also, a residence visa is issued when the foreigner has decided to enter the country through an entry permit, a long or a short-term tourist or visit visa.

4. How to get a residence visa in the Emirates?

You must follow the following steps to apply for a residence visa:

4.1 Legalisation of documents

Complete the application process for a UAE residence visa. You will need the attestation of the university certificate. Get it at the embassy of the United Arab Emirates in your home country. This process can take from 2 to 6 weeks.

4.2 Entry permit

They will deliver the entry permit to you in a period of 6 to 9 business days. In some cases, the authorities select some applications for extra review. This makes the process longer.

After the application, the authorities can approve or deny the entry permit. It depends on the deduction of the immigration department.

4.3 Status change

After the approval, the foreigner becomes eligible to enter the United Arab Emirates. This permit is valid for all internal applicants who do not need to leave the country.

The validity of the entry permit is 60 days after the date of issuance. Register the entrance to the country in this period. Do this at any of the country’s entry points. Another way to perform this step is to leave the country and enter again using the issued entry permit.

4.4 Medical examination

All foreigners over 18 years of age undergo medical check-ups before entering UAE. It is a part of the UAE’s immigration regulations. The medical examination includes:

  • a chest X-ray for tuberculosis screening
  • a blood test for HIV/AIDS

The process of this medical report takes from 1 to 4 business days.

4.5 Emirates ID registration and biometrics

Every person over 15 years of age must attend a biometric appointment,. It includes the following:

  • A digital signature
  • Fingerprinting
  • A photograph at an approved government centre

For renewing an Emirates ID, the biometric process will not be necessary. The delivery time of the ID is 14 business days.  This will depend on:

  • the approval of your residence
  • the issuance of the visa

4.6 Visa stamping

Complete the medical check-up. If the report is normal, the immigration authorities will approve the residence permit. The UAE residence visa will be stamped on your passport. This process usually takes 5 to 7 days.

4.7 Receiving Emirates ID Card

The government authorities will approve your visa. They will process your Emirates ID. The EID authorities issue the ID. It is after they receive confirmation from the Immigration department. The total time for this is 7 business days.

5. What are the requirements to apply for a residence visa?

Submit these documents:

  • Your original passport
  • Entry permit
  • The UAE visa application received either online or via the nearest typing centre
  • Two photos the size of your passport, as stated in the visa application regulations in the UAE
  • For a work visa, the company must include:
    • a copy of the employment contract
    • copies of the valid firm card
    • valid trade license
  • Proof of your UAE medical insurance plan
  • For family visas, include proof of family ties. For example, marriage certificates or birth certificates.

6. The cost of a residence visa in the UAE

The cost of a residence visa in the UAE will depend on its validity period. You can view some prices in the following list:

  • Investor visa: This 3-year residence visa in Dubai costs AED 2,478 per year.
  • Family visa (For the family of a partner): This 3 year residence visa in Dubai costs AED 2,478 per year.
  • Family visa (For the family of an employee): This visa has a validity period of 2 years and has a cost of AED 3,727.
  • Working visa: This visa has a validity period of 2 years and has a cost of AED 3,727.

7. Benefits of being a resident in the Emirates

Enjoy the following benefits:

  • Access government health services and health insurance
  • Access financial facilities
  • Open a bank account
  • Apply for a driving licence
  • Travel visa-free to certain destinations
  • Work and invest
  • Register your children in government schools

8. How to renew your UAE residence visa?

To renew your visa, your sponsor must do so within 30 days before the expiry date. Your sponsor can renew after the expiry date. It is possible as long as it is within the UAE residence visa’s expiry grace period.

Your sponsor must apply for a new Visa for you at:

  1. the General Directorate of Residency
  2. Foreigners Affairs in the corresponding Emirate

8.1 UAE Residence visa: Expiry grace period

The authorities of the United Arab Emirates offer an extension of time when your UAE residence visa expires. This time is 30 days. It means that even if your visa expired you can stay in the country for one more month.

If at the end of 30 days you have not renewed your visa, you must leave the country and enter again with an entry permit. If you stay longer, you will receive a fine for each extra day.

9. Differences between the entry permit and a residence visa

These are the difference between an entry permit and a UAE residence visa:

  • Foreigners enter the country for a specific period with an entry permit. It is usually three months.
  • This permit goes by the purpose of your trip. An entry permit for tourism is a UAE tourist visa.
  • Your sponsor applies for your entry permit before you enter the United Arab Emirates.
  • Your sponsor will be able to apply for your residence visa after you have entered the UAE.

Some nationalities do not need an entry permit. They can get one upon arrival in the country.

The new residence visa in the UAE allows foreigners to live in the country for a longer period. Once you enter the country, your sponsor must complete the application process for a residence visa. It has to be done with the corresponding government entities.

10. How can we help you apply for a UAE residence visa?

The United Arab Emirates receives thousands of people. They are looking for a change in their lives. These changes always bring with them:

  • procedures
  • paperwork
  • a lot of documentation

This is where Connect Zone can be your best ally. We will be with you every step of the way to get your UAE residence visa. We offer you our services through your visa application.

Want to learn more? Contact us by writing an email to info@connectzone.ae.

FAQs

Can I apply for an Emirates ID without a UAE residency visa?

No. A valid residency visa is required before you can apply for an Emirates ID.

How do I check the status of my Emirates ID?

You can check it through the ICP website or mobile app using your application or passport number.

How do I renew my Emirates ID in the UAE?

Submit your renewal application through the ICP website or an approved typing center, then complete biometrics if required.

Can entrepreneurs in the UAE get a residency visa and an Emirates ID?

Yes. Business owners can apply for investor or partner residence visas and Emirates ID

Can a tourist visa be converted to a UAE residence visa?

Yes, but it depends on the visa type and specific eligibility rules.

Can I buy property with a Dubai residence visa?

Residence visa holders can purchase property in designated freehold areas.

content:

    • How long does a fashion store company formation take?

When it comes to the fashion industry, Dubai has positioned itself as a world leader. Multiple well-known brands have decided to establish themselves in Dubai to meet the demand for quality clothing and accessories. At the same time, many new entrepreneurs decide to take the risk and become the owners of a fashion store in Dubai.

In this article, you will find information about the fashion business, what are the steps to a fashion store business setup in Dubai, what benefits can you get by opening this type of store, how to start an online fashion store and how we can help you meet your goals.

  1. The fashion business in Dubai
  2. How to start a fashion store in Dubai?
  3. Benefits of a fashion store company formation in Dubai
  4. Why should you open a fashion store in Dubai?
  5. How to start an online fashion store?
  6. How can we help you open a fashion store in Dubai?

 

1. The fashion business in Dubai

 

In recent years, the fashion industry has reached a large part of the UAE market, due to the numerous strategies implemented.

According to Dubai Chamber Research, the fashion industry has contributed an amount of AED 44 billion, with an annual growth of 4.8 percent. Also, the industry is expected to grow the most between 2019 and 2023.

The UAE fashion industry has done a great job of attracting the attention of worldwide investors. Some of the most striking products are bags, footwear, accessories, and apparel.

In essence, Dubai is the perfect place for almost any company, its different areas allow economic flourishing for new entrepreneurs. In the case of the fashion industry, Dubai Design District is the perfect place to start your company.

1.1 Dubai Design District

Since its foundation in 2013, Dubai Design District has been characterized as an area full of opportunities for creative minds and entrepreneurs interested in the fashion industry. This area had a global value of AED 3 billion in 2019 and its sales continue to increase.

2. How to start a fashion store in Dubai?

To open a fashion store in Dubai you must take into consideration the following steps:

2.1 Market research

The first task you must perform is market research. You must understand the population and your target audience, know their preferences and tastes to satisfy their needs.

Analyzing the competition, understanding the demands of the public, and learning what strategies work in the market will be essential for the success of your company.

2.2 Clear your products and your target audience

Once the market study has been carried out, you need to clarify what products you will sell and to whom it is directed. Also, you need to have a clear idea of ​​the supply and demand for your products and form an active network around them.

2.3 Strategic location

It is well known that the United Arab Emirates offers flexibility when choosing a location for your company. Choosing a favorable location is vital to the success of your business.

2.4 Required documents

To complete the process of registering your company, you need to submit the necessary documents to the Department of Economic Development. The necessary documents are the following:

  • Passport and visa copies of the shareholder
  • No Objection Certificate for initial and name approval
  • The application form filled out
  • Memorandum and Articles of Association (MoA/AoA)
  • A well-structured business plan

2.5 Approval and license

After the submission of the documents, you need to obtain the approval of the corresponding government entities. Once the approval is received, you will be able to withdraw your specific business license. This license will serve as permission to operate in Dubai.

2.6 Accounting and bookkeeping

From the beginning of your company, you must be very clear about the income and expenses generated. Keeping an accounting and bookkeeping record will help you with the organization of your company.

2.7 Product marketing

The reputation of a fashion store in Dubai is of paramount importance if you want to be successful. For this reason, you should focus on making your brand and products known, investing in marketing strategies, and promoting your services in the local area.

2.8 Online presence

To extend your reach in the market, it is necessary to create an online presence that fits the dynamics of your company and the business environment. In addition to this, creating a web page where you show your products will help you reach a local and international audience.

If you want to enter the fashion industry, there are different types of companies that you can choose from. For example:

  • Opening a fashion boutique
  • Manufacturing business
  • Online fashion business
  • Wholesaler

The fashion industry in Dubai is a sector full of possibilities for new entrepreneurs, and if approached with the correct strategies, it can result in a very profitable business.

3. Benefits of a fashion store company formation in Dubai

Among the many benefits of starting a fashion store in Dubai, there are the following:

  • Free zone benefits
  • No restrictions on trading locations
  • Low import duty
  • First-class infrastructure
  • No minimum capital requirement
  • Work along with government bodies
  • Tax benefits
  • No restriction in currency limitation
  • More options for business activities
  • No limitations to the number of visas

4. Why should you open a fashion store in Dubai?

Entering a market that is full of big brands in the fashion industry can be challenging. However, the fact that these brands exist only shows the demand for high-quality clothes and apparel.

This presents opportunities for small and medium-sized businesses to offer services that the big brands cannot. (Boutique fashion, homegrown, etc.) If you think you have the necessary skills to succeed in this world, check the following considerations:

4.1 Huge potential in the market

While the prestigious, international brands fill the need for hot couture clothing, there is still interest from the UAE locals for other types of clothing. The modest, homegrown, and UAE fashion houses are just flourishing and it is a turning point for new entrepreneurs.

In 2021, UAE locals have spent millions on clothing, footwear, and accessories of this kind, with the big brands just watching from afar. It is important to point out that this gap in the market can be considered an opportunity for those entrepreneurs who wish to create a fashion company in Dubai.

4.2 Set up in a Free Zone or in Mainland

Depending on the nature of your company, you can establish your business in a Free Zone or the Mainland. If what you are looking for is to have a retail outlet, then a Mainland Setup is the best option for you.

On the other hand, if you decide to start an e-commerce fashion company, you will notice that the benefits of the Free Zones are more adapted to your needs.

For example, no corporate and personal tax, 100% ownership, and full export and import tax exemption.

4.3 Easy setup

To start a fashion company, either in a Free Zone or in the Mainland, no additional licenses are needed. The process of establishing this type of business is incredibly easy, if you decide to open your company in the Mainland, go to the Department of Economic Development, the process will not take more than 90 minutes.

If you decide to open your company in a Free Zone, all you have to do is go to the authorities of the corresponding zone. Licenses are normally delivered within a couple of days.

The only thing you need to start trading is a license. However, if you wish to establish a brand, you must apply for a trademark, and this can only be requested through the Ministry of Economy.

Whether you decide to settle in the Mainland or a Free Zone, you will find it favorable to hire a specialized company formation services provider, such as our agency, to ensure that the process is carried out successfully.

4.4 Multiple shareholders

Although you have the option to work alone and create the company on your own, you can also establish your company with multiple shareholders in the Mainland or a Free Zone. These shareholders can be corporate entities or individuals.

4.5 Multiple visas

When setting up your fashion company, you will come across many visa options. If you decide to settle in a Free Zone, you will have a limit of visas for which you can apply, and this limit will be directly related to the office space you have. In contrast, for the formation of a company in the Mainland, there is no limit on visas.

However, this is also directly related to your premises. The general rule is one visa for every 100 sq. ft. of office space.

 4.6 Sponsor your dependents

While you must apply for the necessary visas for you and your employees, you can also sponsor your dependents for their visa application. Whether you need a visa for a child, spouse, driver, etc. The process is the following:

  • Entry permits
  • Status adjustment
  • Medical fitness test
  • Emirates ID registration and visa stamping

4.7 Open a corporate bank account easily

Once you have applied for your license and established your company, you will be able to opt for a bank account. The process to acquire one is very simple, if you decide to open your company in a Free Zone, your staff can advise you on which bank best suits your interests.

On the contrary, if you decide to open your company in the Mainland, an agency specialized in company formation can carry out this process for you. Also, if you prefer, you can go to a local or international bank yourself.

5. How to start an online fashion store in Dubai?

Firstly, online global retailers are a millionaire business and by far one of the most attractive e-commerce areas. Secondly, with revenues exceeding AED 50 billion annually, the online fashion industry is a world of opportunity for new entrepreneurs.

If you are interested in forming an online store in Dubai, check out the following steps:

5.1 Trade license

The main thing to form an online fashion store in Dubai is to legitimize it. Dubai offers a variety of e-commerce licenses that will allow you to operate both in the Mainland and in the Free Zones.

5.2 Cost

The cost of forming an e-commerce company can vary from one area to another. For example, an e-commerce trade license in Dubai Media City can cost AED 40,000 and is divided into:

  • Registration: AED 9,020
  • Initial application: AED 1,015
  • Establishment card: AED 1,800
  • License: AED 20,285
  • Memorandum of Association (MoA): AED 2,020
  • Residence visa: AED 3,330
  • Visa deposit: AED 3,000

5.3 Documents

For the approval of the e-commerce trade license, you must submit the following documents:

  • Copy of investor’s passport
  • Business plan for online clothing store
  • Proof of residential address in the country of residence
  • Filled and attested online application form
  • The lease agreement of office space in DMCC

5.4 Online payments

Including an online payment system allows the entrepreneur to generate profits through the online store. To do this, you will need to have two bank accounts, a commercial bank account, and a merchant bank account.

The commercial bank account is managed by the business, while the merchant bank account is managed by the investor and will handle all of the buyer’s online transactions.

5.5 Logistics support

It is essential for a fashion company to partner with shipping companies that are capable of delivering products on time and safely. Shipping companies in Dubai offer corporate packages to e-commerce companies, depending on the needs of your company.

6. How can we help you open a fashion store in Dubai?

Connect Zone is an agency dedicated to advising our clients to meet their goals as entrepreneurs in Dubai. We are known for working quickly and efficiently and we place your interests as a priority.

We can help you with the request and application of your trade license, we can act as your Public Relations Officer, and also we can accompany you in each step of the formation of your business.

Do you want to know more about our business setup services? You can contact us through the following email address: info@connectzone.ae where you will speak with one of our representatives, who will answer all your questions.

Lastly, if you are interested in working with us, you can go to thetalentpoint.com and send an application. Also, you can send your CV to contact@thetalentpoint.com. We do not share or store your information.

FAQs

What license is required to open a fashion store in Dubai?

To open a fashion store, you need a commercial or retail trade license from the relevant authority.

How much does it cost to start a fashion business in Dubai?

Setting up a fashion business costs vary. It depends on location, store size, and licensing authority.

Can foreigners open a fashion store in Dubai?

Absolutely! Foreigners can own fashion businesses in Dubai with full ownership.

Is a physical shop mandatory for a fashion business?

In Dubai, retail fashion stores require a physical shop location.

What are the legal requirements for fashion retail in Dubai?

The legal requirements for fashion retail in Dubai are a trade license, a tenancy contract, approvals, and VAT registration.

How long does a fashion store company formation take?

The fashion store company formation takes around two to four weeks.

mainEntity.name: What license is required to open a fashion store in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: To open a physical fashion store, you need a Commercial Trade License from the Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET). If you are selling only online, an E-commerce license from a Free Zone like SHAMS or SPC is sufficient.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to start a fashion business in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: The license cost starts from AED 12,000 to AED 25,000. However, the total setup cost for a physical store (including shop rent, interior, and stock) generally ranges between AED 100,000 to AED 500,000 depending on the location.

mainEntity.name: Can foreigners open a fashion store in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely! Foreigners can now have 100% ownership of their fashion retail business in the Dubai Mainland and Free Zones without needing a local UAE national as a majority shareholder.

mainEntity.name: Is a physical shop mandatory for a fashion business?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a 'Retail' license in the Mainland, a physical shop and an Ejari (lease agreement) are mandatory. However, for an 'Online Fashion Brand,' you can operate with a virtual office in a Free Zone.

mainEntity.name: What are the legal requirements for fashion retail in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: The key requirements include a valid Trade License, a Tenancy Contract (Ejari), Dubai Municipality approvals for shop fit-outs, and VAT registration if your annual turnover exceeds AED 375,000.

mainEntity.name: How long does a fashion store company formation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The initial license can be issued in as little as 1-3 days (Instant License), but the complete process, including finding a shop, fit-outs, and visa processing, usually takes 2 to 4 weeks.

All companies in the United Arab Emirates, in order to operate legally and efficiently, must submit several documents to the corresponding government entities. This process can be long and tedious, especially if you are an entrepreneur who is just starting in the United Arab Emirates. For this reason, we are going to guide you step by step with the PRO services in Sharjah and Abu Dhabi.

In this article, you will find information about what a Public Relations Officer is and how to choose the best PRO services in Sharjah and Abu Dhabi. Also, you will learn why your company needs a PRO and what services you can enjoy by hiring a specialized agency in the UAE.

  1. What is a PRO service?
  2. What do PRO services offer in the UAE?
  3. When do companies need PRO services?
  4. Advantages of hiring PRO services in Sharjah and Abu Dhabi
  5. How to choose the best PRO services in Sharjah and Abu Dhabi?
  6. Why does your business need a PRO service?
  7. How can Connect Zone help you find PRO services in Sharjah and Abu Dhabi?

1. What is a PRO service?

 

The PRO Services in the UAE are those activities related to the documentation and paperwork that must be consigned to the corresponding government entities in order to work and live in the UAE.

Among the most common PRO services are the following:

  • Family Visas
  • Emirates ID Cards
  • Labour and Immigration Cards
  • Company and Branch Formation
  • Annual License Renewals and Updates
  • Resident and Employee Visa
  • Notarization of Legal Documents
  • Investors Visa
  • Labour Quota applications
  • Offshore and Security Passes (CICPA)
  • Regulatory Approvals and NOC letters

2. What do PRO services offer in the UAE?

PROs or Public Relations Officers are professional government liaison officers in the area of ​​regulations, administrative policies, and laws of the government of the United Arab Emirates. PROs are able to develop a good relationship and communication with government officials, thus allowing the accomplishment of procedures quickly and effectively.

Hiring a PRO in Sharjah and Abu Dabhi for your company is not only a smart decision but also a cost-effective one too.

The experience of these officers in the area of ​​immigration, labor-related works, and their relations with the Ministry of Economy, allow the steady advance of the formation of your company.

Besides, Public Relations Officers are Independent workers who do not require much involvement from the entrepreneur. This way, you can focus on other aspects of your company formation.

Some services that you may need when forming a company are the following:

  • Translations
  • Attestation
  • Company Licensing
  • Visa Services
  • Government Approvals
  • Labor and Immigration Services

2.1 Labor of a PRO in the UAE

When starting a company in the UAE, the first thing you will need is a Company License or Trade License. This license will allow you to operate in the United Arab Emirates legally. The process of applying for this license can seem complicated, especially if you do not know the regulations and laws to open a company in Dubai or the UAE.

This is when hiring a PRO in Sharjah and Abu Dhabi becomes important. They will be the communication bridge between your company and the government, they will be in charge of submitting all the documents and they will also ensure the successful accomplishment of the application process for your license (managed by the Department of Economic Development)

2.2 Services offered by PRO Services Companies

Public Relations Officers are not only limited to starting the process of forming a company. On the contrary, they offer a wide variety of services to facilitate your stay and your work in the United Arab Emirates.

After the initial process, the business must establish, expand and increase its presence in the UAE society. And this will require the hiring of personnel, renewals, cancellations, and any other type of administrative procedure.

If you are an entrepreneur looking to set up your company, here are some of the documents you will need at some point:

  • Renewal and/or cancellation of trade license
  • Labor and Immigration Services, some are the following: Non-educational certificates, Commercial certificates/documentation, and Educational Certificates
  • Attestation of documents, some are the following: Execution of employment contracts and employment visa quotas and Issuance of residence visas and work permits

3. When do companies need PRO services?

Many people tend to assume that a PRO in the UAE is only required for processes related to Immigration and Visa applications. However, this is a false assumption, below are several situations where PRO services are more than needed.

3.1 Department of Economic Development:

Regarding a new license issuance:

  • Initial approval
  • MoA signing
  • Trade name reservation
  • Final submission of documents

For established companies:

  • Change in trade name
  • Change in business activity
  • Addition and/or removal of business partner or manager
  • Any amendment to trade license

3.2 Immigration

    • How much does it cost to receive a trade license in Dubai if you don’t have a physical office?

In recent years, Dubai has become the destination for excellence for new freelancers, entrepreneurs, or already consolidated businessmen who seek to expand their businesses in an area full of possibilities for economic growth. To carry out the formation of a company in Dubai successfully, it is necessary to obtain a Trade License Dubai, which will allow you to carry out all types of transactions legally and safely.

In this article, you will learn about what a Trade License Dubai is, how to get a Trade License in Dubai, what you need to know to get a Trade License without an office space, and how we can help you with the process of obtaining your license.

  1. What is a  UAE Trade License?
  2. Types of Trade License Dubai
  3. How to get a new Business License in Dubai?
  4. Benefits of applying for a new Trade License
  5. How to get a Business License Dubai without a physical office?
  6. What you should know about getting a Trade License Dubai without a physical office?
  7. How can we assist you through the process of obtaining a Trade License Dubai?

1. What is a UAE trade license?

 

A business license in Dubai is a document that indicates what activities a company can carry out in the UAE. General Trading Licenses apply to various activities and are issued by the Department of Economic Development. Keep in mind that among the activities that can be carried out with this type of license are the performance of commercial activities and the import and export of goods.

2. Types of Trade License Dubai

Currently, there are mainly three types of business licenses in Dubai (Commercial, Professional, and Industrial), however, you can find more depending on the economic jurisdiction in the areas of Dubai. Some of the trade licenses Dubai that you can find are the following:

2.1 Commercial Trade License:

Commercial Trade Licenses are delivered to those companies whose activities are directly related to trade, purchase, and sale of goods and services, export and import of products, brokerage activities, and car rental.

Important to realize: If your business is located in Dubai and you want to trade outside the UAE, you will still need a commercial trade license.

2.2 Professional License:

The Professional license allows individuals or companies to pursue their chosen profession, based on their education. Some of the activities covered by this type of license are the following:

  • Carpentry
  • Printing and Publishing
  • Security Services
  • Document Clearing
  • Repair Services
  • Beauty Salons
  • Medical Services
  • Computer Graphic Design
  • Craftsmanship.
  • Digital Marketing Services

With a professional license, foreign entrepreneurs can maintain 100% ownership of their company.

2.3 Industrial License Dubai:

If you have a company that is dedicated to industrial or manufacturing activities, you will require an Industrial License Dubai to carry out the activities. Entrepreneurs can assemble and process goods using domestic or imported raw materials. You need an Industrial License Dubai for the following activities:

  • Equipment and engines
  • Paper
  • Food
  • Textile
  • Metals
  • Petroleum products

2.4 Tourism License:

The Tourism License is for those businesses that operate activities related to the UAE tourism sector. Some activities are the following:

  • Cruise Boat Rental
  • Restaurants
  • Travel Agencies
  • Tourist Camps
  • Hotel rental
  • Guest House

The UEA government introduced this license for a more efficient control the tourism industry. Also, compared to the others, this Tourism license is relatively new.

2.5 Agriculture License:

This type of license is delivered to those businesses dedicated to cultivation and harvesting activities, installation of greenhouses, trading of pesticides. Also, it is given to those companies dedicated to agricultural consultancy.

2.6 Craftsmanship License:

Those individuals who engage in activities related to electrical work, plumbing, carpentry, must acquire this license. For this reason, if a company hires a craftsman, then they need to apply for the license.

In the United Arab Emirates, it is illegal to operate a business without the corresponding UAE license, you can be sanctioned or banned. In addition to this, the Trade License renewal must be every year to avoid penalties.

3. How to get a Business License Dubai?

 

Due to the growing population of entrepreneurs who have come to form new companies in Dubai, the UAE government has facilitated the process to acquire business license Dubai. The process consists of the following steps:

3.1 Choose the economic jurisdiction:

Firstly, to start a company, you must choose in which economic jurisdiction you want to operate. In Dubai, these can be Free Zones, Mainland, and offshore companies.

3.2 Choose the company structure:

At this point, you must choose the legal form, this will determine the rules and regulations to which your company must submit in the future.

 3.3 Select the business activity:

The productive activity to which you are going to dedicate yourself will determine the trade license for which you must apply. Select all activities to work because later you will not be able to operate activities that you did not choose beforehand.

3.4 Get the initial approval:

After completing the first three steps, you must get approval from the Department of economic development in Dubai, to do so you must fill out an application form that they will provide.

3.5 Choose your business location:

To get your business started, you must choose where your company will be. Once the place has been chosen, you must obtain a tenancy contract, Ejari must certify it and send it along with the rest of the documents.

3.6 Prepare the MOA

The memorandum of association is of the utmost importance when applying for a business license in Dubai. It is recommended to hire legal experts to carry out this document.

3.7 Get the external approval:

Depending on the productive activity chosen, you may need the approval of other government departments and entities.

3.8 Submit the documents to the Department of Economic Development

To complete your application for your trade license, you must submit the following documents:

  • The Memorandum of Association
  • The tenancy contract and EJARI
  • The initial approval letter from the DED
  • The DED application form
  • Copies of all the shareholders’ passports

These are some of the most common documents, however, others can be added, depending on the chosen productive activity.

3.9 Complete the final application

After completing all the above steps, you will need to submit the documents and complete the final application from the Department of Economic Development.

3.10 Pay the fees

Once approval is received from the Department of Economic Development, you must pay the fees and receive the trade application.

4. Benefits of applying for a new Trade License

There are many benefits to getting a Trade License Dubai, such as:

4.1 Low taxes

One of the reasons why so many people have decided to start a new life in Dubai is the low taxes. While most countries require investors to pay large amounts of money, Dubai does not. Since Dubai is almost tax-free, investors can earn additional revenue. Money that would otherwise go to taxes can be used for production costs, instead.

4.2 Easy set-up

Getting a Trade License Dubai is much faster than any other procedure. As long as you have the corresponding documentation, you should receive your trade license without any problem, in a few weeks.

4.3 Fewer trade restrictions

Dubai has very few restrictions when doing business, which makes it easy to trade from one place to another. For this reason, as long as you register your products under the appropriate license, you will not have to worry about restrictions.

4.4. Sponsor opportunities

An important point of obtaining a Trade License Dubai is that you can sponsor dependents. This makes it easy to bring family members or employees over to Dubai.

4.5 Boost international and local trade

With a general trading license, you have the opportunity to produce or import products, either to the local Dubai market or abroad, and receive profits from other countries.

Also, this type of license gives you the opportunity to re-export your products, this can help you improve your ability to trade goods and services around the world.

5. How to get a Business License Dubai without a physical office?

The Department of Economic Development and the Free Zones in the UAE have enabled license packages for virtual companies. In other words, small entrepreneurs can start working without having a physical office.

Also, as an initiative of the government of the United Arab Emirates to boost economic growth, they have introduced the “Instant Trade License”. This is a variation of the normal Trade License that you can have in just five minutes and brings with it unique benefits.

     5.1 Benefits of the Instant Trade License:

  • It is not necessary to carry out the Memorandum of association
  • Does not require trade name registration for the first year
  • Can be ready in five minutes
  • It is not necessary to have a physical office

5.2 Documents required to acquire an Instant Trade License

  • Passport copy for all licenses (Partners and managers)
  • A copy of your Visa (If applicable)
  • A copy of your residence Visa and a No Objection Certificate (If applicable)

Also, note that Instant Trade Licenses can only be applied to those businesses engaged in activities that do not require external approvals.

6. What you should know about getting a Trade License Dubai without a physical office?

By not having the concern of a physical office, there is a lot of flexibility when working, however, you should take the following aspects into account:

6.1 Create your business plan

The employer must create a business plan to accommodate the flexibility of working hours and the availability of their workers to meet business requirements. You should also be knowledgeable about current market conditions. That is to say, having a business plan will ensure an organized and stable future for your company.

6.2 Alternative workplace

Firstly, without a physical office, the entrepreneur must find an alternative to his workplace. Secondly, it must be a quiet place where the investor can concentrate and offer quality work.

Some jobs can be done remotely and efficiently. For example, software programming, IT, project management, services engineering, consultancies, etc. Also, most interactions are virtual, making the need for a physical office obsolete.

6.3 Use of the right technology

Investing in technology is essential for maintaining a virtual company, to keep your employees and clients active. In addition to this, the latest technological advances have achieved efficient work and communication from many parts of the world.

6.4 Allocate flexible working hours

One of the most important advantages of the no-office package is the ability to work at any time and from anywhere. Also, they can organize meetings with clients from different parts of the world.

6.5 Virtual meetings and teams

Learning to work through the tools that technology offers us is of the utmost importance. Besides, conducting virtual meetings, hiring remote staff and online teams is the right way to go if you want to succeed by having a company without a physical office.

7. How can we assist you through the process of obtaining a Trade License Dubai?

Carrying out the different legal processes to live and work in the United Arab Emirates can be long and difficult if you are a new entrepreneur. For this reason, we want to provide you with support and guidance so that you can carry out all your processes quickly and efficiently.

Our experts have the training to carry out the entire process of applying for a trade license, also, Connect Zone is the perfect agency to start/renew your visa and act as your local agent.

Do you want to discover more about the Trade License Dubai? You can contact us at the following email address: info@connectzone.ae. Here, you can communicate with one of our representatives, who will answer all your questions.

Also, if you are interested in knowing more about us, visit thetalentpoint.com or send your CV to contact@thetalentpoint.com, no need to worry, your information will be safe with us, we will not share it or store it in our database.

FAQs

What is a flexi desk or virtual workplace for business licenses in Dubai?

A flexi-desk is a shared work area in a business center that serves as your official business location for licensing. A virtual office gives you an authorized address and mailing services without renting a physical workplace.

Is it possible to receive a trade license in the Emirates without having a physical location?

Yes, numerous Free Zones include flexi-desk or virtual office solutions to satisfy the need for an official business location without renting a physical workspace.

Which Free Zones provide commercial licenses without leasing a workplace?

Many Free Zones, such as Meydan, RAKEZ, and Shams, offer adjustable entry-level options, including Flexi-desk and virtual offices for enterprises that work from home.

What papers do you need to get a trading license in Dubai without a physical office?

Most of the time, the documents you need are a filled-out application form, copies of the managers’ passports, the NOC if you work for the company, and an executed Flexi-desk / Virtual Office rental agreement.

How much does it cost to receive a trade license in Dubai if you don’t have a physical office?

The cost is usually lower than in standard setups, based on the Free Zone, the business activity types, and the visa quotas.

The United Arab Emirates has definitely become the must-watch region when it comes to investing, its multiple free trade policies, low taxes, and its geographical location (which allows trade by air, land, and water) have drawn the attention of more than one entrepreneur.

In this article, you will learn the importance of getting a bank account for entrepreneurs, the basic steps to get an account in a UAE bank, and how you can be chosen to get an account in the United Arab Emirates for your startup.

  1. How to open a bank account for entrepreneurs?
  2. What are the types of bank accounts for an entrepreneur in the UAE?
  3. What are the requirements to open a bank account for your entrepreneurship?
  4. Who is eligible to open a bank account for entrepreneurs in the UAE?
  5. Which benefits can you get from opening a bank account for your entrepreneurship?
  6. Why do you need to open a bank account, as an entrepreneur?
  7. How to open a bank account for entrepreneurs if you are a foreigner?
  8. In which way can we help you get to know more about opening a bank account for an entrepreneur?

1. How to open a bank account for entrepreneurs?

 

If you are an entrepreneur looking to start a new path by investing in the United Arab Emirates or with the formation of a new company, you will need a business account from a bank in the UAE to carry out all the transactions related to your company.

You can open a business bank account in the following way:

1.1 Opening a bank account online in the Arab Emirates

The process to open a business account online is quite easy, just go to the website of the chosen bank, fill out the application form, and submit all the required documents.

1.2 Opening a business account offline in the Arab Emirates

For successful entrepreneurs residing in the UAE, it may be more convenient to go directly to the branch of the selected bank.

To deliver the corresponding documents and receive personalized attention.

1.3 Opening a business account via phone call in the Arab Emirates

Another alternative for new entrepreneurs is to make a call with the contact number of the chosen bank. The bank representative will guide you through all the steps to open your account and answer all your questions.

2. What are the types of bank accounts for an entrepreneur in the UAE?

As in the rest of the world, you can open a personal account at the bank and use it for your personal transactions. However, you should know that in the UAE it is not allowed to conduct business through your personal account.

For this reason, successful entrepreneurs open bank accounts intended solely for the use of their companies.

When you open an account at a bank in the UEA, you can choose between a saving, current, and investment account.

2.1 Current Account

Firstly, the current accounts can be used every day, by choosing this type of account you will be able to make money transfers or financial transactions and you will be able to receive a debit card, a checkbook, and a credit card (if you reside in the UAE)

Secondly, these accounts can be held in the currencies of your choice (AED, USD, Euro, etc.)

Also, if you are opening a current account for your business, you must regularly maintain a specific minimum balance, but, at the same time, you will be given the freedom to transfer funds whenever you need.

2.2 Saving Account

These types of accounts usually offer higher interest rates than current accounts, but there is a certain limitation to access the funds.

Also, these types of accounts can be saved in the currencies of your choice and you can transfer wages to them.

2.3 Investment accounts

This type of account offers a higher interest rate than the accounts shown above. However, access to funds may be limited or unavailable.

When you open this account with an amount of money, the bank manages your portfolio and invests in certain financial instruments, which allow you to earn between 3-7% per year.

Must be remembered: This is an intrabank account, so it will not appear in the information displayed in your current or saving accounts. On a quarterly basis, the bank will send extracts of the account for your review.

Most successful entrepreneurs choose a current account, as it allows them to make transactions every day without funds limitation.

3. What are the requirements to open a bank account for your entrepreneurship?

In order to open a business account, the banks of the United Arab Emirates will require certain documentation. For example, Identity, documents related to business, the address proof, etc.

Following, you will see all the required documents:

3.1 Residence and identity proof:

  • Arab Emirates ID of shareholder representative (Original and Copy)
  • Shareholder representative’s Residence Visa
  • Valid passport of shareholder representative and company director (Original and Copy).

3.2 Business Related Documentation

  • Business plan or blueprint
  • Memorandum and articles of association
  • Sources of fund disclosure
  • Company extract (through the official registry of the company)
  • Existing contracts
  • Certificate of Incorporation
  • Registry of shareholders
  • Good standing certificate

3.3 Other Required Documents

  • Information related to the kind of activities to be performed on the account
  • Letter of reference through the business partners

4. Who is eligible to open a bank account for entrepreneurs in the UAE?

 

To open a business account and join the club of successful entrepreneurs who have invested in the United Arab Emirates, it is necessary to meet certain specifications of the bank of your choice.

Must be remembered: Each bank has its procedures and specifications, and the bank will notify you of each of them.

Here are some general specifications:

4.1 Minimum Initial Deposit

Each entrepreneur must deposit a specific amount of money before opening the account. Each bank has a different minimum fee and must be reviewed before starting the process.

4.2 Minimum Average Balance

In order to open and maintain a business account in the UAE, you must maintain a minimum amount of money in it.

This minimum amount, again, will depend on the bank.

4.3 Savings or current account

Some banks may require the investor to have a savings or current account in order to be eligible to open a business account.

4.4 Know your customer (KYC)

All successful entrepreneurs must fill out the Know Your Customer form to facilitate the account opening process.

5. Which benefits can you get from opening a bank account for your entrepreneurship?

Opening and maintaining a business account is extremely important for new investors since it facilitates the different operations related to their companies.

Next, you will know some benefits of opening a business account in the UAE:

5.1 Purchasing Power:

The business accounts have credit services that facilitate obtaining loans, creating a positive business credit that allows larger initial purchases.

5.2 Security and protection:

By keeping personal funds and business funds separate, this bank account offers absolute security. In this way, the account holders’ data remains secure.

 

5.3 Attractive Interest Rates:

Due to the number of investors who have decided to start their business in the UAE, banks offer good interest rates for new investors, thus creating a favorable situation for both parties.

5.4 Minimum Account Balance

Most banks offer a fairly low minimum amount to open a business account. In fact, some offer zero balance, which makes it easier for an entrepreneur to start a business.

5.5 Checkbook Facility

All banking entities in the UAE offer checkbooks in the name of the company, which allows variety in payment methods.

5.6 Online Access to the Funds

The entrepreneur who is in charge of the business account has the facility of being able to see their funds through the online portal of the bank. The entrepreneur can review his funds any day, at any time.

5.7 Multiple Currencies Accepted

As shown above, the business accounts accept different currencies, it is up to the entrepreneur to choose the currency of their preference. This can be, for example, AED, USD, Euros, etc.

6. Why do you need to open a bank account, as an entrepreneur?

Once the formation of the company is completed, the need for a bank account becomes imminent.

You will require a business account to receive and send money, make financial payments, and manage business transactions.

An entrepreneur must have a bank account for the following reasons:

6.1 To make investments

From time to time, an entrepreneur will find himself in the situation of making investments, a business account facilitates this process using reminders and standing instructions.

6.2 Banking services

Banks offer various services that facilitate the maintenance and survival of the funds that enter and leave that account.

6.3 Accuracy in Maintaining Records

Business accounts are able to handle almost all types of financial transactions, thus managing to maintain a large set of records. In this way, the payment of taxes, salaries, etc., on time is facilitated.

6.4 Managing Expenses

Having a business account is very helpful when managing expenses and planning strategies for future investments, taking into account the present time of the company.

Is important to realize that, every enterprise needs a very strong foundation to use as a support to overcome any situation that may present to the entrepreneur.

Without the support of a sustainable banking system, flourishing in the Arab Emirate economy can be a rough path.

7. How to open a bank account for entrepreneurs if you are a foreigner?

There are different ways to open a bank account in the UAE if you are a foreigner, but they are all conditioned by one thing: Your residence status.

To open a bank account as a foreigner, you must present your passport (along with copies of your passport photo) and a No-Objection Certificate (NOC) from your employer or the person sponsoring your Visa.

This last requirement indicates that you need a residence in the UAE to open an international or an offshore bank account.

In addition to your passport and NOC, banks will require other types of documentation, for example, Visa, Emirates ID Card (or the copy of your application, if you are waiting for the arrival). Secondly, you will need a document that states your employer or sponsor and your salary.

Finally, you will need proof of your address. For this, you will have to share your rental agreement and a recommendation letter from another bank.

8. In which way can we help you get to know more about opening a bank account for an entrepreneur?

Connect Zone is the agency qualified to accompany you in each step of the process of opening your bank account. In this way, you can invest safely and efficiently.

Our specialists will be in charge of carrying out all the legal and financial documentation, we work with several UAE banks to guarantee the best assistance and performance.

Also, if you are a foreigner, we have the best training to carry out the process of your resident VISA, so that you can work and open your bank account in the UAE.

If you want to know more about us, Connect Zone, and get more insights on how to open a bank account for entrepreneurs, you can call us at the following number +97143316688. Also, you can send us an email to info@connectzone.ae where one of our representatives will contact you and answer all your questions.

Lastly, if you are looking for employment and want to become a part of our team, you can send your CV to thetalentpoint.com. No need to worry, your information will be safe with us, we will not share it or store it in our database.

FAQs

Can foreigners open a business bank account in UAE?

Yes. Foreigners can open a business bank account if they have a valid UAE company setup. Non-residents may face stricter checks, and some banks require at least one UAE-resident signatory.

What documents are required to open a business bank account?

You need your trade license, certificate of incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, passports of shareholders and signatories, proof of business address, and sometimes a business plan. Non-residents may also need certified documents from their home country.

How long does it take to open a UAE business bank account?

It usually takes 5–10 business days for standard applications. Complex structures or non-resident accounts may take 2–4 weeks.

Which banks are best for entrepreneurs in UAE?

Popular choices include Emirates NBD, Mashreq (NeoBiz), ADCB, RAKBANK, and digital-friendly banks like Wio that cater to startups and SMEs.

Is a company license mandatory to open a bank account?

Yes. A valid UAE company license or certificate of incorporation is required to open a business bank account.

Can startups open a bank account in UAE easily?

Yes. Startups can open accounts, especially with SME-friendly or digital banks, but all documents and compliance checks must be complete. A strong business plan and proper license speed up approval.

title: Do you know how to set up an Industrial Company in Dubai?
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle

    • How much capital is needed for an industrial business in Dubai?
    • Which authority approves industrial licenses in Dubai?
    • Can expats own an industrial company in Dubai?
    • How long does industrial company registration take?

An Industrial Company or manufacturing company is the company in charge of extracting the raw material and transforming it into products or goods to be marketed to the final consumer.

In recent years, there has been a boom in the creation of this type of company in Dubai, due to the various opportunities for economic growth that have been created in the Arab Emirate.

In this article, you will learn how to start an Industrial Company in Dubai, the various benefits that this kind of company brings, and also the cost of forming such companies.

1. How to set up an Industrial Company in Dubai?

2. Which activities fall under the Industrial License?

3. What is the cost of the Industrial License?

4. What is the cost of forming an Industrial Company in Dubai?

5. Benefits of forming an Industrial Company in Dubai

6. Why is Dubai the perfect place for your Industrial Company?

7. How to set up an Industrial Company in Dubai Industrial City?

8. In which way we can help you with the setup of your Industrial Company in Dubai?

1. How to set up an Industrial company in Dubai?

1.1 Choose an activity corresponding to the manufacturing sector

The first step for the creation of an Industrial Company is to choose the good or product you want to manufacture, in this way the legal form and the corresponding license (commercial, industrial or professional) are determined. Also, you could open a Textile Company, a printing or publishing company, a parts factory, etc.

Keep in mind that a company in Dubai can be engaged in more than one activity at a time and that the United Arab Emirates offers more than 2,000 productive activities to choose from.

1.2 Select a local partner

To carry out the process of forming an Industrial Company in Dubai, you need the support of a local agent, a national representative who will accompany you throughout the process and who will take care of all the paperwork.

1.3 Select the legal form

The legal form will depend directly on the product or the good that you are going to make and is the basis for applying the laws and regulations of your company. The investor can choose between the following legal forms:

  • Limited liability company (LLC)
  • Public joint-stock company (PJSC)
  • Private joint-stock company (PrJSC)
  • Civil company
  • Local company branch
  • General partnership
  • Limited partnership
  • Foreign company branch
  • Free zone company branch
  • Sole establishment
  • Holding companies.

Important to realize: The legal form must coincide with the chosen productive activity

1.4 Choose a name for your Industrial Company

Firstly, every Industrial Company in Dubai must have a trade name that distinguishes your business from another, and in turn, must reflect its essence. This must be directly related to the chosen activity, cannot allude to any religion or political ideology, cannot be previously registered, and must respect the moral values ​​and laws of the United Arab Emirates.

Throughout the trade name selection process, you will be given a payment voucher or transaction number that you will need as a reference when paying.

Must be remembered: Trade names certificates are renewable and are registered by the department of economic development. While the trademark is registered by the Ministry of Economy.

1.5 Send the corresponding documents

After choosing your trade name, the legal form, and having chosen a local agent, you must register your company with the DED (Department of economic development) to obtain initial approval and other types of approvals.

1.6 Initial Approval

Afterward, your documents have been reviewed and processed, the UAE government will notify you if your application has been approved.

Receiving this approval means that the government of the United Arab Emirates accepts the creation of your Industrial Company and you can continue with the next steps of the formation process, however, it does not (yet) grant you the authority to start working.

Also, foreign investors who decide to set up an Industrial Company in Dubai must first obtain approval from the General Directorate of Residency and Foreign Affairs.

1.7 Memorandum of association

Once the first part of the formation process of an Industrial Company is completed, you must file a Memorandum of Association (MOA) signed by all the shareholders.

1.8 Submit to the Ministry of Economy

Once the Memorandum of Association has been signed, you must submit the corresponding documents to the Ministry of Economy, where you will receive authorization to continue with the formation of your manufacturing company.

1.9 Find a location

According to the laws of the United Arab Emirates, every company must have an infrastructure, a physical address where the company is located. For this reason, you should rent an office or Business Center in a beneficial location for your necessities.

Additionally, as a requirement, you must provide the official rental agreement and in Dubai, this agreement must be registered by Ejari.

1.10 Dubai Municipality

Afterward, to continue the process of forming an Industrial Company you must obtain the approval and permission of the Dubai Municipality’s planning department to obtain the Industrial license. Once the approval is received, you must complete the documentation and submit it to the environment department to obtain authorization to continue the process.

1.11 Civil defense

After obtaining permission from the Dubai Municipality, you must apply for a NOC (No Objection Certificate) from the Civil Defense, to continue with the process of forming your manufacturing company.

1.12 External Approval

In addition to the approvals shown above, some manufacturing industries in the United Arab Emirates need approval from other government departments. It is important to note that this will depend on the objects or goods that your company produces. For example: If you produce food, you need a food control permit. In the same fashion, if you decide to produce any chemical material, you need permission from the Narcotics Department.

1.13 Trade License

After receiving all the relevant approvals and necessary permits, you can submit the final documents to the Department of economic development to receive your industrial trade license. At last, make the payments of the corresponding fees and your trade industrial license will be delivered to you.

2. Which activities fall under the Industrial License?

Industrial licenses work for a large number of activities and many of them are directly related to manufacturing. For example:

  • Food & beverage manufacturing
  • Helicopter repair & maintenance
  • Metal products coating
  • Multi-dimensional images
  • Sculptors
  • Textile manufacturing
  • Adhesive & paper slitting
  • Bookbinding
  • Saddle & animal, bird training requirements making
  • Safety harness manufacturing
  • Casting of metals
  • Cards & envelopes printing
  • Lathe workshop
  • Magnetic technology equipment trading

To clarify, this is a general list of some activities that need the Industrial license.

Note that if your company does production, fabrication, preparation, or manufacturing of products, then you will need an industrial license as well.

3. What is the cost of the Industrial License?

Firstly, the cost of the application for an Industrial license will depend directly on the area in which you want to establish your company.

As shown above, to apply for a license, you need to comply with certain documents, obtain certain approvals from government entities and pay the corresponding fees.

In general, an Industrial License can cost between 10,000 – 25,000 AED, these prices may be different if you decide to set up your Industrial Company in a Free Zone.

4. What is the cost of an Industrial Company Formation?

Due to the growing popularity of the financial benefits that can come from investing in the United Arab Emirates, the costs to set up a manufacturing company are relatively low. As following:

  • Initial Approval: AED220
  • Trade name approval: 720 AED
  • MOA preparation: 600 AED
  • Notarization of MOA: 1800 AED
  • Sponsorship Fee: AED10,000
  • License: 10,000 – 25,000
  • Market fee: 5% of the rent
  • Environment Impact Assessment Report: 10,000

5. Benefits of forming an Industrial Company in Dubai

The exponential growth that has occurred in the United Arab Emirates in recent years has brought multiple benefits to new investors, encouraging the creation of new companies every day.

The government of the United Arab Emirates, over the years, has tried to diversify its investments to attract new entrepreneurs and position itself as the leading region when it comes to economic growth.

Due to the new regulations, investors have 100% ownership of their companies and can trade without any restrictions.

Among the benefits of an Industrial Company Formation in Dubai, we find the following:

  • Business supportive regime
  • Optimal chances for business growth
  • Maintaining business privacy
  • World-class infrastructure
  • Exemplary standard of living
  • Strategic location
  • Excellent connectivity

6. Why is Dubai the perfect place for your new Industrial Company?

In essence, Dubai is one of the most economically attractive areas for old and new investors. It has an open environment and full support for small, medium, and large companies that allow the growth of the region’s economy.

Free-market policy, fair competition, and low taxes have been another key point to receiving multiple foreign investments each year.

Dubai is the perfect place to invest for the following reasons:

  • It has a strategic geographical location, it is located in the heart of MENASA (Middle East, North Africa, and South Africa). Also, it allows trade with these regions of the world.
  • It has a very stable financial and banking system
  • The taxes in this region are the lowest in the world
  • The economy is proactive and constantly evolving
  • As an incentive for new investments, they have an entire support system to facilitate the formation of an Industrial Company.

7. How to set up an Industrial Company in Dubai Industrial City?

 

The Industrial Company Formation process in Dubai Industrial Park is very similar to the process of setting up an onshore company in Dubai.

Firstly, you must choose the productive activity of your company, select the trade name (which must be related to the productive area), prepare the memorandum of association, and take the corresponding documents to the relevant government authorities.

Then, once the documents are ready, you will be given a registration certificate and business license.

Dubai Industrial Park has, at the present time, six areas in which companies can work. Each area is dedicated to a specific productive activity, like the following:

  • The transport area
  • The machinery area
  • The food and beverages area
  • The mineral production area
  • The base metal area
  • The chemicals area

 7.1 What is Dubai Industrial City?

Dubai Industrial City is the free zone in Dubai that focuses on manufacturing industries. It opened in 2004 and recently its name changed to Dubai Industrial Park.

7.2 What type of Industrial Company can settle in Dubai Industrial City?

At this point, Individuals or legal entities can establish limited liability relationships in Dubai Industrial City. Subsequently, foreign companies can open extensions of their offices or enter into joint ventures with other companies in Dubai.

The industries allowed to settle in Dubai Central Park (in addition to manufacturing) are:

  • Machinery
  • Transportation
  • Logistics
  • Food and beverages

Also, Manufacturing Companies in Dubai Central Park can process metals, minerals, and even chemical materials.

8. In which way can we help you with the setup of your Industrial Company in Dubai?

When it comes to Industrial Company Formation in Dubai, Connect Zone is the perfect partner to carry out this process. We are your trusted agency that will take care of all the paperwork, legal and administrative aspects so that your only concern is to focus on the formation of your new business. Also, we will provide you with the best places to locate the headquarters of your company.

Here at Connect Zone, we care about your safety and the security of your investment, which is why we assume the role of your local agent, to guarantee a safe process.

Would you like to connect with us?  If you want to learn more about Connect Zone and how to set up an Industrial Company in Dubai, you can call us at +97143316688. Also, you can contact us via email at info@connectzone.ae, where you will speak with one of our advisors who will answer all your questions.

Besides, if you are looking for a job in the UAE and other regions, feel free to visit thetalentpoint.com. Do not worry, your information will not be shared or stored in any database.

FAQs

What is an industrial license in Dubai?

Dubai’s industrial license permits manufacturing, processing, or industrial production activities.

What are the requirements to set up an industrial company?

Setting up an industrial company requires approvals, facility plans, environmental clearance, and capital commitment.

How much capital is needed for an industrial business in Dubai?

Capital requirements depend on the activity type, machinery, and facility needs.

Which authority approves industrial licenses in Dubai?

The Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism and the relevant free zones approve licenses in Dubai.

Can expats own an industrial company in Dubai?

Expatriates can fully own industrial businesses in Dubai.

How long does industrial company registration take?

The industrial company registration usually takes one to three months.
