Over the last few years, Dubai became home to more than 200 different nationalities. Likewise, thousands of tourists choose the Golden City as their vacation getaway every year. Therefore, opening a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone is the latest trend every chef and food lover entrepreneur should follow to thrive in the UAE.

In this article, you will discover why opening a restaurant in free zone inthe UAE is a great investment idea for master chefs, entrepreneurs, and food franchises along with the different factors to consider before opening a food establishment in the UAE. You will also learn:

  1. Why should you open a restaurant in Dubai?
  2. Can you open a restaurant in any Dubai jurisdiction?
  3. Requirements for opening a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone
  4. Process for opening a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone
  5. What documents will you need for opening a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone?
  6. Extra requirements to consider
  7. How much will it cost to open a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone?
  8. How can we help you open a restaurant in Dubai and across the UAE?

1. Why should you open a restaurant in Dubai?

Dubai is a touristic and investment hub. It is a place filled with culture, leisure, and entertainment.

All around Dubai and across the UAE, top executives, entrepreneurs, and tourists (local and foreign) seek places to have meetings, share with their families, or try foods from local and foreign cultures. Therefore, master chefs and young cooking talents have the possibility to establish a successful business within any area of cuisine.

On the other hand, Dubai has emerged as a cradle for culinary experimentation. To clarify, there is a great diversity of flavors and culinary traditions from newcomers who settle in Dubai.  That is why opening a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone is among the top 10 business ideas to start a business in Dubai UAE.

It is an opportunity for increasing your profits and making a name for yourself in the gastronomic Emirati world. That is to say, the chances of failure are minimal. A large number of foreign residents and visitors opens the door to culinary creativity and investment which helps both small and large food establishments safely succeed in the UAE.

2. Can you open a restaurant in any Dubai jurisdiction?

Even though opening a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone has multiple benefits, establishing a restaurant in Dubai has its own rules and restrictions, starting with location. To sum up, there are two possible options for opening a restaurant in Dubai: Dubai Mainland and Dubai Free Zone.

Contrary to popular belief, it is not possible to open a restaurant in any place in Dubai. Firstly, it is not allowed in the industrial Free Zones of Dubai. However, it is permitted to open a restaurant in a Dubai Free zone that serves as a residential unit.

Therefore, among the jurisdictions that grant a restaurant license are:

  • Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO)
  • DAFZA or Dubai Airport Free Zone
  • DMCC or Dubai Multi Commodities Centre

On the other hand, Dubai Mainland has its own rules for restaurant setup however it can be an easier option. Since Dubai Mainland holds more independence and flexibility, it is the investment and financial center chosen by many looking-forward entrepreneurs to establish their food businesses.

2.1 Mainland vs. Free Zone

However, there is a major difference between opening a restaurant in Dubai mainland and a free zone. In the case of the mainland, it is essential to obtain a permit from the Department of Economic Development (DED) in order to work in any Dubai territory. That is to say, the restaurant can open anywhere on the mainland. This includes branches and franchises.

Click here to learn how to get an e-trader license in Dubai Mainland in a short time.

Nevertheless, in Dubai, Free Zones restaurant owners are only allowed to work under the perimeters of the Free Zone. To clarify, food establishments cannot operate out of the jurisdiction’s borders where they have decided to set up initially.

3. Requirements for opening a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone

Opening a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone is a quick, cost-effective process. The list of requirements is not long and the papers needed are few. However, costs and required documents may vary according to the jurisdiction where you choose to open your business

In general terms, the main steps you should follow are:

  • Choosing an available Trade Name
  • Get a local sponsor
  • Obtaining a Tenancy Contract
  • Having an Ejari (rented spaces)
  • Designing the interior of the restaurant according to the Food and Safety Department standards
  • Submitting required papers to the Department of Economic Development (DED)
  • Get a valid NOC from the Food Safety Department
  • Obtaining Dubai Municipality approval

4. Process for opening a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone

For opening a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone successfully and smoothly, the steps you must follow are:

Step 1: Choosing a jurisdiction suitable to your needs

Firstly, you should spend a little time researching each available Free Zone’s different benefits for setting up a restaurant. Dubai Silicon Oasis, the Dubai Airport Free Zone (DAFZA), and Dubai Multi Commodity Center (DMCC) provide restaurant owners with slightly different benefits, activities and requirements. Secondly, you just have to find the right one for your business plan.

Step 2: trade license

To operate freely, it is essential that restaurant owners obtain a trade license from the Dubai Economic Development (DED) or apply for one in one of the free zones. The license allows a foreigner to have 100% business ownership.

This license can be new or renewed.

Step 3: food and other permits

In this next step, restaurant owners must obtain a food license from the Food Safety Department to ensure that the facility meets all Food Code standards and abides by the department’s rules above all.

Discover everything you need to know about Dubai’s offshore companies

In addition to the Food License, the restaurant will need other special permits such as food transportation, food truck operation, and a special permit to handle and serve pork on the premises.

Step 4: submission of layout/ blueprint

Another important step in opening a restaurant in the Dubai Free Zone is to submit a sketch or floor plan of the premises so that the Food Control Department can review it and give its approval in case reconstruction, renovation, or construction is required.

The plan must contain details of the layout and spaces for cooking, cleaning, food storage, and seating. Another requirement is:

  • Areas intended for bathing and sanitary facilities.
  • The layout of open spaces
  • Location of windows, doors, and ventilation systems
  • Equipment layout
  • Details of inlets and outlets
  • Sink and dishwasher distribution

Step 5: asking for a site/ location

This requirement is to preserve the safety of food, staff, and clientele. That is to say, the restaurant must have a minimum distance of 30 meters from any source of contamination, dumpsters, or incompatible processing facilities.

Step 6: submit application forms and required documents

Finally, you must submit your fully formed application. In addition, provide a copy of:

  • Business license
  • Floor plans of the restaurant
  • Units and storage areas

Step 7: open a bank account

To open a restaurant in the Dubai Free Zone, it is essential to have a domestic bank account. This way you will be able to regulate the cash flow and keep track of the restaurant’s assets, acquisitions, and expenses.

5. What documents will you need for opening a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone?

If you are opening a restaurant in Dubai Free zone, the papers needed to obtain the necessary licenses and permits are few. However, required documents may vary according to the Free Zone. Consequently, the general documents are:

  • Restaurant layout/blueprint (if needed)
  • Trade license copy
  • Investor’s passport copy
  • Investor’s visa copy
  • Color passport-sized photo
  • Detailed business plan
  • Additional permits like liquor, pork manipulation
  • Non Objection Certificate (NOC)
  • Tenancy agreement form
  • Proof of payment

6. Extra requirements to consider

There are some extra requirements you should consider when opening a restaurant. Including location, space distribution, and opting for a residential visa to be able to supervise your restaurant personally.

In the case of location and space distribution, you must take into account:

  • The kitchen area should be 300 ft.
  • Washing instruments must have hot and cold water
  • The kitchen tandoor should be at least 380 ft.
  • The chimney should be at least two meters highest than the closet building
  • There must be different facilities for dry, chilled, and frozen food
  • Drainage pipe must be at least two inches away from the walls

On the other hand, if you are interested in opening the restaurant and running it personally, the steps you should follow are:

  • Opting for a residential visa to fully supervise your restaurant
  • Getting your Emirates ID

6.1 Following the Food Code

If you are thinking about opening a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone, it is essential you follow the Food Code. It is the general law regarding the handling, hygiene, and preparation of food. Therefore, if a restaurant wishes to be successful in Dubai Free Zone and across the UAE.

It is vital that restaurants adhere to these guidelines in order to properly distribute ventilation, clean rooms, and ensure that everything is in order so as not to have problems with the local authorities.

7. How much will it cost to open a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone?

Opening a restaurant in Dubai free zone is a cost-effective process. You must create a budget that fits the needs of planning, development, and corresponding fees. You should also take into consideration all the licenses and permits you require. However, restaurant business setup costs around AED 15,000.

Click here to know more about the Dubai professional license and its uses

Remember that the price will depend on the Free Zone where you decide to establish your restaurant. In general terms, the costs to consider are:

  • Full-Service restaurant: This will depend on the space distribution. That is to say, the amount of space to be used for dining, kitchen, and storage. It may vary from AED 300,00 to AED 500,000
  • Delivery: If you want to open a delivery restaurant, it can be more cost-effective. You will only need the cooking area and the necessary utensils. It will be between AED 100,00 to AED 160,000.

8. How can we help you open a restaurant in Dubai and across the UAE?

In conclusion, opening a restaurant in Dubai Free Zone is a great investment option to introduce you to the thriving food, tourism, and venture market. Now you know better the complete process and requirements, at Connect Zone we are ready to help you establish your restaurant in Dubai Free Zone and across the UAE.

In Connect Zone we count on an expert team to help achieve all your professional goals in the UAE. To clarify, our staff is prepared to assist you during restaurant set up in a quick, safe, effective way at the best price. From providing local partners service to Pro services,

We ensure 24/7 support during business setup. Moreover, we offer a full document clearing service so your restaurant has all its papers and are legally ordered before and after submit in them.

Would you like to contact Connect Zone to help you open Dubai free zone and across the UAE? In case you have any questions, contact us on +971 43 316 688. Moreover, you can email us at contact@connectzone.ae, and you will talk to one of our representatives who will answer your questions.

To receive more information, submit your CV or resume to thetalentpoint.com. Your personal information won’t be stored or shared.

You can open your restaurant in Dubai by getting your trade license, relevant food-related approvals, and location clearance.

How to get a restaurant license in Dubai?

You should apply through DED or via your free zone authority to get your restaurant license.

How to get food safety approvals in Dubai?

For getting food safety approvals in Dubai, you should register with the Dubai Municipality Food Safety Department.

How to choose a location for a restaurant in Dubai?

You should consider foot traffic, competition, and your target audience when choosing the location for a restaurant in Dubai.

The startup cost to open your restaurant in Dubai depends on the size, location, and concept of your restaurant and its operations.

title: How to get an event management license in Dubai?
content:
Table of Contents

Toggle

    • Step 3: Choosing the right business set up area

  • 6. How can we help you get an event management license in Dubai?

    • Can foreigners start an event management company in Dubai?
    • How much does an event management license cost in Dubai?
    • Which authority issues an event management license in Dubai?

    • How long does it take to get an event management license?

The Dubai event management market is booming. In most parts of the Gold City, you can find great amounts of people attending huge tech showcases, luxurious weddings, or investment conventions. As a result, many event planning professionals come to the UAE and get an event management license in Dubai to set up their own businesses.

In this article, you will learn everything about how to get an event management license to work in Dubai Mainland or any of the Free Zones. Likewise, the different documents and requirements you might need. You will also discover more about:

  1. What does an event manager do?
  2. Why invest in Dubai’s event management market?
  3. Why do you need an event management license to work in Dubai?
  4. Step by step process for event management license application
  5. Use of event management license to apply for visas
  6. How can we help you get an event management license in Dubai?

1. What does an event manager do?

Behind every successful event in the UAE, there is a mastermind who backs it up with a good action plan. That is to say, event managers. They are professionals who focus on organizing, planning, supervising, and evaluating social, promotional, or corporate events according to their client’s requirements and expectations.

The event manager’s main role is to ensure everything runs smoothly and on schedule. Regardless of the event type, event managers seek to efficiently draw in the target audience and make sure their experience is memorable and enjoyable.

Click here to learn everything about how to set up offshore companies in Dubai

Moreover, among other activities individual event managers or event management companies take care of are:

  • Creating a detailed action plan that meets the client’s demands, needs, and goals for the event.
  • Assigning and supervising staff activities
  • Monitoring that the event’s schedule is followed to the letter.
  • Submitting a format with the post-evaluation of the event to the client. Event managers also conduct this assessment.
  • Contact special guests, speakers, lecturers, and any other type of host or entertainment figures.
  • Meeting constantly with clients to learn exact specifications for the event.
  • Preparing several itemized proposals that include timelines, possible locations, legal constraints, staffing, and budget
  • Arranging facilities such as parking, traffic control, security, transportation, first aid, entertainment, and media.
  • Supervising the equipment dismantling and removal. Also, clearing the venue efficiently
  • Constantly seeking new customers and opportunities
  • Providing hotel reservations for attendees, special guests, speakers, or hosts.
  • Promoting the event in social media, press, and other means.
  • Ensuring the sale of tickets or receipt of invitations.

1.1 What kind of projects can an event manager in Dubai do?

There is a wide range of activities that an event Business management company can carry out in Dubai. Consequently, thanks to the wide variety of renowned organizations, start-ups, tourism destinations, and VIP options, event managers can organize:

  • Conferences
  • Seminars
  • Showcases
  • Concerts
  • Fashion shows
  • Theatre performances
  • Product launches
  • Corporate events, such as parties, trips
  • Trade fairs
  • Weddings
  • Award ceremonies
  • Gala dinners/parties
  • Conventions

2. Why invest in Dubai’s Event Management Market?

Dubai is a city full of life, tourism, and investment opportunities. Throughout the year, more and more companies, organizations, entrepreneurs, and regular people hold high-style promotional, business, or social events across its Mainland and Free zones.

Therefore, establishing yourself as an event manager in Dubai can be a great opportunity. By doing so, you will get access to a market full of local and foreign shareholders who need to promote, organize and optimize their workshops, trips, conferences, seminars, and other events.

Here you can discover how to get an e-trader license in Dubai mainland in a short time

Furthermore, setting up an event management business in Gold City is a cost-effective option to increase your corporation’s potential and reach new heights. Thanks to the different license packages the UAE offers to entrepreneurs, event management business setup cost remains low.

Lastly, by obtaining an event management license in Dubai, you have the possibility to apply for a long-term residency visa for you, your employees, and your beloved ones easily and in a short time.

 3. Why do you need an event management license to work in Dubai

One of the reasons event managements business owners require an event management license in Dubai is to provide a clear, legal, fair service to their local and foreign clients. In this sense, the event management license grants major credibility to event planning companies in the different UAE jurisdictions, allowing them to work seamlessly and hassle-free.

Discover a top 10 business ideas to set up a company in Dubai 

Similarly, after gaining this license you will have access to the rest of the services found in the license packages such as Flexi-desks, warehousing facilities, residential visas, and an extensive list of national and foreign potential customers.

4. Step by step process for event management license application

Before formally applying for an event management license in Dubai, there are some steps you must follow to make the whole process go smoothly. For example, collecting some documents, establishing your business plan, choosing an available name for your company, and paying the corresponding fees.

Another key point is picking in which of the Dubai jurisdictions you would like to set up your event management business. Remember to choose a location that matches your organization’s mission, vision, and objectives and that you feel comfortable in.

In short, after completing each one of these steps, and with the right counseling, you will obtain your event management license in a short time.

Step 1: Summarize your event management company’s operations

There is a wide range of activities that event managers can undertake in Dubai mainland and free zones, such as event promotion, organization, or post-event evaluation.

However, some of them are restricted. In order to avoid banning and penalties, write down and submit the services your event management company performs. This will also help you adjust your company to the UAE guidelines.

Therefore, to obtain your event management license in Dubai successfully, the activities you should avoid are:

  • Importing or exporting products
  • Facility management
  • Training activities
  • Talent agency-related activities
  • Organizing an event without prior approval from the local authorities

Step 2: Choosing an available name for your enterprise

Although it may seem irrelevant, this is an essential step. It is important that your organization’s name complies with the rules of the UAE territory.

Therefore, be sure to pick a name that is unique and available within the Dubai registries. Likewise, avoid using any offensive or blasphemous words or making references to renowned organizations or companies.

Click here to discover how you can get your own E-Version of Emirates ID

In case you want to use your personal name for your event management company, use your full name. That is to say, initials or abbreviations are not allowed.

Step 3: Choosing the right business set up area

When getting up an event management license in Dubai, there are two possible zone options available to consider: A Dubai Free Zone or Dubai Mainland. Both of them offer different advantages, benefits, and business setup options for event management organizations.

First, Free Zones are cost-effective jurisdictions. Exemption from customs duties, full repatriation of goods, profits, and invested capital, no personal and corporate income taxes, and no currency restrictions are some of the advantages provided by areas such as Dubai CommerCity, Dubai Design District, or Dubai Gold and Diamond Park.

However, Dubai Mainland company formation’s main attraction is the possibility of trading directly with the local market without using a local agent (which cannot be done in Free zones).

Learn more about how to get a Partnership VISA in Dubai by clicking here

However, no matter which one you choose, both options are a good place to create an event management corporation. Both the free zones and Dubai Mainland are strategically located, allowing easy access to the technology, investment, fashion, artistic and social markets.

Also, in both locations you will have full availability to high-standard facilities, offices, and warehouses, fully equipped with the best technological and digital devices.

Step 4: Gathering, organizing, and submitting requested documents

There is a short list of papers you will need to submit for an event management license in Dubai which include:

  • Filled event management license application form
  • Passport copy of owners
  • Business partner Passport copy (if any)
  • Two color Passport-sized photographs
  • Initial approval copy from government authority
  • Trade name registration certificate

Step 5: Pay the required fees

One of the last steps to formally apply for the event management license in Dubai is to pay some small services fees. The amount may vary depending on the jurisdiction where you apply for the permit, but it is around AED 14,500 – AED 15,000.

Some of the formalities you will have to pay for include:

  • Business license
  • Name approval
  • Initial approval
  • LSA notary fees
  • Company seal
  • Tasheel Fee
  • Company service
  • Documentation

On the other hand, if you are applying for an event management license in Dubai for the first time, it might be a good idea to add advisory service fees to the above list.

Step 6: Formally apply for the license

Once you have completed all the previous steps, you can formally apply for an event management license in Dubai. Depending on your organization’s needs, you can opt for a full license package or a non-visa license.

Click here to learn how to get a 5 multiple-entry tourist Visa in the UAE

Another advantage that Dubai event management licenses have is the option to keep working remotely in case you need to. However, the full license package includes access to Flexi-desks, which provides equipped facilities with Wi-Fi, mail services, internet, and telephone usage so, your business can have an address in the UAE territory.

5. Use of event management license to apply for visas

Lastly, if you want to set up a physical office in Dubai and supervise personally your event management company, you have the option to apply for a residence visa using your event management license.

The maximum number of visas you can apply for will depend on the package you choose, the number of employees, and the size of your company. Moreover, you can also serve as a sponsor for your family (children, spouses, or parents) to bring them to the UAE.

6. How can we help you get an event management license in Dubai?

To sum up, now you have better knowledge of how to get an event management license in Dubai, you can start planning your company’s entry into one of the best markets for event planning worldwide.

To achieve this, you will need to find the best consultancy team to set up your event planning business in Dubai quickly, safely, and effectively. With over 20 years of experience, Connect Zone has experience helping small, medium, and large companies to establish themselves in the UAE local market at the best price.

From VAT registration system to local partners, we ensure 24/7 support during the entire company formation process. In addition, with our Pro services, you will enjoy continuous advice after entering the Emirati market.

Would you like to contact Connect Zone to know how to get an event manager license in Dubai? In case you have any questions, call us on +971 43 316 688. Moreover, you can email us at contact@connectzone.ae, and you will talk to one of our representatives who will answer your questions.

Likewise, if you would like to receive extra information, send your CV or resume to thetalentpoint.com. Don’t worry; your personal information will not be stored.

FAQs

What is an event management license in Dubai?

It’s an official business license that allows you to legally plan, organise, promote, and manage events. These can be weddings, corporate events, exhibitions, and shows in Dubai.

Can foreigners start an event management company in Dubai?

Yes. Foreigners can fully own an event management company in Dubai. Free zones allow 100% foreign ownership, and mainland companies also allow full ownership under current regulations.

How much does an event management license cost in Dubai?

The cost usually starts around AED 12,000 and can go up to AED 25,000, as of 2025. However, the final amount depends on whether you choose a mainland or free zone setup and how many visas you need.

Which authority issues an event management license in Dubai?

The Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism issues the license for mainland companies. Whereas the chosen free zone authority issues the license for free zone companies.

Is a local sponsor required for an event management business?

No local sponsor is required for event management business in free zones. For mainland setup, a UAE national service agent may be required, but full business ownership stays with you.

How long does it take to get an event management license?

If documents are complete, the license is usually issued within 5 to 10 working days. Some free zones may issue the license even faster.

title: How to Obtain Golden Visa: Know everything about it
content:

    • What is the Golden Visa for the UAE?
    • What timeframe is required to get a Golden Visa for the UAE?
    • Are family members allowed to apply for a UAE Golden Visa?
    • What is the timeframe to stay outside the UAE with a Golden Visa?
    • Can I get a job with a UAE Golden Visa?

For the past several years, the UAE has emerged as a top option for entrepreneurs and investors to establish their businesses and homes. Due to a booming market, forward-looking investment objectives, and the possibility to opt for a Golden Visa, many individuals decided to set up in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and other Emirati jurisdictions.

In this article, you will learn everything you need to know about how to obtain a golden visa in the UAE. Additionally, you will discover the full list of main requirements, types of visas, and conditions to apply. You will also learn more about:

  1. What is a  UAE Golden Visa and Who Can Apply?
  2. Top Benefits of UAE Golden Visa for investors and entrepreneurs
  3. Who can apply for a Golden Visa in the UAE?
  4. 5-year Golden Visa: Requirements and profile
  5. 10-year Golden Visa: Requirements and profile
  6. Step by Step Golden Visa application process
  7. How can we help you obtain a Golden Visa in the UAE?\

1. What is a  UAE Golden Visa and Who Can Apply?

The UAE’s exponential economic growth caught the eye of investors and entrepreneurs from all over the world. Thanks to its pro-migration policy, the Emirati authorities created a special long-term residential visa, also known as Golden Visa; to help “talented people and great minds” to settle in the UAE territory.

As a result, the Golden Visa allows foreigners and residents business owners a way to get a resident visa without resorting to a local sponsor. Since its creation in 2019, around 400 professionals moved within UAE borders to work, live, and, most importantly, thrive in all senses.

Click here to learn everything about starting e-commerce in Sharjah Free Zone

However, Golden Visas have some special conditions. Firstly, not everyone is eligible to apply for them. Applicants must be professionals with years of experience in priority areas, researchers, investors, or large entrepreneurs.

Secondly, according to career and profession, a person can opt for a 5 or 10 year Golden visa (it will depend on the individual’s profile). Lastly, it is possible to apply for a renewal. However, to get it, the holder must follow some conditional terms.

2. Top benefits of a Golden Visa

The major benefit of the Golden Visa is allowing investors, entrepreneurs, and professionals the possibility to relocate to the UAE for a long-term period. According to solicited requirements, holders can reside in the country for up 5 to 10 years.

Likewise, holders enjoy:

  • Multiple-entry permits: Golden visa holders have greater options to move out of the UAE frequently. Unlike other residential visas, Golden Visas beneficiaries are exempt from remaining physically in the UAE every 6 months.
  • Beloved one’s extension: One of the general benefits of the visa is the extension of the visa to immediate family members (spouses and children) and business partners.
  • Permanence Security: Thanks to its long extension, foreign Golden Visa holders feel safer to enjoy a long period of stay in the UAE.
  • Renewal option: Although some conditions must be fulfilled, there is a possibility to renew the visa
  • Aid and special services: Golden Visa also comes with aid and assistance programs to help foreign and resident investors. For instance, the 24/7 “You are special service” program in Dubai.
  • Affordability: Contrary to what you may think, Golden Visa is one of the cheapest kinds of visas worldwide, making it more accessible for investors and entrepreneurs.

2.1 Golden visa cost

Cost may vary according to the type of visa you apply for. Each type has its own fees, documents, and requirements. However, it is around AED 5,000 for investors.

This amount excludes PRO services, additional fees, and charges.

3. Who can apply for a Golden Visa in the UAE?

The Golden Visa is intended to attract individuals who can contribute to the local economic growth and promote scientific, technological, and cultural advances.  Therefore, this visa is aimed at a specific type of foreigner.

It is typically given to people specialized in technology, venture, or creative fields. Likewise, other foreign and resident professionals like:

  • Investors
  • Entrepreneurs
  • Researchers
  • Large company’s owners
  • Promising science students
  • Specialized and experienced professionals
  • Public and private secondary outstanding students
  • Outstanding artists

Although all of these careers and professions are suitable candidates to opt for a Golden Visa, the duration of the Golden Visa will depend on the requirements to apply for the 5-year or the 10-year.

4. 5-year Golden Visa: Requirements and profile

5-years Golden Visas are related to the educational and investment fields. That is to say, they are aimed at investors, entrepreneurs, and outstanding students. The conditions and requirements for each one are:

4.1 Entrepreneurs

Business owners with organizations valued or with a minimum capital of AED 500,000. Moreover, another condition is that they have an incubator business credit approval within any of the UAE Free Zones, Mainland, or Off-Shore companies.

Benefits:

  • A six-month multi-entry permit
  • Visa renewal for another six months
  • Long-term visa including spouse, children, a business partner, and three executives

4.2 Investors

This profile includes entrepreneurs with investments equivalent to AED 5,000. In addition, another condition is that the investments cannot come out of a loan. On the other hand, if they have investments in real estate, these must be restrained for at least three years

Conditions:

  • The investor’s property or projects must be in a certified UAE field.
  • Applicant must own the supporting organization
  • Applicant’s company must provide records of support to startups or smaller enterprises. That is to say, they must provide resources and services to other organizations.
  • The applicant shall provide insurance for themselves and their immediate family members at the time of application.

4.3 Outstanding students

In this case, College and secondary students can apply for a Golden Visa if they are cursing scientific studies or possess an outstanding GPA.

Conditions:

  • Public or private secondary students with a minimum grade score of 95%
  • College students, within and outside the country, with a 3.75 GPA by graduation time.

Benefits:

  • Long-term visa for direct family

5. 10-year Golden Visa: Requirements and profile

Likewise, the 10-year Golden Visa profile and requirements are aimed at investors with high purchasing power or specialists with extensive academic and professional backgrounds. It also includes prominent figures in culture and the art world, doctors, high-level executives, and renowned scientists.

Therefore, specific requirements are:

5.1 Investors

In the case of investors, the main requirement is to be the owner of a company that has at least AED 10 million invested in the Emirati market. This amount repeats in the rest of the requirements.

Conditions:

  • Applicant must partner with an existing or new company that has a share value of no less than AED 10 million.
  • On the other hand, investors should have a 60% investment in real estate valued at no less than AED 10 million
  • It is essential that the investment does not come from a loan.
  • Applicant’s investment should be retained for at least three years
  • Investors should have solvency of AED 10 million before applying

Benefits

  • A business partners’ visa extension, on the condition that each partner contributes AED 10 million
  • A visa extension for spouses and children’s
  • Visa extensions for one executive director and one advisor
  • Possibility to apply for a multiple-entry permit for six months.

5.2 Individuals with specialized talents

It covers professionals in science, technological development, scientific fields, and knowledge such as doctors, inventors, scholars, and researchers. In addition, specialized individuals and experts in the arts and culture are also eligible for the Golden Visa.

Conditions:

  • Having a valid employment contract in a specialized field of priority in the UAE
  • Properly documented and proved exceptional talent skills
  • Patents or scientific research published in a high-level journal
  • Executives must own a leading and worldwide renowned company
  • Executives should present a high academic achievement position
  • Scientists must have a Mohammed Bin Rashid recognition for Scientific Excellence and accreditation of the Emirates Scientists Council
  • Art and culture researchers or professionals should be accredited by the Ministry of Culture and Youth

Click here to learn how you can access professional licenses in Dubai

On the other hand, extra requirements doctors and specialists should consider before applying are:

  • A Ph. D form of one of the top 500 Universities in the world
  • An award or certificates in his/her field of specialty
  • Proven contribution to a major scientific research organization in his/her field
  • Published articles in major scientific papers or magazines
  • Published renowned specialized books in his/her field
  • A Ph. D. degree
  • A 10-year professional experience career
  • Specializations in prior UAE tech, science, and cultural fields

6. Step by Step Golden Visa application process

Now that you know the profile to apply for a Golden Visa in the UAE, it is time to apply. If you meet the requirements and conditions, you must follow the next simple steps to make the process fast, safe and successful. These are:

Step 1: Gather the necessary documentation for its further submission in order to obtain the visa. The requested documents may vary according to the profile you fall in. However, in general terms, you will need the following:

  • Applicant’s Passport copy
  • Visa copy
  • An Emirates ID
  • Passport size color photo
  • Trade License/Licenses
  • Memorandum of Association
  • Certificate and license provided by an auditor
  • Bank statements
  • Company/Organization/Real estate title deed
  • Ejari
  • Applicant’s health insurance (this also includes direct family)

Step 2: Submit the documents in proper order to the Consulate

Step 3: Once you pay the correspondent fees, submit the documents, and have the authority’s approval, the Golden Visa will be issued. Be willing to relocate to the UAE as soon as possible

Thinking about setting up a business in the UAE? Learn why you need document clearing

However, getting a Golden Visa does not mean you won’t require some extra licenses and permits to work freely after establishing in the UAE. Before settling or applying for the Golden Visa, remember to choose the area in which you wish to live and obtain or renew the necessary permits to operate freely.

7. How can we help you obtain a Golden Visa in the UAE?

Applying for a Golden Visa is not a complicated process. On the contrary, it is an opportunity to transform your lifestyle and achieve new professional goals in one of the most prone countries in the world. At Connect Zone, we are ready to help you make your Golden Visa application process go smoothly.

With over 20 years of experience, we are experts in successfully advising and introducing companies to the Emirati market. Likewise, once you are fully established in the UAE, we can contribute to your growth with our PRO services, guaranteeing a team of experts available 24/7 at the best price.

We also provide company formation services, staff outsourcing, business center option, document data verification, translation, bookkeeping, and tax consultancy. If your profile does not fit the Golden Visa requirements, you can also consult us to apply for a Freelancer visa. Our cost-effective packages are designed to help you to enter the freelancer Emirati market and exploit your freelance skills.

Discover top 10 potential business setup ideas in Dubai

Would you like to contact Connect Zone to know more about how to get a Golden Visa in the UAE? In case you have any questions, call us on +971 43 316 688. Moreover, you can email us at contact@connectzone.ae, and you will talk to one of our representatives who will answer your questions.

To sum up, if you want to receive extra info about our products or services, submit your CV or resume to thetalentpoint.com. Don’t worry, your personal information won’t be shared or stored.

FAQs

Who can get a UAE Golden Visa?

People who can get a visa include investors, business leaders, scientists, excellent students, and those with specialized skills, such as doctors or surgeons.

What is the Golden Visa for the UAE?

It is a long-term residence visa, five to ten years, that allows international talent to reside, work, or pursue studies in the UAE without a local sponsor. It is issues depending on investment or extraordinary talent.

What timeframe is required to get a Golden Visa for the UAE?

The time it takes to process an application depends on the categories and the documents. However, in most simple circumstances, like investors, the approval is usually given within seven to fifteen working days.

Are family members allowed to apply for a UAE Golden Visa?

The primary beneficiary can sponsor their dependents. They can also sponsor multiple domestic servants to keep the family stable.

What is the timeframe to stay outside the UAE with a Golden Visa?

The provision specifies you may stay outside the UAE for more than six months in a row with this visa.

Can I get a job with a UAE Golden Visa?

You need to get a work permit from MOHRE or a non-sponsored identification card from the Free Zone authority.

mainEntity.name: How can I start an e-commerce business in Sharjah Free Zone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starting is a simple 4-step process in 2026: 1. Choose your business activity and trade name. 2. Apply via the SHAMS or SPC portal. 3. Submit passport copies and digital photos. 4. Pay fees and receive your e-license, often within 2 to 4 hours.

To offer services and products in the UAE it’s necessary to have a valid business license. One of the most requested by entrepreneurs and freelancers is the Professional license in Dubai. This is because it allows them to offer professional services to their clients legally in the UAE.

Since the UAE is one of the preferred places to make business, it’s good to know what options you have to start carrying out your activities there. So, knowing how to obtain this business license and what benefits can offer you it’s a great place to start.

In this article, you’re going to learn everything you need to know regarding the professional license in the UAE. In addition, you can gain valuable insight about why a third-party can be of great help during this process. Let’s observe:

  • Professional license in Dubai

1. Professional license in Dubai

Running a business in Dubai can be a great decision for investors and entrepreneurs. This is because this place has a thriving and flourishing market that you can enter easily. Additionally, since it’s a place that attracts people from different places, you have high chances of finding your perfect target audience.

In this regard, to have a legal business in the UAE you must apply for a business license. The DED (Department of Economic Development) is the responsible body to issue these licenses. So, there are several licenses to which you can choose from:

  • Commercial license: for companies who will carry out trading activities
  • Industrial license: companies that will engage in manufacturing activities
  • Professional license: for individuals who will offer services, craftsmen and/or artisans.

If you want to be a service provider, you must apply for a Professional license in Dubai.

Here’s what you have to know about Offshore Companies in Dubai.

2. What is a Professional License?

The professional license can be obtained by businesses that want to engage in service-oriented activities. Skilled individuals who hold a professional degree, have enough experience in a particular field or profession, and professionals can apply for this business license.

So, a professional license is for individuals who rely on their talents, skills and intellectual abilities to conduct businesses.

Entrepreneurs may feel confused whether they must apply for this kind of license or if they should go for a commercial license. This is because there are some activities that may fall under the commercial category as well as under the professional one.

Therefore, it’s important to know which one suits your business activity best. It’s also important to understand the Professional license requirements in Dubai, so you can have everything ready to submit your application.

3. Who should apply for a Professional License in Dubai?

Before starting to learn about the process and Professional license fees in Dubai, it’s important to know the eligibility. Anyone who wants to conduct business in the UAE should have a business license. The problem is knowing which license is the proper one for your activity.

If you’re a professional that wants to offer your services in the UAE, you must apply for the professional license.

And, if you’re planning on establishing a business that offers professional services, you’re also eligible to apply.

Regarding who should apply, any individual or company that relies on trained skills to offer a service can be a professional. So, if you hold any of the following professions, you should get the professional license:

  • Accountant
  • Financial advisor
  • Architectural consultant
  • Medical representative
  • Educational professionals
  • Business consultants
  • Web designers
  • IT professionals
  • Technical services
  • Artisans and carpenters
  • Healthcare professionals

If you’re a skilled professional but you don’t know if you should apply for this kind of license, you should look for help. Here in Connect Zone we can provide guidance regarding how to obtain the proper business license for your company.

Find out how you can obtain your E-trader license in Dubai Mainland.

4. What are the benefits of having a professional license?

Having a Professional license in Dubai can provide several benefits. First and foremost, you’re able to carry out your activities legally while you live in one of the top places in the world.

Here we have some of the best benefits of holding this kind of license

100% ownership

With a professional license you can have 100% ownership of your business, unlike industrial and commercial licenses.

You can have your sole proprietorship business, but to do this you must appoint a local agent. This local service agent must be an UAE national as this is a requirement for completing judicial formalities.

However, the agent won’t have any control over your business. This agent will only charge the fixed annual fee for the service.

Access to a lucrative market

In Dubai you can find clients from different backgrounds, and you can offer your services to obtain a great income. In addition, you can connect with other professionals, vendors, and businesses to develop a solid network.

This will help you have a better quality of life and enjoying the luxurious lifestyle of this thriving place.

Learn how you can get your partnership Visa in Dubai.

5. What are the requirements to obtain a professional license in Dubai?

To obtain this important document you must know about the Professional license requirements in Dubai.

It’s important to have everything ready so you can carry out the process smoothly. Here we have the requirements to obtain the professional license:

  • Appoint a local service agent
  • Choose a trade name for your business that complies with the law
  • Develop a detailed business plan describing your business activity
  • Fill the application to obtain the business license
  • Get copies of your passport and of your partners’
  • Obtain the NOC for the foreign partners (if required)
  • Prepare a copy of your visa
  • Rent an office space

In addition, you must learn about the Professional license cost in Dubai so you can know how much you’ll have to pay for this document.

6. Which activities are covered by the professional license?

When you have your Professional license in Dubai you can carry out your business activities legally. But, before applying, it’s important to know which business activity you want to conduct. In this regard, the DED has established the list of activities that fall under the professional license. This is to make it easier for individuals to know to which one apply.

Some of the business activities covered by the professional license are the following:

  • Consultancy services
  • Artisanship
  • Medical services
  • Financial and auditing services
  • Beauty salons
  • Repair and maintenance services
  • Printing and publishing services
  • Security services
  • Carpentry

These are just some of the few activities that are under the professional license. The DED has the long list that anyone can consult to check if their profession is suitable with the professional license. After determining your business activity, the next step is knowing How to get professional license in Dubai.

See the process you have to go through to get the UAE Residence Visa.

7. What is the Process to obtain a Professional License in Dubai?

It’s important to note that you should know How to get professional license in Dubai if you want to offer professional services.

In this regard, you should learn about the process so you can know how to carry out it successfully.

  1. Local service agent: enter into an agreement with a local service agent (must be an UAE national) and fill the agreement form.
  2. Get the agreement translated into Arabic and attested
  3. Make the MOA (Memorandum of Association) with your local service agent
  4. Find an office space and obtain the tenancy contract for leasing it
  5. Get the EJARI registration and approval from the municipality for the tenancy contract
  6. Submit the application along with the documents to the DED
  7. Once you get the approval, make the payments for the license

Which documents do you need to obtain your business license?

The following are the documents you must gather, translate and attest when necessary:

  • Business owners’ passport copies
  • If one of the business owner is a resident in the UAE, you must submit the Emirates ID copy
  • Visit visa copy for expatriate business owners
  • Emirates ID copy and passport copy of the local service agent
  • Additional approvals
  • Approval from the municipality

Here’s explained how you can get an E-version of the Emirates ID.

Which documents do you need to submit the tenancy contract?

It’s important to obtain the approval from the municipality of your tenancy contract. This is because you’ll need this document to obtain your business license.

Here’s the following documents you need:

  • BR1 form
  • Trade name certificate
  • Initial approval
  • Tenancy contract
  • EJARI registration

In some cases, the DED will also require for the applicants to pay a fee and a security deposit. If the business is a civil company (two or more partners) it’s necessary to pay the security deposit of AED 20000. If it’s a single person, the security deposit is of AED 10000.

8. What is the cost of the professional license in Dubai?

Another important aspect you have to take into account is the Professional license fees in Dubai. Once you have received the approval, you must pay the necessary fees to collect your business license.

The cost of the professional license is around AED 15310 in Dubai. It’s worth noting that this price includes the following:

1. Fees for the professional license

2. Fees for paying the trade name registration

3. Fees for appointing the service agent

4. Market fees (based on your chosen business activity)

5. Administrative services fees

6. Local fees

7. Government cultural fees

After having paid the Professional license in Dubai cost, you can obtain your business license. Then, you can carry out your business activities and offer your services legally in Dubai.

See how you can obtain a 5-year multiple entry tourist visa in the UAE.

9. Common questions regarding the professional license

It’s important to be clear regarding every aspect surrounding the professional license. For this reason, here we have some of the doubts regarding this important document.

Some of the most common questions are the following:

Can I have 100% ownership of my business with a professional license?

With the professional license, you’re able to have 100% ownership of your business. With all the other legal structures in the UAE, you must have an UAE national as a partner who will hold the 51% of shares of your business, Or does any Legal Services Support or Legal Advice UAE is Required? No Absolutely not.

However, with the professional license you can establish your business and have 100% ownership. But, you should have a local service agent that will receive the fixed annual fee.

How many partners can I have with a professional license?

Perhaps you may think that with a professional license you can establish a company with a single partner. But, the truth is that you can establish a civil company with more than one owner and obtain your professional license.

This kind of legal structure is known as a civil company. Make sure to have all the necessary documents of each owner to apply for the business license.

10. How can Connect Zone help you obtain the professional license?

Here in Connect Zone we want to assist you with your goals of establishing your business in the UAE. Our team of professionals can help you obtain the Professional license in Dubai so you can offer your services legally.

Start building your network, getting clients, and enjoying the high quality of life in Dubai by working as a service provider. We can assist you through each stage of the process so you don’t have to worry about the paperwork or administrative tasks.

If you’re interested in knowing more about the professional license in Dubai, you can contact us at contact@connectzone.ae, or you can call us at +1 (971) 433 1688 and one of our representatives will gladly answer all of your inquiries.

A professional license in Dubai allows individuals to offer services based on skills and expertise.

Who qualifies for a professional license in Dubai?

Consultants, freelancers, and service providers qualify for getting a professional license.

How much does a professional license cost in Dubai?

The costs for a professional license in Dubai vary depending on your jurisdiction and visa requirements.

What documents are required for a professional license in Dubai?

You will need your passport copies, qualifications, and approvals to apply for your professional license in Dubai.

What is the process to renew a professional license in Dubai?

You can renew your professional license in Dubai by annually applying through the licensing authority.

  6. How can Connect Zone help you set up an offshore business?

1. What is the definition of an Offshore company?

For many, picturing a place where businesses don’t have to give up a big part of their revenue on taxes would simply be a dream. Additionally, imaging anyone could form a company in any corner of the world and not pay taxes seems rather unreachable. However, in today’s world, this is certainly a handy option for business owners.

An offshore company allows businesses to operate outside their juridical registration. In a nutshell, this means that it is possible to register your company in a country you do not reside in. If that specific place we talk about is Dubai, suddenly that dream world we mentioned seems just around the corner.

See more details on how to set up your business in Dubai

There are two jurisdictions available for offshore companies in Dubai. The Ras Al Khaimah and Jebel Ali Free zone are free-taxation zones offering 100% ownership for foreign entrepreneurs. These jurisdictions allow start-up companies to have the benefits of a Dubai company while remaining in a foreign country.

The Ras Al Khaimah is known for having a big influx of foreign Investors. Entrepreneurs from all over the world are usually attracted to its booming economy, innovative architecture, and business-friendly policies. On the other hand, Jebel Ali accounts as one of the free zones with the most international companies. Jebel is amongst the firsts free zones established in the UAE, being among the most progressive zones for businesses.

Click here to learn more about 100% ownership in Dubai 

2. Why have Offshore companies become so popular in Dubai?

Over the past few decades, we have been able to see the rapid surge of these so-called offshore companies. Because of Dubai’s promising economy, many startup companies have become interested in getting Dubai’s jurisdiction and becoming offshore companies.

There are multiple key factors that attract and invite entrepreneurs from all over the world to invest and set up their businesses in Dubai. Overall these attractive features focus mainly on helping business owners to grow their companies both nationally and internationally.

If we consider the amount of revenue international enterprises have to give up in taxes alone, it’s no surprise because offshore companies in Dubai became so popular. For instance, business owners that lack access to a residence visa in Dubai and don’t want to pay an absurd amount of money in taxes can opt for getting an offshore company in Dubai.

Here you can find all the information you need to get a UAE resident Visa

Additionally, because of Dubai’s business-friendly policies, there aren’t many restrictions for foreign companies to get an offshore jurisdiction. In fact, getting an offshore company in Dubai can be rather easy when backed with the right assistance. For that matter, here at connect zone, we offer you the best assistance to get your company registered hassle-free, with the help of our capacitated professionals.

3. What are the benefits of an Offshore company?

Depending on the jurisdictional area you choose, the benefits that offshore companies in Dubai receive vary. Besides this, there are various observable differences regarding the requirements and features of offshore companies in Dubai.

For example, getting an offshore registration in JAFZA, can allow you to have local real estate ownership, while a RAK jurisdiction cannot. Differences like this depend mostly on the policies established for each offshore registration zone. However, that isn’t to say that one zone is more favorable than the other, it is just about determining what zone suits you best.

See all the details you should know about the JAFZA free zone

3.1. Here are some of the benefits that a JAFZA jurisdiction can offer

100% foreign ownership – A minimum of one shareholder is required for offshore companies in Dubai located in the JAFZA Zone. Naturally, full foreign ownership is possible to obtain with this jurisdiction.

Shareholding in local companies – Despite the emphasized prohibitions for offshore companies to do business with locals, the authorities do allow shareholding in local companies and free zones companies.

Real estate ownership – One particular feature of the JAFZA offshore companies is the permission for real estate investment. This means that JAFZA offshore companies can directly own real estate. However, to do this you will first need to have a development approval and a free zone approval.

Anonymity – There is no need for public disclosure when it comes to offshore companies in Dubai. In the JAFZA Zone, it is not a requirement for offshore companies to disclose any information about the shareholders or directors in any public register.

Access to a local bank account – Getting access to a local bank account could be considered one of the most essential tools given to offshore companies in Dubai. Additionally, with a local bank account, you will be able to do multi-currency transactions both nationally and internationally.

3.2. Here are some of the benefits that a RAK jurisdiction can offer

100% ownership for foreigners – As we are speaking about offshore companies in Dubai, the main benefit of getting a RAK jurisdiction is being able to own your business without a local partner involved. Furthermore this jurisdiction requires a minimum of one shareholder to get a RAK jurisdiction.

Fast incorporation – Thanks to the diligent and rapid services of the RAK registration process, companies can be registered within one week. If you want to get your RAK jurisdiction within no time, Connect Zone can help you make sure all your documents are error-free. Furthermore, our team of specialized VAT professionals can register your company hassle-free as well as assist you on any bookkeeping or tax service you may need.

Company administration – While it is a requirement for your company to have at least one secretary and one director, there is no need to disclose any information about your company’s administration to the public.

Shareholder’s anonymity – As well as we previously explained for the administrative activity of your company, there are no requirements for you to publicly disclose information about your shareholders.

Local bank account access – Just like the JAFZA jurisdiction, the RAK jurisdiction provides access to a national bank account. Further allowing your business to do both national and international multi-currency transactions and invest in local companies.

3.3 Some of the most general benefits that Offshore companies in Dubai can get may include:

  • Tax neutrality for both national and international company profits.
  • A stable economy and a business-friendly legal system.
  • Provides security to companies with trademarked content.
  • Easy setup process.
  • Trading commodities, both nationally and internationally.
  • Complete anonymity of your name. This will not be in any public documentation.

4. What kind of companies can become offshore in Dubai?

Now that you know the benefits offshore companies in Dubai have, let’s check what companies fit into the offshore model. For instance, knowing what kind of license your company needs is crucial. This is because there are only a certain number of licenses available for offshore registration.

For that matter, here at Connect Zone we want to help you through the entire registration process. From personalized assessment for your company, to register your company hassle-free in the right jurisdiction with the right license. Our team of VAT specialized representatives can give you the assistance you need during the extension of this process.

Now, let’s determine what specific licenses are available for offshore companies in Dubai:

International trading License – In an offshore trading company, it is possible for you to contact consumers directly. This means that you can receive and send the orders, and additionally deliver the products directly to a manufacturing company.

Get further insights about the new E-trader license in Dubai

Professional license – This license is available for businesses focused on providing professional services. The professional service industry is a big part of the offshore companies in Dubai. They mostly account for professional assistance in legal or administrative areas.

Commercial license – Offshore companies in Dubai that hold commercial licenses account mostly for property holding. This includes specific cases in which offshore companies are bought with the only purpose of holding a property in a low-cost zone and distributing the shares as desired. Examples of these cases can be inheritance procedures or marital divorces in which the shared need to be distributed.

5. How can I set up an Offshore company in Dubai?

Considering the ever-growing economic scene that we can see Dubai becoming, it is no surprise that the offshore market is growing faster than ever. With all the benefits and facilities that Dubai offers to newcomers, it is only imaginable the amount people looking to get offshore jurisdiction in Dubai.

5.1. Here are the steps you need to take in order to get an offshore registration:

Select your company’s name – This name has to be original. For that, Connect zone has an already established registration process to help you verify the name you chose hasn’t already been claimed.

Select the right activity for your company – Choosing the right activity your company will do is crucial. With that information Connect Zone can help you get into a jurisdiction that suits best your company.

Select the right license – This will ensure you that your company is in fact capable of operating in an offshore jurisdiction. This is because, depending on your company’s operations, there might not be a license that suits your company. In order to avoid that, Connect Zone has a team of experienced specialists ready to help you select the most suitable license for your company.

Gather and send the required documentation – By this point you’ll have to submit the pertinent documents required for offshore companies in Dubai. These documents include; proprietorship documents of the company you are registering and personal documents.

5.2. What documents do I need to register an offshore company?

While establishing an offshore company in Dubai may sound simple, there are a few requirements that you need to meet in order to get there. This is assuming that you have the legal knowledge to submit all of your documentation free of error and with the right information in it.  Here is a list of all the documentation you will need:

  • A reference letter from your bank – This will have a summary of all the transactions you have done with it over the past six months.
  • The memorandum of association of your company – This document will show the information and positions of all the shareholders in your company (In case there are more than one).
  • Current jurisdiction of the company’s owner.
  • Copies of the passports belonging to the shareholders and employees.

6. How can Connect Zone help you set up an offshore business?

Getting an offshore company in Dubai isn’t as simple as it may sound and establishing an offshore business can be rather tricky. For some, the process may look simple, but the truth says otherwise. For that Connect Zone wants to help you get this process just right.

Connect Zone has multiple services that can make your registration process easier.  With over twenty years of experience setting offshore companies in Dubai, Connect Zone can help you register your company hassle-free, and aid with any bookkeeping required for your company.

If you are interested to know more about how we can help you, you can contact us at contact@connectzone.ae, or you can give us a call on + 1 (971) 4331-6688 and one of our expert representatives will gladly answer all your inquiries.

What is an offshore company in Dubai?

An offshore company in Dubai operates internationally with no local trading.

What are the benefits of setting up an offshore company in Dubai?

The benefits of setting up an offshore company in Dubai are asset protection, tax efficiency, and confidentiality benefits apply.

Who can open an offshore company in the UAE?

Foreign individuals and companies can open offshore entities in the UAE.

What documents are required for offshore company formation?

The documents, such as passport copies, proof of address, and business details, are required for offshore company formation.

Can an offshore company open a bank account in Dubai?

Offshore companies can open a bank account in Dubai, subject to bank compliance checks.

Is physical office space required for offshore companies?

Offshore companies do not require office space to operate.

mainEntity.name: What is an offshore company in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: An offshore company (also known as a non-resident company) is a legal entity registered in a UAE offshore jurisdiction like JAFZA or RAK ICC. It is designed for international trade, asset holding, and wealth management, but it is strictly prohibited from conducting commercial activities within the UAE mainland or free zones.

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of setting up an offshore company in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key benefits include 100% foreign ownership, zero corporate and personal income tax (on foreign-sourced income), high level of confidentiality for shareholders, and robust asset protection against international lawsuits. It also allows for easier capital and profit repatriation.

mainEntity.name: Who can open an offshore company in the UAE?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any foreign individual, entrepreneur, or existing international company can open an offshore entity. There are no nationality restrictions, and the owners do not need to be UAE residents.

mainEntity.name: What documents are required for offshore company formation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically required documents include certified passport copies of shareholders and directors, proof of residence (utility bills), a professional reference letter from a bank, and a detailed CV of the owners. A registered agent in the UAE is mandatory to handle the application.

mainEntity.name: Can an offshore company open a bank account in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, offshore companies can open multi-currency corporate bank accounts in the UAE. However, due to strict AML and KYC regulations in 2026, banks require thorough documentation, a clear business plan, and often a minimum average balance (typically AED 20,000 to AED 100,000).

mainEntity.name: Is physical office space required for offshore companies?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, offshore companies are not allowed to lease physical office space in the UAE. Instead, they must use the address of their 'Registered Agent' as their official legal address.
